jobs.title: Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Company:**
MARS Cosmetics

**About MARS Cosmetics:**

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**Role Summary**

Own end-to-end skincare and haircare product development from concept to launch, driving formulation, packaging, claims, costing, timelines, and cross-functional execution with internal teams and 3P manufacturers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the NPD pipeline across skincare (serums, gels, emulsions) and haircare (shampoos, conditioners, masks, oils, scalp treatments, styling): identify opportunities, build briefs, define hero claims/USPs, and execute launch plans.
2. Manage formulation development with 3P labs/OEMs, from prototypes and performance benchmarks through stability, finalization, and scale-up.
3. Translate consumer problems into measurable product targets (e.g., hydration, brightening, anti-hairfall, anti-dandruff, frizz control, scalp oil control).
4. Drive packaging development: component selection (pumps, droppers, flip-tops), compatibility and leakage/transport testing, artwork readiness, and vendor coordination.
5. Own product quality and performance: sensorial targets (texture, foam, slip, rinse feel), fragrance direction, efficacy and claims substantiation inputs, safety, and QA handover.
6. Build and control timelines using stage-gates; manage risks, iterations, and stakeholder alignment.
7. Own product costing (COGS/BOM): target pricing, value engineering, MOQ planning, and margin guardrails.
8. Coordinate regulatory readiness for India, including labeling/claims compliance and documentation with RA/QA partners.
9. Benchmark competitors and global trends (actives, delivery systems, textures, formats) and convert them into actionable specs.

**Requirements**

1. 4–8 years in skincare and/or haircare NPD (brand side or OEM/ODM), with multiple launches shipped.
2. Strong formulation and packaging understanding: emulsions/gels/serums for skincare; surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones, and oils for haircare; compatibility and stability basics.
3. Experience running vendor cycles with Indian/China/SEA partners, including iteration discipline, negotiation, and scale-up execution.
4. Strong project management; comfortable with BOM, COGS, MOQ, margin targets, and launch scorecards.
5. High ownership, fast execution, and strong cross-functional communication.

jobs.title: Coffee Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

jobs.title: Research And Development Manager (Face Care)
jobs.description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands –
**mCaffeine & Hyphen**
. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is India’s first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEP’s mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases.

**Come, join the pack!**

**Job Summary:**

We're looking for a
**Face Care Lead**
to own the complete R&D agenda for our Face Care category — serums, moisturizers, face sunscreens, toners and adjacent formats. This is a category-ownership role: you will set the face care innovation roadmap, lead a small team of formulators, stay hands-on with critical formulations, and act as the technical authority for face care across Brand, Marketing and Business teams. You'll be accountable for what we launch, how well it performs, and how competitive our face care science is versus the market.

**Key Responsibilities :**

1. Category Strategy & Technical Ownership

* Own the face care R&D roadmap (launches, upgrades, range extensions) and give final technical sign-off before launch.
* Guide technical direction on actives, delivery systems, emulsions, UV protection, and standardized base platforms.
* Lead product reformulations, cost-optimization programs, and maintain an alternate ingredient library to de-risk supply.

2. Hands-on Formulation Expertise

* Formulate and troubleshoot complex products (active serums, hybrid sunscreens, lightweight moisturizers) for Indian skin and climate.
* Set sensorial benchmarks (texture, absorption, finish, fragrance) and resolve escalated stability, compatibility, preservation, and scale-up issues.

3. Testing, Claims & Compliance

* Define testing protocols (stability, packaging, preservative efficacy, SPF/PA, dermatological safety) and execute clinical/consumer claims substantiation.
* Ensure full regulatory compliance (CDSCO/BIS and international standards) across all products and ingredients.

4. Team Leadership

* Manage and mentor 2–4 formulators, oversee project prioritization/bandwidth, and establish lab SOPs and tracking practices

5. Cross-functional & Market Alignment

* Partner with Brand, Marketing, and Category teams to build the pipeline and represent R&D in business reviews.
* Manage contract manufacturers and suppliers (tech transfer, scale-up, evaluation) while tracking global skincare trends

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Cosmetic Science/Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or related field (PhD a plus)
* 7–10 years of cosmetics/personal care R&D experience, with deep specialization in face care
* Proven experience leading a team (formulators/executives) in addition to individual formulation work
* Expert knowledge of skincare actives, emulsion science, UV filter systems, preservation and stability
* Strong working knowledge of CDSCO/BIS regulations and international cosmetic standards
* Established network with ingredient suppliers, testing labs and contract manufacturers Strong business acumen and communication skills — credible with lab teams, brand teams and leadership
* High ownership and energy for building a category in a fast-scaling D2C / start-up environment.

jobs.title: Executive- Formulation & Development (Sterile)
jobs.description:
Role Objective:

To execute hands-on laboratory experiments for the formulation development of sterile liquid injectables, drug-device combination products, and lyophilized formulations. This role focuses on day-to-day experimental execution, cycle optimization, device compatibility evaluation, and operational troubleshooting under the guidance of senior team members to ensure smooth project progression. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Formulation Execution: Conduct routine laboratory experiments to develop stable, robust sterile liquid injectable dosage forms and troubleshoot technical issues during development.
* Drug-Device Testing: Perform compatibility, functional testing, and quality evaluations for drug-device combination products in alignment with regulatory expectations.
* Lyophilization Support: Execute freeze-drying runs for peptides, proteins, and small molecules, aiding in cycle development, optimization, and characterization.
* Laboratory Operations: Maintain analytical and processing equipment, document experimental protocols, keep meticulous laboratory notebooks, and draft standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Scale-Up Assistance: Assist senior scientists in technology transfer activities, batch manufacturing records (BMR) preparation, and pilot batch execution.
* Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to cGMP guidelines, safety standards, and internal quality systems in all daily laboratory activities.

  
STAKEHOLDER INTERACTION

Type of Interaction: Internal

* Interaction with: Senior Scientists, Analytical R&D, Quality Assurance, and Packaging Development.
* Nature of Interaction: Daily routine work alignment, reporting experimental results, sample handover for analytical testing, and technical data discussion.

Type of Interaction: External

* Interaction with: Raw material suppliers and analytical/equipment vendors.
* Nature of Interaction: Procurement of lab samples/reagents, routine equipment calibration support, and gathering technical product specifications.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

* Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in sterile injectable formulation R&D.
* Technical Expertise:

1. Operational understanding of aseptic processing techniques, sterile compounding, filtration, and lyo cycle monitoring.
2. Basic familiarity with ICH guidelines, GLP/cGMP protocols, and device compatibility metrics.

* Skills:

1. Hands-on formulation development of sterile liquid injectables and basic troubleshooting capabilities.
2. Exposure to drug-device combination product testing, device functionality, and compatibility setups.
3. Practical experience operating lyophilizers and supporting freeze-drying cycle optimization for small molecules, peptides, or proteins.

Academic Qualifications & Certifications

jobs.description:
Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (MPS) is one of the fastest growing companies in the Semiconductor industry. We are worldwide technical leaders in Integrated Power Semiconductors and Systems Power delivery architectures. At MPS, we cultivate creativity, are passionate about sustainability, and are committed to providing leading-edge products and innovation to our customers. Our portfolio of technology helps power our world ---come join our team and see how YOU can make a difference.

This is a customer application engineer position, based in Bangalore and reporting to the Automotive Product Line. The candidate will be working on automotive applications at Tier1 and OEM customers in India, across ADAS, infotainment/IVI, power distribution and lighting.

  

The candidate will be supporting the local FAE and sales teams, understanding the customers needs and requirements, planning action items, communicating with MPS internal departments, and driving actions to meet customer requirements and deliver the best solution.

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Engineering Manager

\_\_

**Mission of the Role**

Are you interested in cybersecurity governance and motivated to be part of a global company transforming the industry with advanced technology? ABB is looking for a **Cyber Security Specialist** to join our **Automation Engineering and Service organization** in Machine Automation.

New European Union regulations set rules for how applications must be engineered and delivered. In this role, you will define the first cybersecurity governance and security guidelines for these applications. You will be the primary contact for cybersecurity matters. If you have experience in GRC, IEC 62443 and ISO/IEC 27001, and you are ready to turn regulations into practical controls, this opportunity is for you!

  

**Work model:** Hybrid

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define, maintain and continuously improve the cybersecurity governance framework for global automation engineering and services.
* Translate ABB requirements, customer obligations, regulations and standards (such as IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2) into practical controls, processes and responsibilities.
* Coordinate cybersecurity risk assessments, treatment, risk acceptance by designated risk owners, escalation and exception management. Maintain risk and compliance reporting.
* Define the secure development lifecycle, decision rights, RACI models and minimum requirements for engineering projects, service activities and lifecycle changes.
* Coordinate compliance assessments, audits and corrective actions. Develop reusable policies, templates, checklists and control mappings.
* Monitor regulatory and standards developments, including NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and coordinate the required governance updates.
* Support and advise customers on cybersecurity requirements and help them apply practical security measures in their automation applications.
* Align with Product Cyber Security, R&D, IT, Quality, Legal & Integrity and regional organizations, providing practical guidance on governance, risk and compliance.

  

**Requirements**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Practical experience in cybersecurity, risk and compliance, including direct technical security work.
* Good knowledge of IEC 62443 and ISO/IEC 27001, and familiarity with NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act and cybersecurity risk management principles.
* Understanding of customer cybersecurity requirements, third-party governance and the practical implementation of security controls in engineering and service environments.
* Ability to structure risk decisions, control frameworks, exceptions, audit evidence and KPIs, and to translate complex requirements into practical guidance.
* Solid technical writing, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with a pragmatic, risk-based working style and the ability to work without formal authority.
* Fluent English.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience in industrial automation, OT or other industrial environments.

  

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to be part of a global company engaged in large-scale industrial projects.
* The chance to build the first cybersecurity governance guidelines of this kind for the organization.
* Collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a supportive development culture.
* Growth possibilities within a solid technical career path inside ABB.
* Hybrid work model.

  

**About ABB's Machine Automation Division**

The Machine Automation division of ABB **(B&R Industrial Automation)** works with automation engineering and service teams and customers worldwide. Our teams develop solutions that support digital transformation and improve operational performance for our customers.

  

AUSTRIA: The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is 4.472,11 EUR monthly for a full-time position as of November 2026. But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience .

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

**Overview**   
   

As a PD specification writer, the role requires ensuring that the necessary criteria and requirements in building the specification of ING and Non INGs (Excluding Packaging Label) are met. This role will drive the legacy specification migration to SAP initially and provide support to PepsiCo Product Developers on new ING NON-ING PD Spec development to ensure they comply with the standards and requirements Post System rollout in the sector.

  
 **Responsibilities**   
   

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the PepsiCo PLM and SW ways of working in legacy systems (offline) and in SAP including Global Ingredient Standard and Supplier Standard and become proficient in the CAST Program and IT Applications associated.
* Drive accurate migration of Legacy Specs (ING and Non ING) in SAP systems and validate with regional teamsPre Go live on CAST.
* Collaborate with Regional teams to review and update ING Non-ING specifications in line with the regular spec renewal dates.
* Collaborate with Regional Cross Functional Teams and external resources to develop ING and Non-ING specifications (Excluding Label Packaging) that are clear, concise, and accurate to be handed over to run operations- Post Go Live on CAST.
* Ensure all requests are processed, documented, and delivered within defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
* Identify potential areas for process improvements to make recommendations to RD Leadership for continuous improvement.
* Raise necessary CRs on behalf of sector R D teams when needed and aligned.

**ING Specs**  :

* Work with and provide guidance to suppliers in completing the requirements of the specification through the completion of relevant tools i.e. ISSQ, in the following Key areas:

* Ingredient Composition
* All Chemical, physical and other parameter requirement.
* Claims/Compliance related with QA/FS
* Food safety Requirements
* Allergen
* Test method and limit of for FS and Performance parameters
* Ingredient Micro sensitive assessment.
* Other Spec General information

* Validate correct migration of data to the Global Ingredient Specification system, includes review of the information and supporting documents/evidence collected from the supplier.
* Work with Functional approver to review and align the specifications created/updated. Communicate with Operations and vendors for acceptance on specification change as needed. Coordinate uploads with SDSA teams.
* Work with Functional Approvers (Regulatory, Quality, Food Safety, Product Development, Analytical and Micro), and facilitate engagement with the relevant stakeholders like GP, SQA and QC for enrichment of specifications as per Global business workflows.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards.
* Collaborate with LiSU to assess impact on higher level specs if any and manage with regional partners.
* Upload all paperwork (i.e., Supplier Specs) and materials qualifications into the SAP system and track workflow.
* Manage Supplier relationships and serve as point of contact to gather information/data needed to build specifications; complete timely follow-ups to keep the process moving to completion.

**Non ING Specs (Scope- Formula, Process, FGE):**

* Collaborate with and provide guidance to regional PD, TDC and Packaging teams in completing the requirements of the Non-ING specs through the completion of relevant tools- AMESA Spec Request Form PLM Templates.
* Align ER release per the project classification (Innovation, Productivity, TBS, Ingredient Change etc).
* Digitize the Non ING specs accurately per the information received from PDs and review ER progress against the agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with PD,TDC, Pkg partners to ensure ER closure on time.
* Collaborate with SDSA, RA Pkg partners to ensure the necessary uploads in R D repositories.
* Escalate the risks/challenges faced (if any) well in time with the stakeholders through the progress on ER(s) for the projects.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards

**System associated activities:**

- Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of systems related to creation of specifications (e.g. SAP) as may

be required. Report gaps, roadblocks or findings and support on finding solutions and help facilitate closure with

IT SMEs

  
 **Qualifications**   
   

* Bachelors degree in Food Engineering, Food Safety, Food Technology, Food Science and Microbiology, or adjacent subjects. MS is desired.
* Min. 2-3 years of experience on Regulatory, QA/QC, Food Analytical experience or other Food related FMCG in a technical role; 1-2 years of which on Product Development or Specification Writing.
* Well-versed on Microsoft Office and Excel.
* Effective communication skills, both verbal (i.e. presentation, conference calls) and written (i.e. reports, e-mails) in English.
* Confident and able to speak or present to senior leaders when needed.
* Learning agility, self-motivation and desire for continuous self-improvement.
* Team player and works well with cross-functional, cross-regional and cross-cultural teams.
* Can work independently and has initiative for problem solving

* Identify potential areas for process improvements to make recommendations to RD Leadership for continuous improvement.

* Food safety Requirements
* Allergen
* Test method and limit of for FS and Performance parameters
* Ingredient Micro sensitive assessment.
* Other Spec General information

* Validate correct migration of data to the Global Ingredient Specification system, includes review of the information and supporting documents/evidence collected from the supplier.
* Work with Functional approver to review and align the specifications created/updated. Communicate with Operations and vendors for acceptance on specification change as needed. Coordinate uploads with SDSA teams.
* Work with Functional Approvers (Regulatory, Quality, Food Safety, Product Development, Analytical and Micro), and facilitate engagement with the relevant stakeholders like GP, SQA and QC for enrichment of specifications as per Global business workflows.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards.
* Collaborate with LiSU to assess impact on higher level specs if any and manage with regional partners.
* Upload all paperwork (i.e., Supplier Specs) and materials qualifications into the SAP system and track workflow.
* Manage Supplier relationships and serve as point of contact to gather information/data needed to build specifications; complete timely follow-ups to keep the process moving to completion.

Non ING Specs (Scope- Formula, Process, FGE):

* Collaborate with and provide guidance to regional PD, TDC and Packaging teams in completing the requirements of the Non-ING specs through the completion of relevant tools- AMESA Spec Request Form PLM Templates.
* Align ER release per the project classification (Innovation, Productivity, TBS, Ingredient Change etc).
* Digitize the Non ING specs accurately per the information received from PDs and review ER progress against the agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with PD,TDC, Pkg partners to ensure ER closure on time.
* Collaborate with SDSA, RA Pkg partners to ensure the necessary uploads in R D repositories.
* Escalate the risks/challenges faced (if any) well in time with the stakeholders through the progress on ERs for the projects.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards.

**System associated activities:**

* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of systems related to creation of specifications (e.g. SAP) as may be required. Report gaps, roadblocks or findings and support on finding solutions and help facilitate closure with IT SMEs

Qualifications

* Bachelors degree in Food Engineering, Food Safety, Food Technology, Food Science and Microbiology, or adjacent subjects. MS is desired.
* Min. 2-3 years of experience on Regulatory, QA/QC, Food Analytical experience or other Food related FMCG in a technical role; 1-2 years of which on Product Development or Specification Writing.
* Well-versed on Microsoft Office and Excel.
* Effective communication skills, both verbal (i.e. presentation, conference calls) and written (i.e. reports, e-mails) in English.
* Confident and able to speak or present to senior leaders when needed.
* Learning agility, self-motivation and desire for continuous self-improvement.
* Team player and works well with cross-functional, cross-regional and cross-cultural teams.
* Can work independently and has initiative for problem solving

jobs.description:
WORK YOULL DO

As a Data Science Consultant/Senior Consultant within CS&D, you will deliver data-driven insights, actionable recommendations, and cutting-edge analytical solutions. Youll play a pivotal role in supporting clients commercial strategies with a blend of technical depth and strategic thinking.

1. **Data Science & Analytics Strategy**

* Design and implement data strategies aligned to business goals across pricing, sales, marketing, and product development.
* Integrate data science into cross-functional business workflows with teams from product, marketing, finance, and operations.
* Develop predictive models, ML algorithms, and advanced statistical methodologies (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, hierarchical clustering, Lasso/Ridge regression).
* Recommend best practices in data governance, quality, and integration.
* Build customer segmentation and clustering frameworks for tailored marketing and product strategies.

2. **Advanced Data Analysis & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct pricing and transaction-level analysis to identify optimization opportunities.
* Build financial models to assess pricing strategies impact on revenue and profitability.
* Track market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive benchmarks to inform client strategies.
* Execute campaign analytics, market-mix modelling (MMM), and conjoint / product affinity analyses to guide customer engagement efforts.

3. **Domain-Specific Data Solutions**

* Healthcare & Life Sciences: Predictive analytics for patient outcomes and clinical trial optimization.
* Sales & Marketing: ML-powered dynamic pricing and campaign optimization.
* Product Innovation: Data-driven decisioning in product design based on real-time customer insights.
* Consumer & Retail: Demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and customer loyalty analytics.
* Technology Sector: Predictive performance modeling and QA automation using AI.

4. **Advanced Analytics & Model Development**

* Build and optimize ML models for classification, regression, clustering, and recommendation systems.
* Use NLP and deep learning (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) to derive insights from unstructured data.
* Maintain and recalibrate existing analytical models to ensure ongoing business relevance.

5. **AI Engineering & Emerging Tech**

* Design AI solutions integrated with agentic platforms, LLMs, and orchestration pipelines for intelligent automation.
* Apply concepts from AI engineering to productionize ML models and scale data pipelines using tools like **Apache Spark**, Hadoop, MLflow, and MLOps principles.
* Utilize cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy scalable AI solutions.

6. **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Align pricing and data strategies with C-suite objectives through collaborative workshops and executive presentations.
* Communicate complex analytical findings in business-friendly language.
* Educate clients on data science tools and methods to foster internal capability-building.

7. **Infrastructure & Technology Assessment**

* Evaluate clients' existing data and analytics maturity.
* Recommend advanced data platforms and scalable architectures.
* Lead deployment of new tools and ensure integration with enterprise systems.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Fulfillment
jobs.description:
**Mission**

* **Key missions of the position:**

* **Purchasing Management**: Managing purchase orders, monitoring deliveries, and coordinating with internal teams to keep operations running smoothly.
* **Use of Oracle ERP system** for all Business Tractions & **SCC (Supply Chain Connect)** for collaboration with Suppliers (PO Management, Promises & ASN)
* **Inventory Management**: Managing inventory levels according to Target to ensure INR Target & Turns are achieved.
* **Supplier Performance Management:** Ensure supplier is performing at desired level.
* **Cost Control** To manage logistics cost within Budget.
* **Improvement Initiatives** Ensure to take improvements initiative through CFT Collaboration.

**Measurement**

* S : 100% adherence to Safety Guideline. ZERO Damaged Pallets or Consignment receipt from suppliers.
* Q : Ensure NCMR parts are shipped back to supplier within 7 days. Rework of parts within 30 days.
* C : Meet Inventory Targets & Turns. No Excess Inventory & No Shortages.
* D : Supplier OTD >90%, OTP >96%
* P : Zero Line stoppage

  

**Responsibilities**

**Main responsibilities:**

**Project Souring Execution:**

* Review requisitions and convert them into purchase orders daily. Ensure >3 Days aging is ZERO. Any issue related to master data like ASL, SOB, Pricing etc. to be resolved with Sourcing and PO must be placed within 10 days for those cases. >10 Days ageing for whatsoever reason should be ZERO.
* Ensure PO acknowledgement & promise date from supplier through SCC (Supply Chain Connect Portal) for 100% of PO within 2 working days. Zero Exceptions. ASN all shipments.
* To take complete ownership of assigned Suppliers performance including OTD > 90%, OTP >96% , ZERO Documentation Error, 100% Compliance of Sharing Quality Documents with EACH shipment and improve overall delivery performance.
* Ensure to plan materials pick-up On Time with best route w.r.t. Cost and Delivery timeline to meet production requirements.
* Expedite Delivery when there is Pull In of demand or quality issue in Parts (NCMR, DMR) or stock adjustment etc.
* Share 2 months firm + 4 months to 18 months (depending on leadtime) forecast to supplier to plan long lead time parts & raw materials in advance.
* Conduct regular meetings with cross function team comprising Sourcing, SQE, QA, PPC, and Operations for resolving Open issues and ensure Delivery is not impacted for whatsoever reason.
* Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock and ensure given Inventory Target both in INR/ M$ and Turns are achieved. Take actions to control Inventory
* Ensure Sub-contract execution on time and ageing is less than 30 days.
* Ensure supplier stock and account reconciliation is performed on Quarterly basis and ZERO ageing issues >90 days. Any Tax related / Payment related issues to be closed within 30 days.
* Manage supplier relationships and resolve issues (damaged goods, incorrect shipments, invoice errors)
* Negotiate Safety Stock fill rate, Contract terms, lead times, and service levels with supplier. Support Localisation of Parts by Sourcing.
* Support Sourcing plan such as Make or buy, Localization and Transfer of Technology projects, dual sourcing.
* Ensure to share Daily, Weekly & Monthly KPI as per ask from Manager / Functional Heads.
* Work as a Team to ensure Organization level Goals are achieved.
* Participate in all CFT meeting, Gemba meeting, workshops to improve SPQCD.
* Ensure to adhere Safety, Quality & Compliance guidelines 100%

jobs.description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands **mCaffeine & Hyphen**. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is Indias first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. jobs.title: VP R&D Injectable Products
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Off Targets Research is building a pipeline of differentiated, complex injectable products for regulated markets, developed through the 505(b)(2) and complex-generic routes and out-licensed to commercial partners. The Vice President R&D, Formulation Development (Injectables) will own formulation and process development end to end, from product feasibility to technology transfer and regulatory submission.

This is an executive role. You will set the technical strategy for the function, decide which products and formulation approaches the company pursues, hold the function accountable for timelines, quality and regulatory success, and represent Off Targets technically with partners, CDMOs and regulators. You will remain close to the science and will lead from technical depth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and portfolio**

* Define the formulation development strategy for the complex injectable portfolio, including suspensions and nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal and lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, ready-to-use solutions and depot / long-acting injectables.
* Assess the technical feasibility, risk and commercial attractiveness of new product opportunities, and advise the CEO and Board on which to pursue, delay or drop.
* Design formulation approaches that are patent-aware and non-infringing, working with IP counsel on freedom-to-operate and carve-out strategy.
* Own the development plan, milestones and budget for the function, and report progress and risks to the CEO and Board.

**Technical leadership and execution**

* Lead preformulation, prototype development, optimisation, scale-up and exhibit batch execution for assigned programmes, either directly or through senior scientists.
* Apply QbD and risk-based approaches (CQAs, CPPs, DoE, control strategy) to formulation design, process understanding and troubleshooting.
* Resolve the hardest formulation and process problems, including stability failures, particle size and polymorph control, precipitation, injectability, reconstitution behaviour and process robustness.
* Make sound sterilisation and manufacturing-route decisions (aseptic, terminal, filtration, lyophilisation, container closure) and understand their effect on product quality and regulatory risk.
* Oversee technology transfer to pilot and commercial manufacturing sites and CDMOs, and challenge their execution where needed.

**Regulatory, quality and CMC**

* Own the formulation and process development sections of regulatory filings (including 3.2.P.2) and the scientific justification behind them, and lead responses to regulatory queries.
* Work with Analytical R&D, QA and Regulatory Affairs to align methods, specifications, characterisation, in-vitro performance testing and stability programmes.
* Set and uphold standards for documentation, data integrity, laboratory discipline and technical review across the function.

**Commercial and partner engagement**

* Lead the technical side of out-licensing, co-development and contract development discussions, including due diligence responses and partner presentations.
* Build and maintain relationships with CDMOs, CROs, technology providers and external experts.

**People and capability**

* Build, lead and mentor the formulation team, including senior scientists and managers, and develop the next level of leaders.
* Set the culture of the function: scientific rigour, accountability, speed and a bias for solving problems at the root.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Ph.D. in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline (strongly preferred), or M.Pharm / M.S. with an exceptional track record.

**Experience (must have)**

* 25 or more years in pharmaceutical R&D, with at least 20 years in injectable or sterile product development.
* A record of taking injectable products through to regulatory submission and approval in the US, preferably through 505(b)(2) or complex-generic routes.
* Hands-on depth in at least two complex dosage forms from: suspensions or nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal or lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, depot or long-acting injectables.
* Proven experience in scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing sites or CDMOs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in specialty pharma, complex-generic or injectable CDMO environments.
* Familiarity with patent landscapes and non-infringing formulation design.
* Exposure to licensing, partnering or technical due diligence.
* Experience working with regulators, including FDA meetings and deficiency responses.

**Leadership attributes**

* Technical authority that earns the respect of scientists and partners.
* Strong judgement under uncertainty, and the courage to give the CEO and Board a straight view.
* Clear written and spoken communication with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* High ownership, urgency and accountability for delivery.

**Why Join Off Targets**

* A senior role with direct access to the Chairman and CEO and real influence on which products the company develops.
* A pipeline of differentiated injectable products with commercial relevance, built for out-licensing to partners.
* Scientific rigour paired with speed and accountability, in a company small enough for a leader to shape how things are done.
* Competitive fixed compensation, together with a performance-linked incentive tied to out-licensing outcomes.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV to the contact provided with this description. All discussions are treated in confidence.

jobs.title: AM - Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To lead and manage the complete Quality Assurance and Quality Control function of a high-precision aerospace CNC manufacturing facility, ensuring compliance with AS9100D Rev. D, ISO 9001:2015, aerospace customer requirements, engineering drawings and applicable industry standards.

The candidate must possess strong practical experience in aerospace quality management systems, APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, Gauge R&R, CMM inspection, GD&T, AS9102 First Article Inspection, special process control and aerospace customer quality management.

The individual should be capable of independently handling customer quality audits, technical discussions, quality escalations and approval requirements.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Aerospace Quality Management System AS9100D Rev. D**

* Establish, implement, maintain and continuously improve AS9100D Rev. D Quality Management System.
* Ensure effective implementation of ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain Quality Manual, procedures, work instructions and quality records.
* Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits.
* Coordinate external certification audits, surveillance audits and customer audits.
* Manage NCR, CAPA, corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure risk-based thinking, operational risk management and continual improvement.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace customer-specific quality requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of the Quality Management System.

**B. APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning**

* Lead APQP activities for new aerospace product development.
* Prepare and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* Prepare and implement Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
* Develop and implement Control Plans.
* Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* Establish quality planning and inspection requirements for new components.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering for process validation.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality planning during NPI.
* Review and approve quality documentation before production release.

**C. MSA – Measurement System Analysis and Gauge R&R**

* Strong practical knowledge of Measurement System Analysis (MSA).
* Conduct and review Gauge R&R studies covering repeatability and reproducibility.
* Evaluate measurement system capability and suitability.
* Establish calibration and verification systems for measuring instruments.
* Understand measurement uncertainty, accuracy, precision and traceability.
* Ensure appropriate measuring instruments are selected for critical aerospace dimensions.
* Maintain calibration records and measuring instrument registers.
* Establish measurement system control for CMM and other precision inspection equipment.

**D. Dimensional Inspection and Advanced Metrology**

Must have strong practical knowledge of:

* CMM operation, programming and inspection methodology.
* Contour measuring instruments.
* Profile projectors.
* Height gauges, bore gauges and precision micrometers.
* Roundness and surface roughness measuring instruments.
* Digital and specialised precision measuring equipment.
* Calibration and measurement traceability.
* GD&T and complex engineering drawing interpretation.
* Datum structures, true position, profile, concentricity, runout and geometric tolerances.

Ensure inspection planning, first-off inspection, in-process inspection and final inspection of aerospace components.

**E. CNC Machining Quality and Process Inspection**

Experience in quality control and inspection of:

* CNC turning components.
* Twin-spindle CNC turn-mill components.
* 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milled components.
* CNC VTL components.
* Wire-Cut EDM components.
* Complex precision aerospace components with tight dimensional tolerances.

Ensure dimensional inspection reports are reviewed against customer drawings, specifications and approved inspection requirements.

**F. Aerospace Special Process Quality Management**

* Strong understanding of aerospace special process requirements.
* Control and monitor in-house and outsourced special processes.
* Experience with heat treatment, anodising, chemical conversion coating, plating, passivation and protective coatings.
* Knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) processes such as FPI, MPI, UT and radiography.
* Review special process certificates, test reports and process qualification records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace specifications and customer requirements.
* Coordinate special process supplier audits and approval requirements.
* Knowledge of NADCAP accreditation and special process supplier management will be a strong advantage.

**G. Aerospace Quality Documentation and First Article Inspection**

* Preparation and review of AS9102 First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR).
* Preparation and maintenance of APQP documentation.
* Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* PFMEA and Control Plans.
* Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* MSA and Gauge R&R reports.
* Dimensional inspection and CMM reports.
* Material traceability records and material test certificates.
* Special process certificates and qualification records.
* Non-Conformance Reports (NCR).
* Corrective Action Reports (CAR) and 8D reports.
* Calibration and measurement system records.
* Customer-specific quality documentation and approval records.

**H. Quality Tools and Continuous Improvement**

* Strong knowledge of 7 QC Tools.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Process Capability Analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp and Ppk).
* Root Cause Analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone.
* 8D Problem Solving.
* Risk Management and FMEA.
* Continuous improvement and defect prevention.
* Supplier Quality Management and supplier development.
* Reduction of internal and customer rejection.

**I. Supplier Quality Management**

* Monitor and improve supplier quality performance.
* Conduct supplier quality audits and process evaluations.
* Ensure raw material certifications and material traceability.
* Monitor outsourced special process suppliers.
* Handle supplier non-conformities and corrective actions.
* Ensure supplier compliance with aerospace customer requirements.
* Maintain approved supplier documentation and performance records.

**J. Aerospace Customer Handling and Quality Management**

* Strong experience in direct customer quality interactions with aerospace OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers.
* Independently handle customer quality audits, quality reviews and technical discussions.
* Handle customer complaints, NCRs, corrective actions and 8D reports.
* Coordinate customer FAI approvals and dimensional inspection documentation.
* Respond to customer queries related to GD&T, CMM, MSA, Gauge R&R, material traceability and special processes.
* Manage customer quality escalations and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Coordinate customer visits and represent the organisation during quality meetings.
* Ensure customer-specific quality requirements are understood and implemented across departments.

**Preferred Aerospace Customer Exposure:**

Airbus, Boeing, Honeywell Aerospace, GE Aerospace, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney, ISRO and HAL.

Experience working with their approved Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers will also be considered.

**K. Quality Team Management and Training**

* Lead and manage quality engineers, inspectors, CMM programmers and metrology personnel.
* Develop departmental responsibilities and competency matrices.
* Conduct training on AS9100D, GD&T, CMM, APQP, PFMEA, MSA and inspection methods.
* Develop employee technical competency and inspection skills.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality procedures across production and engineering.

.

**3. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience in aerospace, defence or high-precision manufacturing quality.
* Strong hands-on experience in AS9100D Rev. D implementation.
* Practical knowledge of APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA and Gauge R&R.
* Strong CMM, GD&T and precision metrology experience.

**Job Profile: Payer Modernization Healthcare Transformation & Analytics**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for professionals with experience in **healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics** to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.

Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:

* Healthcare Back Office Transformation
* Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
* Payer Analytics & Data Strategy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
* Assess existing processes and develop **process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations**.
* Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support transformation across payer functions such as **claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment**.
* Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
* Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
* Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing **risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity**.
* Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
* Use **GenAI** to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
* Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of payer workflows such as **claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management**.
* Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Experience working with complex datasets.
* Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.

**Preferred Knowledge & Experience**

* Understanding of **Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models**.
* Familiarity with **risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS**, and compliance-driven payer activities.
* Understanding of **Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)** concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.

* Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

* Predictive modeling and forecasting
* Healthcare analytics and data visualization

jobs.description:
**About Christel House: Christel House is a non-profit organization specializing in educating and transforming the lives**

**of impoverished children around the world. Towards this end, Christel House schools provide a robust K-12 education,**

**nutritious meals, a strong character development program, college & career support, and family assistance.**

  

**Job Title: Primary School Teacher**

  

**Job Overview: As a primary school teacher, you are responsible for nurturing the academic, social, and**

**emotional development of young children. You create a positive learning environment where students can**

**explore, learn, and grow. The role involves planning and delivering lessons, assessing student progress,**

**and collaborating with colleagues and parents to support each child's educational journey.**

  

**Main Roles &**

**Responsibilities: Specific duties and responsibilities of the Primary School Teacher will**

**include as follows, but will not be limited to the following**

**1. Curriculum Development and Implementation:**

  

**• Plan and prepare courses, schemes of work, and individual lesson plans tailored to students'**

**needs.**

**• Integrate subjects like EVS, literacy, and maths to create a comprehensive learning**

**experience.**

**• Employ diverse teaching methods such as storytelling, educational play, and media to**

**engage students effectively.**

**• Organize field trips aligned with the curriculum to provide hands-on learning experiences.**

**• Foster values and independent thinking among students through experiential learning.**

  

**2. Student Assessment and Support:**

  

**• Assess individual student progress through formative and summative assessments and**

**update the scores on the student information system (SIS) and Share point.**

**• Communicate with parents during parent-teacher meetings to understand students'**

**backgrounds and update parents on their progress.**

**• Analyse and provide oral/ written reports for FA & SA data along with Instructional Coach**

**and D.P to support student learning and growth.**

**• Collaborate and work with R.T.I ( Response to Intervention) and co-curricular teachers to**

**refine and implement an integrated curriculum.**

  

**3. Classroom Management and Environment:**

  

**• Ensure classrooms are safe, positive, and nurturing environments conducive to learning.**

**• Contribute to creating attractive displays throughout the class that align with the**

**curriculum.**

**• Model appropriate behaviour and communication while enforcing school rules and values.**

**• Supervise students during transitions, including walking with them to and from the dining**

**hall and during dispersal to ensure their safety and well-being.**

  

**4. Other Important tasks:**

**• Serve as a homeroom/ class teacher with responsibility, for the day-to-day pastoral care of**

**students.**

**• Attend meetings such as staff and departmental meetings.**

**• Carry out supervisory duties at assembly/lunch times.**

**• Attend workshops and support student functions outside of the regular school day.**

**• Serve on House duties and Committees, as required.**

**• Act as a substitution teacher for other teachers in the absence of a teacher or as per the need.**

**• Maintain regular attendance during all scheduled school days .**

**• Perform any additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.**

**• Create supplementary resources like charts and worksheets to enhance classroom learning.**

**• Participate in invigilation and evaluation duties as per the requirements.**

**• Prepare students for events like Sports days, Class assembly, Annual days, and STEM & Literary**

**Fests.**

**• Complete appraisal documents and submit them to the immediate Supervisor as part of**

**professional development requirements.**

**• Reflect on teaching practices and contribute to school-wide reviews of policies and aims.**

**• Keep accurate records of attendance, grades, and other relevant data.**

  

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

**• Bachelors Degree/Diploma degree in education**

**• Prior experience as a primary school teacher (preferable)**

**• Excellent understanding of the principles of child development and educational methods to teach**

**primary students.**

**• Excellent communication, instructional and storytelling skills .**

**• Well versed on how to use Microsoft Word, Excel and PPT.**

**• Patient, friendly and reliable**

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant - Commercial Analytics + AI Engineering
jobs.description:
ZS  is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here youll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

;

**Insights Analytics  ;**

**ZS's  Insights Analytics  group**    partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously,  leveraging  advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep  expertise  and thought leadership.  ;

  
  
 ****The role****    

A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 24 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.

This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.

;

**What  Youll    Do**  ;

* ****AI analytics engineering (~60%)****    
  + Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables metric layer signal detection LLM narrative application surface.
  + Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
  + Enforce guardrails in data and metadata governed tables, SQL-level scope control rather than in prompt instructions.
  + Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
  + Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
  + Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
  + Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked).  
    
   ****Core commercial analytics (~40%)****    
  + Take ambiguous questions from any client function commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
  + Pick the method the question needs diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation and defend the choice.
  + Work across the client's data estate syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
  + Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code one definition, every surface.
  + Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders.  
    
   ****Client team leadership****    
  + Plan, review and coach a team of 24; QC everything before it reaches the client.
  + Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
  + Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.

**;**  ;

**What  Youll  Bring**  ;

* A bachelors or masters degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
* 5 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
* **SQL expert.** Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
* **Python production-grade.** pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
* **Lakehouse platform** Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
* **LLM application engineering** Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
* **Applied analytics** solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* **Consulting skills.** Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
* **People leadership.** Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)

**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

* Paid time off

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Assistant Manager Quality Assurance (QA/QC)**
-----------------------------------------------

**Location:** Silvassa

**Department:** Quality Control (QC)

**Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E.

**Experience:** 710 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant Manager Quality Assurance to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities across manufacturing operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, process compliance, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality management and food safety standards, including ISO 9001 and FSSC 22000.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and oversee all Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and applicable quality and food safety standards.
* Handle customer and supplier quality requirements, complaints, and quality-related concerns.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and 8D problem-solving activities.
* Implement and monitor FMEA, the 7 QC Tools, and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Plan and conduct internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and product traceability audits.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
* Monitor and ensure effective implementation of Control Plans, PRP, OPRP, CCP, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Ensure proper functional testing, inspection, and validation of products and processes.
* Maintain quality documentation, inspection reports, test records, SOPs, and audit-related documents.
* Monitor product quality at incoming, in-process, and final inspection stages.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, R&D, and other departments to resolve quality-related issues.
* Ensure proper utilization, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory testing equipment.
* Develop and implement quality improvement plans to reduce rejection, customer complaints, and process deviations.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Job Title:** Production Manager- Sanitary Pads & Hygiene Products

**Location:** Pune

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Department:** Production/ Operations

**Reports To:** Managing Director

**CTC:** 10-15 LPA

**Direct reports**: Production, Maintenance & Engineering, Quality Assurance / Quality Control, Planning & Stores, EHS, Plant HR/Admin (via functional heads)

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Production volume vs plan, OEE and line efficiency

* Material yield and wastage percentage

* Cost per unit and conversion cost vs budget

* Quality metrics: customer complaints, rejection rate, audit findings

* On-time delivery and order fulfilment

* Safety performance (LTIFR, incidents) and compliance record

* Attrition, training hours and talent development
