jobs.title: Executive - Product Development
jobs.description:
**Designation:** EXECUTIVE
  
**Location:** India UTTAR PRADESH Noida
  
**Group:** DS Group
  
**Entity:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited
  
**SBU:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited
  
**Department:** PRODUCT AND TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT
  
**Function:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT LAB
  

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

**Job Title**: Chemical Engineer – Pilot Plant & Production

**Department**: Production / Pilot Plant

**Location**: Andheri East, MIDC

**Reports To**: Project Manager & Production Manager / Plant Head

**Experience**: 1–4 years

**Qualification**: B.E. / B.Tech/ M. Tech in Chemical Engineering

**Purpose of the Role**

To support the scale-up of processes from the R&D laboratory to the pilot plant, participate in the installation, inspection, commissioning and operationalization of process equipment, and thereafter supervise safe, efficient and compliant plant operations. The role is critical to achieving reliable output, yield, quality, safety, and cost targets during the transition from laboratory development to pilot-scale operations.

**Company Context**

We are scaling up a precious metal refining process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant. The process involves glass and glass-lined reactors, corrosive chemical systems, precious metal-bearing materials, and stringent requirements for containment, material recovery, safety, and traceability.

**Key Responsibilities-**

**Pilot Plant Installation & Commissioning**

* Actively participate in the scale-up process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant.
* Review equipment specifications, layouts, P&IDs, utility requirements, and material-of-construction suitability against process requirements.
* Verify that installed process equipment meets design, process, safety, and quality requirements.
* Participate in pre-commissioning checks such as inspection, leak testing, calibration verification, utility readiness, instrumentation checks, and trial runs.
* Support commissioning, start-up, stabilization, and performance testing of pilot-plant systems.
* Identify installation gaps, equipment issues, or process deviations and coordinate corrective actions with engineering, vendors, maintenance, and R&D teams.
* Prepare and maintain commissioning documentation, equipment logs, SOPs, batch records, and operating instructions.

**Pilot Plant Operations & Supervision**

* Plan, supervise, and execute daily pilot-plant operations as per approved batch sheets, SOPs, and production schedules.
* Operate and supervise reactor systems, ensuring correct procedures and SOPs are followed
* Monitor critical process parameters and take timely corrective action where required.
* Ensure safe handling and transfer of chemicals in the process streams.
* Maintain accurate batch records, production logs, raw-material consumption records, metal accounting inputs, and daily pilot-plant reports.
* Coordinate with R&D, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, EHS, and Dispatch to ensure smooth material flow and minimal downtime.
* Troubleshoot process deviations, equipment issues, and quality concerns; conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Optimize yield, reduce process losses, improve equipment utilization, and support recovery of valuable materials.
* Train and supervise operators and technicians on safe operating procedures, glassware handling, emergency response and process controls.

**Safety, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure strict adherence to EHS requirements, statutory regulations, pollution-control norms, PPE discipline, and safe work practices.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling and disposal of hazardous chemicals, process residues, and waste streams.
* Support risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, and management-of-change activities for new or modified equipment and processes
* Participate in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, customer, and safety audits; close audit observations within defined timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, 5S, Kaizen, and structured troubleshooting initiatives.
* Support new-product trials, process validation, scale-up studies, and technology transfer from R&D to pilot plant.

**Required Skills**

* Strong fundamentals of chemical engineering, including mass and energy balance, fluid flow, heat transfer, reaction engineering, and process instrumentation.
* Hands-on understanding of pilot-plant and production equipment and associated piping and utilities.
* Practical knowledge of installation checks, commissioning activities, equipment trials, and plant start-up.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, equipment drawings, SOPs, batch sheets, and technical specifications.
* Understanding corrosive chemical handling, hazardous-process safety, containment, and emergency procedures.
* Familiarity with precious-metal processing will be an advantage.
* Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.
* Good documentation, coordination, problem-solving, and team-supervision skills.
* Willingness to work at the plant site and support shift-based pilot-plant operations when required.

**Senior Software Engineer Specialist**

**Esko | Veralto Corporation** **Location:** Bangalore, India – Hybrid

**About the Role**

**The Opportunity**

We're seeking a Software Engineer Specialist to design, build, and deliver artwork automation and structured content solutions for WebCenter. In this hands-on role, you'll independently own features that connect structured content and artwork workflows with Adobe InDesign and related creative applications. The emphasis is on JavaScript/TypeScript, React interfaces, and API integration, working closely with Adobe integration engineers on the complete user workflow. You'll apply sound engineering judgment and help the team adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is an opportunity to deepen your technical skills and grow your career at the intersection of creative technology and purposeful engineering.

You'll work closely with product managers, architects, UX designers, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions. Success in this role means delivering complex features predictably, improving quality measurably, and becoming a trusted technical resource for the team within 12–18 months.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, test, and maintain WebCenter artwork automation and structured content capabilities, with emphasis on **JavaScript/TypeScript, React interfaces, and API integration**; contribute to **Adobe InDesign scripting** and integration workflows as you build domain knowledge, collaborating on **Java/J2EE services** as needed.
* Own and deliver complex features, enhancements, and technical initiatives independently from requirements clarification and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and follow-up; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks proactively.
* Translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-quality technical solutions for artwork automation and structured content workflows, preserving content accuracy and traceability from source content to generated artwork.

* Design reliable integrations and automation with clear API/data contracts, input validation, actionable error reporting, and safe handling of timeouts, retries, and partial failures; consider performance, security, and compatibility across supported application versions.
* Work with UX designers and domain experts to deliver clear, usable artwork and content-editing workflows; test content mapping and generated outputs against representative documents, templates, and edge cases.
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture and implementation decisions that drive long-term product health.
* Articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build shared understanding.
* Contribute to AI-powered application capabilities within WebCenter that improve artwork automation and structured content workflows where required by the product roadmap.
* Explore agent-based solutions, intelligent workflows, and AI-assisted product experiences where appropriate, in collaboration with architects and relevant specialists.
* Use approved AI-enabled development tools to assist with coding, test generation, refactoring, documentation, and investigation; independently review and validate outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and protection of proprietary or customer data.
* Support fellow engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing to build a high-performing team.
* Promote engineering best practices, continuous learning, maintainability, and software quality across the R&D organization.

**What We're Looking For**

**Minimum Qualifications**

*These are the must-have requirements for the role:*

* Proven, substantial hands-on experience in front-end web or full-stack software development, including production React applications, with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering and maintaining complex features in an established software product.
* Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, including component design, state management, and asynchronous user-interface development; ability and willingness to learn Adobe ExtendScript and InDesign integration. Prior Adobe application or scripting experience is not required.
* Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming, modular design, error handling, and debugging; sound software design principles and practical understanding of HTTP, browser behaviour, and client/server interactions.
* Experience integrating web applications with external systems through HTTP/REST APIs, including authentication, data exchange, error handling, and troubleshooting across client/server boundaries; familiarity with automated testing, code reviews, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience translating UX designs into accessible, responsive, reusable UI components, including loading, empty, validation, and error states; ability to investigate browser performance and compatibility issues.
* Proven ability to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions across the full software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex defects using logs, browser developer tools, debugging, and profiling; improve existing code safely through automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, regression protection, and incremental refactoring.
* Proven ability to write maintainable JavaScript scripts or automation and adapt solutions across different scripting runtimes.
* Ability to take ownership under ambiguity, clarify requirements, make proportionate technical decisions, and escalate risks early while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to clearly articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

*These skills will set candidates apart:*

* Proven hands-on technical experience with Adobe Creative Cloud applications, especially InDesign, including ExtendScript scripting and Adobe application APIs/object models; experience with InDesign Server integration is also valuable.
* Experience with InDesign Server automation and APIs, Adobe Illustrator, or Adobe extensibility frameworks such as CEP and/or UXP, with awareness of host-application and version compatibility.

jobs.description:
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
--------------------------

**Jubilant Bhartia Group**

Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 56,000 employees.

**Jubilant Pharmova Limited**
-----------------------------

Jubilant Pharmova Limited (formerly Jubilant Life Sciences Limited) is a company with global presence that is involved in Radiopharma, Allergy Immunotherapy, CDMO Sterile Injectables, Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO), Generics and Proprietary Novel Drugs businesses.

In the Radiopharma business, the Company is involved in manufacturing and supply of Radiopharmaceuticals with a network of 46 radio-pharmacies in the US. The Company’s Allergy Immunotherapy business is involved in the manufacturing and supply of allergic extracts and venom products in the US and in some other markets such as Canada, Europe and Australia. Jubilant through its CDMO Sterile Injectables business offers manufacturing services including sterile fill and finish injectables (both liquid and lyophilization), full-service ophthalmic offer (liquids, ointments & creams) and ampoules.

The CRDMO business of the Company includes the Drug Discovery Services business that provides contract research and development services through two world-class research centres in Bangalore and Noida in India and the CDMO-API business that is involved in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients. Jubilant Therapeutics is involved in Proprietary Novel Drugs business and is an innovative biopharmaceutical company developing breakthrough therapies in the area of oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six manufacturing facilities that cater to all the regulated market including USA, Europe and other geographies.

**The Position**
----------------

**Job** **Summary****:**

The Project Financial Analyst supports financial governance, risk management, and cost control for pharmaceutical R&D and CapEx projects, including manufacturing and equipment sourcing. This role manages multi-million-dollar budgets, ensures timely execution, and provides strategic financial analysis and reports to senior leadership. Serving as the primary financial partner to Project Managers, Engineering, Clinical Development, and Operations globally, the analyst supports financial discipline and data-driven decisions. They also collaborate with CMOs for expenditure accounting during projects.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Maintain baseline budgets during development and construction and enforce change controls to prevent unauthorized spending
* Conduct monthly variance analysis comparing actual costs to budgets and adjust for timing, price, scope, or inefficiencies
* Assist in cost estimates and tracking for new and multi-year projects while maintaining SAP records
* Update rolling cash flow and Estimate at Completion (EAC) forecasts and monitor cost and schedule performance
* Identify financial risks early and create dashboards with KPIs to alert teams and management
* Present monthly and quarterly variance reports explaining financial impacts of delays

* Monitor contractor billings, equipment, and vendor costs to prevent cost overruns
* Oversee Construction in Progress (CIP) account tracking and transition to fixed assets
* Provide monthly reports on profitability, cash flow, and R&D tax credits
* Support procurement in managing vendor agreements, change orders, and invoice compliance
* Manage SAP transactions to ensure spending remains within approved limits

* Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar).

**Experience:** 6–8+ Years  
**Position:** Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Food / FMCG / Food Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

**5. Team & Department Coordination**

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
POSITION VACANCY
  
  
Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness
  
  
POSITION SNAPSHOT
  
  
Company: Nestlé
  
  
Location: Dubai - HQ
  
  
**Position Summary**
Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.
  
  
As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.
  
  
A DAY IN THE LIFE …
  
  

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.
* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.
* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.
* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.
* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.
* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.
* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.
* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…
  
  

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)
* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.
* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.
* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.
* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.
* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.
* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.
* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.
* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.title: Senior Packaging Development and Industrialization Director
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Senior Director of Packaging leads the Packaging pole of Product Operations: Packaging Development & Industrialization, and a new Packaging R&D capability. This role owns the technical packaging solution from brief to production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, moves technical risk upstream through risk-based pilots and evidence, and builds proven, PPWR-ready platforms for future launches. It works with an independent End-to-End Quality team.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Packaging Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own the packaging technical strategy and roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Lead two sub-poles, Development & Industrialization and Packaging R&D, through strong leads with clear decision rights.
* Protect R&D time and budget from live-launch pressure; escalate trade-offs to the VP, Product Operations.
* Size the team from real workload and portfolio data.

**Packaging Development & Industrialization**

* Own the technical delivery of every launch, from brief to PPS.
* Run risk-based pathways, set from the 1 to 5 risk score and confirmed by Quality.
* Secure pilot molds and homologation before production tooling for new, high-risk packs.
* Lead drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, functional analysis, DFMA and formula/pack compatibility.
* Own tooling validation, line trials, PPS and scale-up readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers.

**Packaging R&D & Innovation**

* Build and lead Packaging R&D: platforms and technology, advanced development and innovation, Kaizen.
* Build a library of proven packs, supplier standards, design rules and test files.
* Lead technical and experience sourcing.
* Hand concepts over to development only once proven.

**Sustainability & PPWR**

* Own the packaging sustainability roadmap, balancing consumer experience, brand, cost and regulation.
* Lead PPWR readiness for new launches and the existing portfolio, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Set clear ownership: R&D builds PPWR-ready solutions, Development applies them in each launch, Regulatory and Legal advise on compliance.
* Prioritize changes to existing packs by risk and business impact, with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Technical Governance & Risk Ownership**

* Adapt assessments to project risk, with clear ownership, evidence and approval at each checkpoint.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for the Product Operations gates: Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation, Go Prod.
* Own packaging specifications and drive the adoption of the internal specification tool.
* Never trade an unresolved critical risk for cost or timing; any skipped step goes to the Newness Committee.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.
* Respect Quality's independent co-signature of homologation and its ownership of release and CAPA.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging developers, engineers and R&D specialists.
* Recruit and grow sub-pole leads; build succession for critical technical roles.
* Act as a role model for technical rigor and evidence-based decisions.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Commercial and Finance.
* Bring feasibility, cost, timing and risk input at the brief, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Represent Packaging at the Newness Committee and in launch readiness reviews.
* Drive value engineering and COGS improvement without trading critical risk; manage the packaging technical budget

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of complex primary packs from concept through tooling, line trials and scale-up at suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Deep expertise in materials, processes, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and formula/pack compatibility.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, homologation and stage-gate governance.
* Experience building a pre-development, R&D or platform program.
* Proven leader of leaders, delegating through clear decision rights.
* Able to read and challenge CAD models and technical drawings.
* Solid understanding of packaging sustainability and the EU PPWR, and their impact on design, cost and supply.
* Experience with global supplier bases in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of evidence-based judgment, comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 15+ years in packaging development and industrialization, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.description:
**About Gradiant**

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at www.gradiant.com.

**Job Overview**

* Own and lead the development of Gradiant’s mineral extraction technologies from laboratory concept through pilot validation, scale-up and commercial deployment, covering extraction, purification, concentration and conversion to the final products.
* Set the technical direction across extraction routes (e.g. sorbents/ion exchange, solvent extraction, membranes, precipitation/crystallization), lead the R&D team, and serve as the technical authority for customers, partners and internal project teams.

**Specific Duties/Responsibilities**

*Technology strategy and roadmap*

* Define and own the technology roadmap for mineral extraction, purification and conversion, aligned with business and market needs.
* Benchmark competing technologies, evaluate new chemistries (sorbents, extractants, membranes) and partner technologies, and drive IP generation.

*Lead R&D team and manage projects*

* Lead and mentor the R&D team across SG and AD Labs (scientists, engineers and interns); set priorities and guide experimental design and data analysis.
* Oversee planning, budgets, execution and tracking of projects and procurement; liaise with vendors, contractors and internal groups; prepare key presentations and reports for leadership.

*Process development and flowsheet design*

* Develop and optimize mineral extraction flowsheets for high recovery and selectivity over competing ions (e.g. Na, K, Mg, Ca, B), including impurity control, reagent/solvent management and recycle streams.
* Perform process modelling, mass and energy balances and techno-economic inputs to produce high-purity final product.

*Scale-up and technology transfer*

* Lead the progression from lab and bench scale to pilot and demonstration; design, procure and commission pilot units.
* Resolve scale-up challenges (e.g. phase separation, solvent loss, sorbent lifetime, fouling, impurity build-up, process stability) and prepare process design packages for engineering and project teams.

*Commercialization and customer support*

* Lead end-to-end application studies on real feeds (brines, produced water, leachates) from feasibility through process validation.
* Support proposals, feasibility studies and performance guarantees; provide on-site commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization at customer plants.

*Partnerships and stakeholder engagement*

* Build and manage collaborations with customers, technology providers, universities and suppliers to accelerate technology validation and deployment.
* Represent Gradiant’s mineral extraction technology in technical discussions with customers, partners and at industry forums.

**Qualification, Skills & Experience**

*Qualification*

* Ph.D. in Chemical or Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Hydrometallurgy, Materials Science or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree with a strong industrial critical-minerals track record will also be considered.

*Skills*

* Deep expertise in at least one mineral extraction route (solvent extraction, ion exchange/adsorption, membranes or precipitation/crystallization), with working knowledge of the others.
* Process modelling and flowsheet design (mass/energy balances; tools such as Aspen, OLI or PHREEQC) and analytical methods (ICP-OES/MS, IC).
* Strong leadership, communication and customer-facing skills; able to translate technical results into business decisions.

*Experience*

* 10+ years in critical-minerals process development, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
* Proven track record taking a technology from lab through pilot to commercial or industrial operation.
* Hands-on experience in plant commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization, and in technology transfer to engineering or customers.
* Experience with industrial water/wastewater treatment and international customers is an advantage.

*Certificate*

* Preferred, not mandatory: Professional Engineer (PE/P.Eng), PMP, Lean Six Sigma or equivalent.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Key Responsibility Areas:**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.
* Develop and execute an overarching marketing AOP that delivers on the brand’s strategic objectives across the geography.

**Market Windows & Execution Excellence: Own the local calendar, end to end**

* Own the planning and execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market (e.g. Ramadan, Eid, National Days, summer, back-to-school and key sporting and cultural moments), tailoring offer, price and communication to each market.
* Deliver flawless, on-time launches from concept to restaurant, covering product readiness, supply, training, POS, digital and aggregator activation, and close gaps with speed and minimal escalation.
* Run a disciplined launch cadence with clear timelines, owners and post-launch reviews; read results fast, fix what is not working and scale what is.
* Maintain a strong, hands-on presence in markets and restaurants to ensure plans land as intended and learnings are captured and shared across markets.

**Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and get things done**

* Drive cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders, including but not limited to the Franchisor, country GMs and Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Procurement and other business units, to deliver cohesive and impactful NPD and market initiatives.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with country leadership teams; balance regional consistency with local market needs and negotiate trade-offs to land the best outcome for the brand.
* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Continue to deliver industry-leading financial outcomes.
* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.
* Work with cross-functional teams to build a strong data- and learning-based marketing investment culture.

**Insights and Analytics: Role-model the use of data, while staying curious to spot trends that future-proof the brand**

* Use consumer research programs to refine the consumer model, conduct competitor analysis, track consumer habits and initiate product improvements to meet market needs.
* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.
* Be a flag bearer for Americana’s purpose, vision and strategy, instilling an ownership mindset and a bias for action.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 10–15 years of marketing leadership experience.
* Experience in QSR or retail is a must-have.
* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.

jobs.title: Packaging Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Manager, Packaging Development leads the Packaging Development & Industrialization team of Product Operations. This role owns the technical delivery of every packaging launch, from brief to PPS and production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, so each launch is safe, on time and proven. It applies risk-based pathways, runs pilot-first development for new high-risk packs, and decides on evidence, not on supplier statements.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Launch Portfolio Delivery**

* Own the technical delivery of the packaging launch portfolio, from brief to PPS.
* Review briefs early and give feasibility, cost, timing and risk input, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, risk and capacity.
* Personally lead a selected set of the most complex, high-risk launches.
* Escalate early any risk to launch date, quality or cost, with facts and options.

**Risk-Based Development & Evidence**

* Classify each project at the brief by what is new and its 1 to 5 risk score; propose the pathway (Fast Lane, Targeted, Full Pilot-First) for confirmation by Quality.
* For new, high-risk packs, run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests and line trials on pilot parts before any production mold.
* Prepare the evidence for the Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation and GO PROD gates.
* Apply Specifications checkpoints in proportion to risk, with an owner, evidence and sign-off for each.
* Define the test strategy and acceptance criteria with Quality.

**Packaging Engineering**

* Own drawings, critical dimensions, GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Lead functional analysis, DFMA, decoration feasibility and formula/pack/process compatibility.
* Use proven platforms and supplier standards from Packaging R&D wherever they fit.
* Keep approved specifications up to date in Specright.

**Industrialization & CM Readiness**

* Lead tooling strategy and mold validation (T0 to T3) with suppliers.
* Confirm supplier and CM technical capability at the Tech Assessment.
* Organize and attend line trials; secure PPS on the final formula.
* Manage technical changes, deviations and concessions through change control, with Quality.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging engineers and developers.
* Set clear ownership, standards and a regular project review cadence.
* Keep the project portfolio data accurate, as the basis for capacity decisions.
* Feed lessons learned into specifications, design rules and Kaizen priorities.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain and Regulatory.
* Give technical input on supplier choices; Procurement leads RFQs and negotiation.
* Represent Packaging Development in launch reviews and at the Newness Committee when required.
* Contribute to value engineering and COGS savings without trading critical risk.

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of primary packs (e.g., mascara, gloss, compacts, closures, pumps) from brief to production at external suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Strong command of technical drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and injection molding.
* Hands-on experience of mold validation, line trials, PPS and packaging test methods.
* Solid knowledge of formula/pack compatibility and filling and assembly processes.
* Experience leading or coaching packaging engineers.
* Able to review CAD models (SolidWorks or similar) and run a portfolio in a project tool (Asana or similar).
* Able to travel to suppliers and contract manufacturers in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of structured, evidence-based delivery, staying calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 8+ years in packaging development, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

**Scientific Engagement Manager**
---------------------------------

**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.**  
**To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.

This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.

The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.

**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**

This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

**Role duties and accountabilities**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
