jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Product Engineer, Gaming

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

**About:**

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**
who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

**The Role:**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

**What You'll Do:**

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**
  : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**
  : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**
  You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and present ideas effectively.

* Highly organized with attention to detail and the ability to meet tight deadlines.
* Analytical, with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong problem-solving skills and proactive in identifying solutions.

**Why Join MARS Cosmetics?**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to be part of an innovative, fast-growing global brand.
* A creative and dynamic work environment with room for growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative team culture focused on passion, innovation, and personal development.

If you are passionate about driving innovation in the beauty industry and have a strong track record in new product development, we encourage you to apply and join MARS Cosmetics in shaping the future of beauty.

Please submit your resume along with a cover letter outlining your experience, qualifications, and why you would be a great fit for this role to careers@marscosmetics.in

jobs.description:
**Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)**  
JOB DESCRIPTION | SECURITY L3 | Technical Service Delivery & Engineering | Hyderabad Service Delivery Center  
**Company:** Palmiq  
**Palmiq Role:** Senior IT Support Specialist - Security Operations Center (L3)  
**Department:** Technical Service Delivery & Engineering  
**Reporting To:** Service Delivery Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Role Category:** Engineering  
**Industry Type:** Emerging Technologies (SOC, Compliance & Cloud)  
**Experience:** 4-6 Years (Min. 3+ yrs hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview & Compliance)  
**Compensation:** INR 10 LPA - INR 18 LPA (commensurate with L3 experience)  
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (Remote initially; in-person at HYD office next year)  
**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Palmiq is seeking a hands-on **Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)** to serve as the senior technical escalation point across our managed enterprise clients. This role sits at the intersection of **Microsoft 365 & AI Data Governance (Purview/Copilot), Regulatory Compliance (CMMC/HIPAA/NIST/CIS), Identity & Endpoint Security, SecOps (SIEM/XDR), Network Security (Fortinet), and Cloud Migrations**. You will lead complex client security remediations and incident response, mentor L1/L2 engineers, and partner with Service Delivery leadership on technical scoping, Statements of Work (SOWs), security architecture reviews, and executive reporting.  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**1. Data Security, Microsoft Purview & AI Governance**

* Design, deploy, optimize, and troubleshoot **Microsoft Purview** policies, including custom Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling policies (using sensitive information types/identifier formats), **Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**, and **Insider Risk Management**.
* Implement and enforce **data protection lifecycle controls**, including encryption in-transit and at-rest, data retention policies, legal holds, and purge workflows.
* Lead **Microsoft 365 Copilot security and readiness** engagements - disabling external web search where required, blocking Copilot from summarizing labeled sensitive files or accepting restricted prompts, and validating audit logging and retention.
* Audit and remediate **SharePoint and Teams oversharing** by removing company-wide/"everyone" access and enforcing strict named-user sharing defaults.

**2. GRC & Regulatory Compliance (CMMC, HIPAA, NIST & CIS)**

* Execute technical remediation activities aligned with **CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls** across regulated client environments.
* Establish repeatable compliance procedures, perform quality assurance (QA) checks, conduct **periodic access reviews**, re-run readiness assessments, and compile audit-ready compliance evidence packs for client handover.

**3. Identity, Endpoint Security & SecOps**

* Enforce **IAM/RBAC**, least-privilege access, **Privileged Access Management (PAM)**, and **Zero Trust principles** across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (hybrid identity) environments.
* Manage and enforce device security baselines via **Microsoft Intune** and **Entra ID Conditional Access** - ensuring corporate devices are enrolled, encrypted, and compliant while restricting unmanaged/personal devices to browser-only access with no downloads.
* Drive continuous **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM)**, structured patch cadence, endpoint/infrastructure security hardening, and **SIEM/XDR operations** (including audit log integrity, threat triage, and KQL-based investigations).
* Build and maintain security automation scripts and workflows using **PowerShell** (and optionally Python or Logic Apps) to streamline bulk M365, Intune, and Purview remediations.

**4. Network Security & Firewall Administration**

* Administer, configure, and troubleshoot **Fortinet (FortiGate) firewalls** and enterprise/cloud network security controls for managed and regulated clients.
* Lead cross-client firewall patching to established quality standards and manage **wireless access point (WAP) certificate updates**.

**5. Cloud Migrations & Workspace Hardening**

* Execute end-to-end **Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace** mailbox and file migrations, including post-migration validation, final delta synchronization, and confirmation of data accessibility and completeness.
* Perform **Google Workspace security hardening**, including configuring Organizational Units (OUs), access controls, MFA enforcement, security alerts, and Gmail security protections.

**6. L3 Escalation, Incident Response, ITSM & Technical Project Delivery**

* Serve as the senior **L3 escalation and de-escalation point** across all clients, including structured on-call support for L1/L2 teams.
* Lead major security incidents (containment, eradication, and recovery), develop **incident response playbooks**, and support client tabletop drills.
* Drive **ITIL v4 Change Enablement** (ensuring rollback plans before critical changes and acting as change manager where required) and **Problem Management** (leading Post-Incident Reviews, Root Cause Analysis, and Knowledge Base linking).
* Mentor and train L1/L2 engineers on firewall standards, security best practices, and compliance execution.
* Partner with Service Delivery leadership to conduct initial client assessments, perform security architecture reviews, author technical **Statements of Work (SOWs)**, and deliver structured end-of-project reports and executive dashboards for senior leadership.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related technical field preferred).
* **Domain Experience:** 4-6 years of overall IT/cybersecurity experience, with at least 3+ years of hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview, and Compliance delivery (multi-client MSP or enterprise consulting experience strongly valued).
* **Compliance & GRC:** Practical working knowledge of CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls, including technical remediation, periodic access reviews, and audit evidence gathering.
* **Cloud & Migrations:** Proven experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration, security hardening, and cross-platform migrations.
* **Consulting & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to conduct security architecture reviews, author technical SOWs, produce executive reports, and de-escalate high-priority client issues.

**EXPECTED EXPERTISE (TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES)**  
**Required Expertise - Core Operational Stack**

* **Microsoft 365, Data & Endpoint Governance:** Deep hands-on expertise in **Microsoft Purview** (Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling, DLP, Insider Risk, Retention/Legal Hold), **Microsoft Intune**, **Entra ID Conditional Access**, Active Directory/Entra ID hybrid identity, SharePoint/Teams permissions, and M365 Copilot governance.
* **SIEM & Querying:** Hands-on proficiency operating and investigating security events across **Microsoft Sentinel** and enterprise **SIEM platforms (Splunk / ELK)**, including writing **Kusto Query Language (KQL)** queries for log correlation, alert tuning, and threat hunting.
* **EDR / XDR:** Operational expertise in **EDR / XDR** platforms - specifically **Microsoft Defender XDR** - for endpoint and cloud threat triage, containment, and root cause analysis.
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM):** Practical experience implementing and governing **PAM** controls (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID PIM, CyberArk, or equivalent) alongside IAM/RBAC and Zero Trust enforcement.
* **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM):** End-to-end **VAM** execution, covering continuous vulnerability discovery, prioritization, structured patching, and remediation verification.
* **Firewalls & Perimeter Security:** Proven hands-on experience managing **Firewalls** - specifically **Fortinet (FortiGate)** - covering VPNs, policy management, firmware patching, and certificate adm

**About the Role**

  

Indurkar Consulting Engineers is looking for an experienced and technically proficient Lead Structural Engineer to independently lead structural engineering projects from conceptual design through detailed design and drawing deliverables.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in structural analysis and design, particularly in seismic and wind engineering, along with the ability to independently manage projects, coordinate with multidisciplinary consultants and guide the technical execution of projects.

  

**Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Structural Engineering from a reputed institute.
* BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

  

**Experience & Technical Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in structural engineering consultancy.
* Proven experience in non-infrastructure structural engineering projects, particularly residential, commercial and hospitality developments.
* Excellent understanding of relevant Indian Standard (IS) Codes.
* Strong expertise in:

+ Seismic Analysis and Design.
+ Wind Load Analysis and Design.
+ RCC Structural Design.
+ Steel Structural Design.
+ Structural Modelling, Analysis and Interpretation.

* Proficiency in ETABS, SAFE, AutoCAD and other relevant structural engineering tools.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Structural Analysis & Design**

* Independently undertake structural analysis and design of building projects.
* Develop and review structural design calculations, reports and engineering solutions.
* Perform seismic and wind load analysis in accordance with applicable codes.
* Ensure technical accuracy and compliance with relevant design standards.

**2. Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead and independently manage assigned structural engineering projects.
* Plan design activities, deliverables and project timelines.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Review and approve design calculations and structural drawings before transmittal.

**3. Coordination & Technical Management**

* Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, geotechnical consultants and other stakeholders.
* Resolve structural design-related coordination issues.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior engineers and design team members.
* Participate in technical discussions and client coordination meetings.

**4. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure consistency between structural analysis, design calculations and issued drawings.
* Conduct detailed technical reviews and implement quality control procedures.
* Take ownership of the technical quality of project deliverables.

**5. Business Development Support**

* Support the Business Development Manager by providing technical input on new enquiries and project opportunities.
* Review tender documents, RFPs and client briefs to define structural scope, design requirements and technical risks.
* Prepare technical proposals, scope of work, man-hour estimates and fee inputs for review by the BD Manager.
* Attend client meetings, technical presentations and pre-bid discussions alongside the BD team as the technical lead.
* Build strong working relationships with clients through dependable technical delivery, so the firm wins repeat business and referrals.
* Identify scope changes during project execution and give the BD Manager the technical basis for variation and additional-fee requests.
* Share client feedback and market insights from projects with the BD team.

  

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong technical expertise with excellent engineering fundamentals.
* Exceptional understanding of seismic and wind engineering.
* Ability to independently handle projects with minimal supervision.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to lead, mentor and guide a team of structural engineers.
* Strong ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

  

**Important:** This is a full-time, work-from-office opportunity. Work from home is not available.

jobs.title: AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description: AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are seeking an AI-aware Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist to develop high-quality marketing content, strengthen brand positioning, and improve visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

The candidate will coordinate with internal teams, industry experts, and subject-matter specialists to collect business information, customer testimonials, case studies, product insights, research inputs, and technical information. These inputs must be transformed into clear, engaging, fact-checked, and approved marketing materials.

The role involves industrial article writing, expert interviews, email newsletters, LinkedIn content, AI search visibility monitoring, brand messaging consistency, content reporting, and preparation of authoritative brand information for appropriate online platforms.

The ideal candidate should combine excellent writing and reporting skills with practical knowledge of AI-assisted content workflows, SEO, and emerging AI search and answer engines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Internal Marketing Coordination & Content Development**

* Coordinate with internal teams, including Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations, to collect marketing information and supporting materials.
* Obtain customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, product information, technical insights, research findings, and business updates.
* Convert internal inputs into usable marketing assets, including website content, articles, brochures, newsletters, social media posts, presentations, and sales-support materials.
* Conduct follow-ups with responsible team members to obtain missing information, supporting documents, evidence, and approvals.
* Maintain a structured content repository containing source materials, drafts, approved versions, publication links, and supporting references.
* Ensure all marketing materials are reviewed and approved by the designated authority before publication.

**B. AI-Assisted Content Creation & Quality Assurance**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other relevant platforms for research assistance, content structuring, drafting, editing, summarization, and content repurposing.
* Convert technical and industry-specific information into accurate, readable, audience-appropriate content.
* Develop reusable AI prompts, content templates, and workflows to improve productivity and consistency.
* Fact-check AI-generated content against reliable sources and approved company information.
* Verify statistics, scientific claims, quotations, references, and regulatory statements before publication.
* Ensure AI-generated content is original, useful, natural, and aligned with the brand's expertise and tone.
* Avoid fabricated testimonials, unsupported claims, invented citations, and unverified AI-generated answers.
* Maintain records of source materials, fact-checking, editorial reviews, and content approvals.

**C. Industrial Articles & External Publications**

* Research and write articles for relevant industrial magazines, trade publications, industry portals, and professional publications.
* Identify suitable publications and prepare content pitches, article proposals, author profiles, and submission emails.
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts to obtain technical inputs, industry perspectives, and supporting evidence.
* Translate expert knowledge into authoritative articles, explainers, opinion pieces, and thought-leadership content.
* Track editorial submissions, acceptance status, revisions, publication dates, and published links.
* Ensure that external articles meet the publication's editorial guidelines and preserve the company's approved positioning.

**D. Expert Coordination & Interviews**

* Identify relevant internal and external experts for interviews, expert commentary, technical articles, and thought-leadership campaigns.
* Coordinate interview schedules, prepare interview questions, collect background information, and manage follow-ups.
* Convert interviews, transcripts, and expert inputs into articles, Q&A features, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, and website content.
* Obtain expert review and approval for technical accuracy and publication consent where required.
* Maintain an expert database containing areas of expertise, interview records, approved quotations, and content opportunities.

**E. Email Newsletter Development**

* Plan and prepare periodic email newsletters for relevant audiences, including industry stakeholders, customers, partners, and professional networks.
* Collect approved updates from internal teams and convert them into concise, useful newsletter content.
* Develop newsletter subject lines, headlines, summaries, calls to action, and supporting links.
* Coordinate review, approval, scheduling, and distribution with the responsible marketing or email operations team.
* Monitor delivery, open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and other available performance metrics.
* Maintain consistent messaging and ensure mailing practices follow applicable privacy and consent requirements.

**F. LinkedIn & Brand Communication**

* Prepare and manage a content calendar for LinkedIn and other approved professional channels.
* Create posts, industry insights, article summaries, expert quotations, company updates, case-study highlights, and campaign content.
* Repurpose approved long-form content into short-form posts, carousels, newsletters, and other suitable formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to obtain relevant updates, visuals, data, and approvals.
* Maintain consistent brand voice, terminology, positioning, and visual-content coordination.
* Monitor engagement and use performance insights to improve future content.

**G. AI Search Visibility & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)**

* Monitor the brand's visibility and representation across AI-powered search and answer platforms, where measurable.
* Track relevant industry keywords, brand mentions, citations, source references, and the accuracy of AI-generated answers.
* Develop content that clearly answers relevant industry questions and demonstrates expertise, experience, authority, and trustworthiness.
* Create question-led articles, FAQs, expert explainers, comparison content, and evidence-backed educational resources.
* Improve content structure, factual clarity, source attribution, and entity consistency to support discoverability in traditional search and AI-generated answers.
* Record representative AI-generated answers for selected queries, identify missing or inaccurate brand information, and recommend corrective content improvements.
* Monitor conventional SEO performance through Google Search Console and other available analytics tools.
* Prepare periodic AI visibility reports using a consistent set of prompts, queries, platforms, and observation dates.

**Important:** AI answer visibility can fluctuate and cannot be guaranteed. Reporting should distinguish observed mentions and citations from estimated visibility, and should not treat a single AI response as proof of ranking or authority.

**H. Keyword & Content Performance Monitoring**

* Identify content gaps and new opportunities through keyword research, competitor analysis, industry questions, and customer-facing team inputs.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic impressions, clicks, engagement, referrals, and conversions where measurable.
* Review content performance regularly and recommend updates, new articles, or content consolidation where appropriate.

**Company Description**

* Good understanding of OECD GLP and global regulatory requirements, including SANCO, EPA, and FAO/WHO guidelines.
* Knowledge of data integrity, computer system validation, instrument qualification, and audit readiness.

**Qualifications**

**Preferred**

* Experience as a GLP Study Director or senior technical lead for Phy-chem GLP data package generation.

* Experience leading cross-functional projects and mentoring junior colleagues.

* Communicates complex scientific topics clearly to different stakeholders.
* Builds effective cross-functional relationships.
* Identifies risks early and solves problems proactively.

You will act as a problem-solver and team player, coordinating stakeholders, managing risk, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget. This role matters because it connects technical delivery to business outcomes, requiring a subject matter expert who can communicate complex concepts clearly, influence decisions, and foster collaboration to achieve shared goals.

* Act as a subject matter expert and lead for complex technical projects, providing guidance on project structure, delivery approach, and best practices for enterprise-scale solutions.
* Plan and prioritize work by translating organizational and segment goals into clear project roadmaps, milestones, and outcomes that align with Disney Experiences’ strategic objectives.
* Lead cross-functional, team-of-teams efforts across engineering, product, architecture, and business partners to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery throughout the project lifecycle.
* Anticipate and solve complex problems by identifying risks, issues, and dependencies early, and driving innovative, pragmatic solutions that keep projects on track.
* Build strong partnerships and collaborate across teams, facilitating productive discussions, negotiating trade-offs, and helping stakeholders adopt new perspectives when needed.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including scope, plans, RAID logs, timelines, budgets, and prioritization plans, ensuring transparency and traceability for all stakeholders.
* Monitor financials by reconciling actuals, updating forecasts, and communicating changes in budget and resource needs to leadership, supporting accurate cost management and governance.
* Lead project meetings and communication cadences, including status updates, dashboards, and executive presentations, to provide clear, data-driven storytelling on progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Train, mentor, and guide junior technical project managers and individual contributors, providing continuous coaching and feedback to elevate project management practices and team performance.
* Create an inclusive, team-oriented environment where Disney values are lived every day by encouraging creative problem solving, ensuring every voice is heard, and connecting individual contributions to team and business success.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 7 years of technical project/program management experience leading projects with technical teams developing enterprise-class solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise as a subject matter expert and lead on complex technology initiatives, with a strong track record as a problem-solver and team player in cross-functional environments.
* Proficiency with Agile, Lean, Kanban, and Waterfall methodologies, including the ability to pragmatically blend approaches to support collaboration and delivery.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, cloud, APIs, services, database technologies, platform dependencies, DevOps, and testing concepts such as CI/CD and TDD.
* Highly developed influence, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts and help others adopt different points of view.
* Experience managing large-scale project budgets, including forecasting, tracking, and explaining variances in scope, schedule, and cost.
* Strong organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience with project management and reporting tools such as MyPPM (Clarity), Jira/MyJira, Smartsheet, and Power BI or similar analytics platforms.
* Bachelor's Degree or higher.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Technical project management experience in Commerce or a closely related domain.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Agile certifications such as CSM, ACP, CSPO/CPO, SAFe, or LeSS.
* Experience supporting large-scale, global software development programs within a creative, customer-focused, and service-minded organization.

Join us as a Team Manager Production - CU based in Pune to drive customer order execution, according to the agreed plan and in line with our priorities safety, quality, delivery and cost. First line manager. Coordinate between different processes and support functions.

**About the Company:**

In Alfa Laval, we are every single day contributing to a more sustainable future for our planet through engineering innovation. Our global team designs and implements the refining, recycling and purifying process that allow our customers to be better themselves. You will find our work in leading applications for water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, pharmaceutical development and much more. The people of Alfa Laval enjoy the freedom to pursue ideas and the resources to see those ideas to become reality, in an environment that welcomes drive, courage and diversity. The result is a company where we all can be very proud of what we do.

Our core competencies are in the areas of heat transfer separation, and fluid handling. We are dedicated to optimizing the performance of our customers' processes. our world-class technologies, our systems, equipment and services must create solutions that help our customers stay ahead. Please feel free to peruse our website www.alfalaval.com.

jobs.title: Filling & Packing Engineer - Projects
jobs.description:
**Main Responsibilities / Job Summary**

1. **Product manufacture**

Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.

Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.

Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.

Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

2. **Compliance**

Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestlé policies, standards and legal requirements.

Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.

Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

3. **Maintenance integration**

Coach / train, with related parties, the technicians and operators in preventive / routine maintenance activities and machinery operations.

Ensure that CDM is fully integrated with factory operations and all operators / technicians understand and practice CDM.

4. **Data management / Systems**

Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)

Measure, analyse and control maintenance & improvement (M&I) budget and spare parts inventory by using available system / tools (NEE).

Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

5. **Continuous Improvement**

Review process failures and execute continuous improvement activities by identifying opportunities, accessing proposals and timely implementation.

Support projects (team) by setting up / installation of new equipment, test run and ensuring readiness for mass production. Wherever required, participate in standard audits (HACCP, FSMS, GMP etc.)

Ensure that the equipment history, damage code and root cause analysis are completed correctly.

6. **Knowledge management and people development**

Coach and mentor, the members of team to increase productivity and efficiency by participating in daily meetings, reviewing actions.

Train the team on safety and environmental requirements and procedures.

Review and feedback to direct reports of their performance against their principal accountabilities and behavioural competencies so as to continually improve individual and team operational and/or technical capability in line with site skills and behavioural requirements.

Communicate information flows from the management to the direct reportees and vice versa.

7. **Area of responsibility**

* Maintenance of filling & packing machines as core responsibility along with process machinery.
* Maintenance budget preparation & day to day management with strong tracking with preventive mindset
* Spares parts management for the plant, Maintenance planning & scheduling
* Engineering contractual management including development & Day to day people management of internal & external
* Problem solving techniques (GSTD, BDA, DMAIC etc,)
* Project management skills will be an added advantage
* Exposure to primary packing (horizontal flow wrapper, vertical form fills sealing machine, can/Jar filling machines, product auto feeding system into the flow wrappers), secondary packing (auto case packing, top loading, or front loading, COBOT or Robo based auto pick & place machines into grey boxes or shippers)
* Knowledge on various type coding: Contact, Inkjet, Laser coders from reputed vendors like DOMINO, IMAJE, VIDEOJET etc.

jobs.title: D365 Business Central Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Agrocorp International is a Singapore-headquartered agri-commodity trading and processing group operating across more than a dozen countries. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is our core ERP platform, and we are rolling it out across group entities while deepening its use in those already live.

This is a central group role, not one tied to a single entity or site. You will lead implementations across new entities and manufacturing facilities, contribute to the redesign of our existing environment, and build the integrations and automation connecting Business Central to our wider systems landscape. The role suits someone who has moved beyond support into implementation — comfortable owning configuration and design decisions, and holding implementation partners to account on quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Business Central implementations for new group entities — functional design, configuration, testing and deployment across finance, supply chain, inventory, procurement and sales.
* Implement and configure the manufacturing module for our processing plants: production BOMs, routings, work and machine centres, production orders, consumption and output posting, MRP and replenishment, lot traceability, production costing and yield variance. Support co-product and by-product costing design.
* Contribute to the redesign of our existing Business Central environment — posting processes, system logic, reporting and financial process alignment — and replace bespoke customisation with standard functionality where possible.
* Define and support integrations between Business Central and Salesforce, banking platforms, warehouse and plant systems. Own data migration: master data, opening balances, validation and reconciliation.
* Use AI tooling actively in delivery — requirements analysis, functional documentation, configuration design, test scripts and data preparation — to shorten implementation cycles.
* Design and build agentic workflows within and around Business Central to automate routine business and system processes.
* Track new Business Central features across Microsoft's release waves, assess their relevance and bring forward those that replace manual effort or existing customisation.
* Work with implementation partners and vendors, reviewing deliverables and functional specifications against agreed requirements. Act as the internal subject matter expert across the group and support site-based team members.
* Design and lead UAT, deliver user training, and provide go-live and hypercare support including on-site presence where required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 4–7 years implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, with demonstrated hands-on manufacturing module experience in a live environment.
* Working knowledge of core accounting within an ERP: chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, period close, inventory valuation.
* Full implementation lifecycle experience — requirements, fit-gap, configuration, data migration, testing, training and go-live — including Configuration Packages / RapidStart.
* Strong documentation, analytical and stakeholder communication skills, and willingness to travel internationally for implementation phases.

**Preferred**

* MB-800 certification; process manufacturing, food or agri-processing experience.
* Understanding of AL extensions sufficient to review and specify development work.
* API and OData integration experience, particularly Salesforce to Business Central.
* Power Platform and Power BI; multi-entity, multi-currency and intercompany setups.
* Practical experience applying AI tooling or building agentic workflows in a business systems context.

jobs.title: Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

We are building and enhancing ecommerce data and technology capabilities for our North America (NAR) Sales organization. These capabilities bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, and retail media data to support business reporting, analytics, and decision-making across ecommerce channels. As Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities (Ecommerce), you will work with Sales, Ecommerce, and D&T teams to understand business requirements and support the delivery of data and technology solutions. You will contribute to the development and enhancement of ecommerce data products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical capabilities. The role involves working with data engineering, BI, analytics, and technology teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, support solution development and testing, and ensure reliable delivery.Success in this role requires experience working with data and technology solutions, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage assigned deliverables in a collaborative environment. You will support solution quality, data validation, implementation, and ongoing improvements while working closely with business and technical partners.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

You will work with Sales, Ecommerce, Operating Unit business partners, and D&T teams to understand requirements and contribute to the delivery and support of reliable data and technology solutions:

  

* Bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, retail media, and other relevant data to provide NAR Sales with an integrated view of ecommerce performance; diagnose growth drivers and performance gaps.
* Frame business questions as analytical approaches, develop hypotheses, combine data sources, validate findings, and deliver evidence-based recommendations.
* Apply understanding of ecommerce business models, retailer platforms, marketplaces, quick commerce, and online grocery to identify channel performance drivers.
* Assess NielsenIQ, Circana, Numerator, retailer first-party/POS, digital shelf, and retail media data for quality, coverage, limitations, and suitability; communicate caveats.
* Measure digital shelf and retail media performance, including content quality, search visibility, availability, click-through and conversion rates, ROAS, and incremental sales where data permits.

jobs.title: Quality Manager, GBS

**Job Summary**

Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?

**Job Functions**
=================

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

  

Global Business Services: Delivering streamlined, scalable support—enhancing efficiency, compliance and service excellence across the company.

  

The role is based in Hyderabad, India(hybrid role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

  

The Quality Manager leads the Quality Assurance team and drives scalable, standardized quality practices across the GBS organization. This role oversees the QA framework, leverages automation and analytics to enhance efficiency, and partners with stakeholders to translate quality insights into measurable business improvements. Through root cause analysis and continuous improvement, the role enables operational excellence and sustainable performance.

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality Assurance team, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Own and continuously enhance the GBS Quality Assurance framework, including standards, methodologies, governance, operating procedures, controls, and evaluation criteria.
* Ensure consistent, objective, and calibrated quality assessments across teams, processes, and stakeholder groups.
* Develop and execute a Quality Automation Roadmap, leveraging automation, analytics, AI, and intelligent monitoring solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Establish and maintain quality reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and trend analysis to provide leadership with visibility into performance, risks, and corrective actions.

* Partner with Operations, Process Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to standardize quality practices, resolve systemic issues, and support the onboarding of new processes into the Quality framework.
* Identify, implement, and replicate quality best practices across functions, processes, and locations to strengthen consistency and business outcomes.
Periodically assess the effectiveness of the QA framework and influence stakeholders to advance a proactive, data-driven, and continuous-improvement-focused quality culture.  

  

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Management, Continuous Improvement, Business Process Improvement (BPI), or related operational excellence functions.
* 2+ years of leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Experience within BPO, Contact Center, Shared Services, GBS, or similar service-oriented environments.
* Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, process standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Lean Six Sigma, PMO, or other quality/process improvement certifications preferred; ability to independently drive complex initiatives from concept to implementation and support business needs requiring up to 40% travel.  

  

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Proven ability to transform Quality functions through automation, analytics, and AI-driven monitoring, reducing manual effort while increasing business impact.
* Strong track record of translating quality insights into root-cause-driven improvement initiatives that deliver measurable operational and customer outcomes.
Experience building and scaling standardized Quality frameworks across Shared Services, GBS, BPO, or Contact Center environments, driving consistency, governance, and continuous improvement globally.  

  

**Why Choose Us?**

* Play a key role in transforming Quality into a data-driven, technology-enabled function that influences business outcomes across a global organization.
* Enjoy a hybrid work model (3 days/week in office) with company-provided two-way transportation for added flexibility and convenience.
Accelerate your growth through learning and development programs, while building your career in an inclusive, collaborative environment that empowers people to learn, lead, and make a lasting impact.  

  

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. jobs.title: Sr. Executive / Executive - R&D and Production (Cheese)
jobs.description:
Designation: Sr. Executive / Executive - R&D and Production (Cheese)

Qualification: M.Tech / B.Tech - Dairy Technology / Food Technology / Food Science or similar qualification.

Experience: 4 - 8 Years

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Description:**

**Production & Process Management :**

* **End-to-End Production:** Supervise daily cheese production activities including milk standardization, pasteurization, curd preparation, cutting, molding, pressing, salting, and ripening.
* **Process Standardization:** Design and standardize critical processing parameters such as temperature, pH, coagulation, curd stretching, and syneresis (moisture control) to ensure product consistency.
* **Equipment Operations:** Operate, troubleshoot, and validate pilot-scale and industrial cheese-making equipment including cheese vats, separators, molders, and brining systems.

**Research, Development & Innovation (R&D)**

* **New Product Development:** Conceptualize, formulate, and commercialize new cheese varieties, including Mozzarella, Cheddar, Processed, Gouda, Brie, and regional artisanal cheeses.
* **Experimentation:** Innovate with adjunct cultures, enzymes, emulsifiers, and stabilizers to create differentiated flavor profiles and optimize product texture.
* **Yield Optimization:** Collaborate with production teams to scale lab trials to commercial levels while optimizing yield, cost efficiency, and quality consistency.

**Affinage (Cheese Ripening & Aging)**

* **Climate Control:** Manage cheese caves and aging facilities by strictly monitoring curing conditions like humidity (often above 90%), temperature (usually around 10°C), and aeration to promote proper microbial activity.
* **Maturation:** Turn, rotate, and apply surface treatments or washes to cheeses at appropriate intervals to maximize optimal drainage, even ripening, and flavor development.

**Quality Assurance & Food Safety Compliance**

* **FSSAI Compliance:** Ensure all formulations, packaging, and labeling comply strictly with FSSAI regulations and international food safety standards.
* **Safety Protocols:** Monitor Critical Control Points (CCP) in compliance with food safety frameworks like FSSC 22000 and HACCP.
* **Hygiene & Sanitation:** Maintain strict hygiene standards, assess environmental impact, and supervise Clean-In-Place (CIP) and manual sanitation protocols in the production area.
* **Testing:** Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to conduct sensory evaluations, organoleptic testing, and monitor chemical/microbial properties.

**Leadership & Administration**

* **Team Management:** Train, supervise, and guide production operators and junior staff on best practices in cheese handling and safety.
* **Documentation:** Document experimental data, daily production reports, batch records, and formulation processes accurately for audits and traceability, utilizing tools like SAP or other ERP modules.

Work Location: In person

**What You Will Do****:**

  

The Market Surveillance Compliance team sits within the Global Compliance Department. The team strives to detect potential insider trading, market abuse, violations of regulations and policies related to information barriers, and/or violations of firmwide trading policies through established advanced technology-based trading surveillances. Market Surveillance focuses on establishing surveillances to cover all business units globally. Candidates should have basic knowledge of financial markets and financial products, including equities and derivatives, a genuine interest in the stock market, and a habit of following financial and market news. The role involves supporting surveillance alert reviews, research, investigations, and surveillance-related projects under the guidance of experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

* Review surveillance alerts and trading activity across equities, derivatives, and fixed income products to identify potential market manipulation, insider trading, and information barrier violations, following established procedures and team guidance.
* Follow financial and market news and research company announcements and market-moving events to assess whether unusual trading activity may indicate potential insider trading or market manipulation.
* Support the review of potential trading issues flagged by business units, such as Global Markets & Banking and Asset and Wealth Management, by gathering relevant trading data, documenting findings, and escalating concerns to experienced team members for further review.
* Assist with reviewing and testing automated surveillance outputs in coordination with experienced team members, Engineering, and Technology.
* Assist with research into trading around market-moving events, such as drug trials, merger & acquisition announcements, offerings, and corporate accounting scandals, to support investigations into potential insider trading and market abuse.
* Participate in team discussions and contribute to initiatives aimed at improving the quality and controls of the trade surveillance program.

**What You Will Need****:**

  

* Bachelor’s/Post Graduate Degree
* Basic knowledge of financial markets, the stock market, and financial products such as equities and derivatives is required.
* Genuine interest in financial and stock markets, with a habit of following market news, company announcements, and current financial developments.
* Basic familiarity with MS Excel and PowerPoint, with a willingness to learn data analysis and presentation skills.

* Interest in learning about trading activity, market surveillance, and financial regulations.
* Analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to summarize research findings clearly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain observations and ask relevant questions.
* Team player with great attitude and work ethic

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Edenred**
Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
  
  
Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.
  
  
Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.
  
  
True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
  
  
Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
  
  
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
  
  
Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.
  
  
**The UAE CONTEXT**
Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.
  
  
We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).
  
  
**THE ROLE**
Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.
  
  
You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.
  
  
Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.
  
  
The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.
* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.
* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.
* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.
* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.
* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.
* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.
* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.
* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.
* Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.
* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.
* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.
* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.
* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.
* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:
  
  

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.
* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.
* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.
* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.
* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.
  
  
**REPORTING STRUCTURE**
Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.
  
  
Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE**
You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.
  
  
*Edenred UAE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or background.*

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to join Pinar Arabia and drive brand and category growth across our priority categories and markets in the GCC and Europe. Guided by our core pillars of “Health for Generations,” “Respect for Planet,” and “Powered by People,” this role owns the annual marketing plan and budget, product launches, agency management, exhibitions and events, and growth initiatives with the Commercial team. It also includes setting up the marketing structure and ways of working for Pinar’s European commercial operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead brand and portfolio strategy across Pinar Arabia’s priority categories and markets.
* Prepare, implement and track the annual marketing plan and budget, reporting on results and recommending corrective actions.
* Drive new product development and launch preparation end to end, working with cross-functional teams and agencies.
* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, ATL, BTL and in-store channels.
* Manage exhibitions, stands and events end to end (e.g., Gulfood), including budget, agency and supplier management, stand design and construction, promotional materials and on-site organization.
* Build the marketing structure and working processes for Pinar’s European commercial operations, including corporate communications, exhibitions and events, promotional materials, and related agency and supplier relationships.

* Manage trademark registration and brand protection processes in coordination with the relevant internal teams and external consultants.
* Monitor market data, consumer research and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities.

**RESPECT FOR PLANET**

* Support environmental and social responsibility through brand communication, activations, exhibitions and events.
* Use marketing resources responsibly, ensuring efficient allocation, tracking and optimization of marketing spend.

**HEALTH FOR GENERATIONS**

* Ensure products and launches are grounded in consumer insights and support healthier, high-quality choices for families.
* Maintain regulatory and brand compliance across product launches, artwork and promotional materials.

**POWERED BY PEOPLE**

* Work closely with the Commercial team on category growth initiatives, trade marketing and in-market execution.
* Work closely with R&D, Quality, technical and Regulatory teams, coordinating packaging design, artwork development and the related approval processes.
* Maintain regular communication and coordination with the Pinar Türkiye marketing team, ensuring alignment with brand strategy and communication standards.
* Manage and evaluate creative, media, PR, digital, event and other agency and supplier relationships.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
* 8+ years of marketing experience in FMCG (required).

At Pinar Arabia, we bring Pinar, a trusted food brand with more than 50 years of heritage, to consumers in the GCC and Europe. Here, your ideas get to market quickly, and your impact on the brand is visible every day.

https://pinararabia.com/

jobs.title: Bartender at InterContinental Residences Dubai Business Bay

**InterContinental Residences Dubai Business Bay** is looking for a creative, passionate, and service-driven **Bartender** to join our Food & Beverage team. As a **Bartender**, you will play an important role in creating memorable moments for our guests through expertly prepared beverages, elegant presentation, and engaging service. You will contribute to the smooth operation of the bar while ensuring consistency, quality, and compliance with established standards.

Situated in the heart of Dubai’s Business Bay, InterContinental Residences Dubai Business Bay offers 176 luxury serviced residences, providing an exceptional setting for both short and extended stays. Your professionalism, product knowledge, and commitment to excellence will help enhance the guest experience and reinforce our reputation for outstanding hospitality.

**Your Day-to-Day**
-------------------

Every day brings new opportunities to create memorable experiences. Your responsibilities will include:

### **Beverage Preparation & Guest Service**

* Prepare and serve a wide selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in accordance with established recipes and brand standards.
* Prepare classic and signature cocktails using established techniques and creative presentation.
* Recommend beverages based on guest preferences and provide knowledgeable descriptions of drinks, spirits, and ingredients.
* Ensure consistency in beverage quality, taste, appearance, and portion control.
* Deliver warm, attentive, and personalized service while building positive relationships with guests.

### **Bar Operations & Inventory Management**

* Prepare, organize, and maintain the outlet and service stations before, during, and after operations.
* Ensure beverages, garnishes, and ingredients are properly stored, labelled, dated, and rotated.
* Monitor inventory levels and communicate replenishment requirements to the supervisor.
* Assist with stocktaking and maintain accurate control of beverage supplies.
* Ensure outlet equipment, glassware, and tools are clean, operational, and properly maintained.

### **Quality, Hygiene & Safety Standards**

* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety in accordance with HACCP requirements.
* Follow responsible alcohol service practices and comply with applicable local laws and regulations.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and preparation of all beverages and ingredients.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and presentable bar environment throughout every shift.
* Follow all hotel policies and procedures relating to health, safety, sanitation, and security.

### **Guest Experience & Team Collaboration**

* Anticipate guest needs and consistently deliver service that reflects luxury hospitality standards.
* Respond to guest enquiries, preferences, and special requests with professionalism and attention to detail.
* Handle guest feedback and service concerns promptly, ensuring guest satisfaction.
* Work closely with restaurant colleagues, kitchen teams, and supervisors to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Attend daily briefings, departmental meetings, and training sessions.
* Support beverage promotions and initiatives that enhance the guest experience.

**What We Need from You**
-------------------------

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Previous experience as a Bartender within a hotel, luxury restaurant, or upscale hospitality environment.
* Experience working in luxury hospitality is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of classic cocktails, spirits, wines, liqueurs, and contemporary beverage trends.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver exceptional guest service in a fast-paced environment.

### **Technical & Beverage Skills**

* Excellent beverage preparation and cocktail-making skills.
* Good understanding of beverage inventory, stock rotation, and cost control.
* Knowledge of responsible alcohol service and applicable local regulations.
* Ability to maintain consistency, accuracy, and efficiency during busy service periods.
* Familiarity with bar equipment, glassware, and beverage preparation standards.

### **Education & Certification**

* High School Diploma or Matric Certificate.
* Bartending certification is an advantage.
* A qualification in Hospitality Management or Food & Beverage Operations is preferred.

### **Personal Attributes**

* Positive, outgoing, and approachable personality with a genuine passion for hospitality.
* Professional appearance and excellent personal grooming.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good attention to detail and presentation.
* Ability to remain calm, organized, and efficient under pressure.
* Strong team spirit and willingness to support colleagues.
* Flexible approach to working shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
* A genuine commitment to delivering memorable guest experiences.

jobs.title: Purchase In-Charge/ Manager - Food & Beverage Industry
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Purchase Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring purchasing activities across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.

The role involves working closely with Operations Managers, Outlet Managers, and other concerned employees to identify purchasing requirements, source suitable suppliers, negotiate competitive pricing, ensure product quality, monitor supplier performance, and maintain proper purchasing procedures and documentation.

The Purchase Manager is expected to ensure that all outlets obtain the required products and materials at competitive prices, with the right quality and timely delivery, while maintaining cost efficiency and accountability throughout the purchasing process.

Key Responsibilities1. Purchase Coordination

* Coordinate with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to understand daily, weekly, and operational purchasing requirements.
* Ensure purchasing requirements are properly communicated, planned, and fulfilled on time.
* Follow up on pending orders, deliveries, shortages, and urgent requirements.
* Ensure outlets purchase products from approved suppliers wherever applicable.
* Monitor purchasing activities across all brands and identify unnecessary, duplicate, or excessive purchases.
* Support outlets in sourcing products whenever required.
* Coordinate purchases for new outlets, menu launches, promotions, and special operational requirements.

2. Supplier Sourcing & Negotiation

* Identify and develop new suppliers for food products, beverages, packaging, cleaning materials, equipment, and other F&B operational requirements.
* Regularly obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, delivery terms, and payment conditions.
* Negotiate competitive prices, discounts, credit terms, delivery charges, and other commercial benefits.
* Develop alternate suppliers for key products to avoid dependency and supply disruptions.
* Maintain an updated supplier database with contact details, product specifications, pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions.
* Establish professional relationships with suppliers and maintain effective communication.
* Conduct regular market research to identify competitive suppliers and better purchasing opportunities.

3. Cost Control & Price Monitoring

* Monitor prices of frequently purchased products across all outlets and brands.
* Maintain updated price comparison records for major food ingredients and operational supplies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs without compromising product quality.
* Monitor supplier price increases and verify whether such increases are justified based on market conditions.
* Inform Management and Operations of significant price changes affecting food cost and profitability.
* Negotiate better pricing based on purchasing volume, frequency, and long-term business relationships.
* Identify opportunities for savings through alternative products, suppliers, packaging, and purchasing arrangements.

4. Coordination With Operations & Outlet Managers

* Work closely with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to ensure purchasing requirements are fulfilled efficiently.
* Understand outlet consumption patterns, menu requirements, operational priorities, and product specifications.
* Coordinate with Operations before changing suppliers, brands, product specifications, or ingredients.
* Ensure new suppliers and products are evaluated and approved by the concerned Operations team before implementation.
* Resolve supplier-related issues affecting outlet operations.
* Ensure purchasing decisions support operational requirements without compromising service, product quality, or customer experience.

5. Supplier Performance & Quality Control

* Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, pricing, delivery, reliability, and responsiveness.
* Ensure suppliers deliver products according to agreed specifications and quantities.
* Coordinate with outlets regarding complaints, rejected products, damaged goods, poor quality, and short deliveries.
* Follow up with suppliers for replacements, refunds, credit notes, and corrective action.
* Arrange product samples and trials whenever required.
* Ensure suppliers provide necessary food safety documentation, product specifications, expiry details, and other relevant documents.
* Identify and replace suppliers who repeatedly fail to meet company requirements.

6. Purchase Documentation & Approval Procedures

* Ensure purchases are supported by proper quotations, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices as applicable.
* Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and authorized approval limits. Make sure that the sytem is updated on the purchase module.
* Maintain proper documentation of supplier quotations, negotiated rates, orders, agreements, and price revisions.
* Verify supplier invoices against agreed prices and approved purchase details.
* Coordinate with Finance regarding invoices, payment terms, outstanding supplier balances, and payment follow-ups.
* Ensure proper transparency and accountability in all purchasing transactions.
* Identify and report unauthorized purchases or deviations from company purchasing procedures.

7. Purchasing Monitoring & Reporting

* Monitor purchasing expenditure across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.
* Maintain records of major purchases and supplier pricing.
* Prepare regular reports on:
* Purchasing expenditure by outlet and brand.
* Supplier-wise purchases.
* Price comparisons.
* Cost-saving achievements.
* Supplier price increases.
* Pending orders and delivery issues.
* Emergency and unplanned purchases.
* Supplier performance and complaints.
* Highlight areas where purchasing costs can be reduced or purchasing procedures improved.
* Submit reports and recommendations to Management on a regular basis.

8. New Suppliers & Product Development

* Identify suppliers for new menu items, ingredients, beverages, packaging, and operational requirements.
* Source customized and portion-controlled food products where required by the Operations Team.
* Research local manufacturers, catering suppliers, food processors, and alternative vendors.
* Arrange samples, quotations, and product trials for evaluation.
* Support Operations in sourcing products for new menus, seasonal promotions, and business requirements.
* Explore new products and alternatives that can improve cost efficiency and operational convenience.

9. Compliance & Ethical Purchasing

* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and approval procedures.
* Maintain transparency in supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing decisions.
* Avoid conflicts of interest and ensure no personal benefits, commissions, or unauthorized arrangements are received from suppliers.
* Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, commercial agreements, and company information.
* Report any irregularities, unauthorized commitments, or supplier-related concerns to Management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Purchase Manager's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Cost savings achieved through supplier negotiations.
* Competitive supplier pricing and regular price benchmarking.
* Timely fulfilment of outlet purchasing requirements.
* Reduction in emergency and unplanned purchases.
* Supplier quality, reliability, and delivery performance.
* Effective identification of alternate suppliers.
* Accuracy and completeness of purchase documentation.
* Compliance with company purchasing and approval procedures.
* Responsiveness to Operations and Outlet Managers.
* Reduction in unnecessary purchasing expenditure.
* Timely reporting and purchasing transparency.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3-5 years of purchasing/procurement experience
* **Valid UAE Driving License (Mandatory)**
* Strong negotiation and supplier management skills
* Experience in sourcing, purchasing, and inventory control
* Ability to handle multiple ou

Job description:

B2B / B2C Sales Executive

We are seeking an energetic, results-driven, and customer-focused Sales Executive to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have experience in both B2B and B2C sales, with a passion for building strong customer relationships and delivering excellent service. Candidates with experience in the chocolate, confectionery, food, or FMCG industry will be given preference.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, managing orders from inquiry to delivery, supporting corporate accounts, and assisting with events and promotional activities.

Key Responsibilities Sales & Business Development

* Develop and maintain relationships with existing B2B and B2C customers.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities, corporate accounts, retailers, and distributors.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Conduct product presentations and introduce new products to potential clients.
* Follow up on leads, quotations, and customer inquiries in a timely manner.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within company guidelines.

Customer Service & Order Management

* Respond professionally to customer inquiries through phone, email, social media, and in-person visits.
* Process customer orders accurately and coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely fulfillment.
* Monitor order status and provide updates to customers.
* Resolve customer concerns and complaints efficiently while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Maintain accurate customer records and sales reports.

Event & Marketing Support

* Assist in planning, organizing, and executing exhibitions, trade shows, corporate events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate event logistics, customer invitations, and follow-up activities.
* Represent the company professionally during events and promotional activities.
* Support marketing initiatives and contribute ideas to increase brand awareness and sales.

Administrative & Reporting

* Prepare quotations, proposals, and sales reports.
* Maintain and update customer databases and sales records.
* Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, and operations teams to ensure smooth order processing and delivery.
* Provide regular sales updates and market feedback to management.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B and/or B2C sales.
