jobs.title: Consultant, PACS - Public Policy and Government Relations
jobs.description:
**Primary Location:**
Gurugram, India
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**Reporting into:**
Senior Director, PACS - Public Policy and Strategic Issues Management INSWA OU
  
  
The prospective candidate will be responsible for developing and executing a high impact government relations strategy in support of the company’s business in India and South-West Asia (INSWA), driving engagement across key policy makers, regulators and thought leaders in the market. He/she will be responsible for creating awareness of the organization’s efforts to key government stakeholders at center, state, local levels, as well as tactical support to the company’s senior leadership team to achieve set goals. The role will require analysis of policies and regulations both at the Center and the State. S/he will report to the Sr. Director, Government Affairs, based in Gurugram, India and work very closely with the VP, PACS in defining and shaping the company’s position of key policy and regulatory matters with the Government authorities and regulators.
  
  
This position must have a significant and positive ability to engage the Government to enable future growth in India while reaffirming a positive image and reputation for Coca-Cola in India. S/he will support relationship management with regulators, academics and other policy influencers. The incumbent will also support on crisis management and issues related to compliance, operations and expansion. Through a deep understanding of the external environment within which the business operates, support senior management on the context for business decision making and the impacts of potential decisions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do For Us**

* Support and steer Coca-Cola’s engagement with policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholders across INSWA to defend and promote the company’s interests.
* Support building relationships that enable Coca-Cola to effectively engage with nodal ministries and related stakeholders; (Finance, Legal Metrology department, Consumer Affairs, Food Processing, Environment, Commerce etc.) and elected officials in the Parliament.
* Monitor and analyses policy developments across INSWA related to food and beverages, environment, fiscal policy and trade that may impact the company’s business.
* Develop policy positions on key issues and make them relevant and compelling to the stakeholders by conducting research, preparing communication materials, and curating thought leadership platforms.
* Ensure strong representation by Coca-Cola in the key national trade associations and US focused industry groups and facilitate the participation of key business leaders at the company on relevant platforms.
* Drive a strong focus on business-enabling policy matters and engage the Government on potential areas of partnership and collaboration.
* Manage external agencies/ associations that support Coca-Cola in Government Affairs.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* MBA / Degree in Law/ Public Policy
* 5-7 years of experience in public policy, Legal Affairs, corporate affairs, and government relations preferably in a corporate position.

**Functional Skills**

* Deep understanding of Indian politics, public policy formulation, GST/taxes/regulations/incentives etc.
* Regulatory and Legal understanding of ESG/Manufacturing and Operational issues.
* Keen interest in sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
* Ability to relate public policy projects to core business objectives.

**What can help you be successful in the role?**
**Growth Behavior**

* Growth Mindset: Demonstrates Curiosity. Welcomes failure as a learning opportunity.
* Smart Risk: Makes bold decisions/recommendations.
* Externally Focused: Understands the upstream and downstream implications of his/her work.
* Performance Driven & Accountable: Has high-performance standards. Outperforms her/his peers.
* Fast/Agile: Removes barriers to move faster. Experiments and adapts. Thrives under pressure and at a fast pace.
* Empowered: Brings solutions instead of problems. Challenges the status quo. Has the courage to take an unpopular stance.

**Leadership Behavior**

* Act Like an Owner: Deliver results, creating value for our brands, our System, our customers and key stakeholders.
* Collaborate with the System, Customers and Key Stakeholders
* Develops Self and Others: Develop self and support others' development to achieve their full potential.
* Drive Innovation: Generate new or unique solutions and embrace new ideas that help sustain our business.

**What We Can Do For You**

* Career growth and development: Leveraging our boundaryless network, we provide access to educational platforms and provide coaching, mentoring and feedback, as a part of our Leadership & Development process.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. We want to make our culture inevitable.
* International Experience: Become part of international projects and work along multicultural teams, through our global network.

jobs.title: Reg Science Scientist
jobs.description:
**Overview**
Drive regulatory compliance for new and modified regulations and guidelines affecting the assigned portfolio across India and India BU markets. Interpret and analyse emerging regulatory requirements and, working in partnership with key stakeholders, assess their regulatory and impact assessments, and associated risks. Develop SOPs/workplans and align, execute, or coordinate implementation of each regulatory change, by working with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring their timely closure. Support the innovation/renovation, productivity, sustainability, and digital work programs assigned through timely regulatory due diligence and necessary closures. Support regulatory advocacy through industry/trade associations and appropriate engagement with regulatory authorities for the areas of responsibility or work programs aligned internally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure regulatory due diligence for assigned portfolios/areas of responsibility, covering the product formulation, ingredients, additives, claims, nutrition information, labelling, artwork, advertising, digital and social media communication, import/export, etc.
* Be accountable for regulatory compliance of the assigned portfolio across India and India Region markets, including governance, documented approvals, issue escalation, and closure of compliance gaps within agreed timelines, by working with the key stakeholders.
* Support Horizon scanning for regulatory/scientific/enforcement related developments. Assess impact, materiality, and timing, and work with internal/external stakeholders for implementation or coordination of the recommended action closures.
* Conduct regulatory assessments by interpreting regulatory-related developments in India BU countries or the areas of responsibility assigned, and support timely and quality implementation of regulatory/governance change management by working with the Regulatory Compliance Task Force/Committee.
* Support/lead or co-lead regulatory petitions, clarifications, approvals, and technical representations required to unlock innovation, productivity, imports/exports, business continuity, and risk mitigation/minimization.
* Own issue-management plans for priority regulatory risks identified or allocated as part of the responsibility. Build and align scenarios, controls, decision points, and contingency actions, and track delivery against agreed budget and timelines.
* Ensure support for the regulatory process for digital systems and data initiatives, including product lifecycle management, specifications, regulatory data, workflow controls, and reporting. Improve consistency, traceability, and speed of regulatory decisions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master (Preferred) in food science/technology/life science/chemistry/toxicology/microbiology or related disciplines
* Communication skills, including writing and speaking fluently in English and preferably hindi/local languages in the India Region
* Working knowledge of India Region regulations.
* Experience in writing and implementing Regulatory Change Management, SOPs

jobs.title: Team Lead, Quality Control- Food Safety, Quick Commerce F F Center
jobs.description:
**Description**
We're seeking a Team Lead to ensure compliance and quality standards across our operations. The role involves overseeing FSSAI licensing requirements and validating applicable licenses for operational sites. You'll manage cold chain compliance for temperature-sensitive items and monitor storage conditions across the supply chain.
  
  
The position requires, conducting regular audits, and coordinating with service partners for corrective actions. You'll evaluate and audit third-party sites for adherence to Amazon's food safety standards, conduct regular breakthroughs, and drive gap closure initiatives. The role includes delivering food safety training sessions and investigating customer complaints related to food safety.
  
  
You'll oversee housekeeping and hygiene protocols across facilities while maintaining comprehensive documentation of audits, temperature logs, and pest control reports. Strong analytical skills are essential for creating dashboards, validating data, and identifying process improvements in food safety-related inventory management.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, and excellent communication skills to work effectively with multiple stakeholders. This role combines technical expertise with practical implementation to maintain the highest food safety standards across our network.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key responsibilities include implementing integrated pest management protocols, ensuring proper segregation of food and non-food items, and maintaining storage compliance to prevent cross-contamination.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
* Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Quality & Food Safety Manager
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring:
**Quality & Food Safety Manager**

**Reports to:**
Founder

**Location:**
Noida, Sector - 80

**Shift:**
general (day), plus surprise night audits twice a month ·

**Experience:**
5–8 years

**About The Cinnamon Kitchen**
The Cinnamon Kitchen is a D2C health-snacking and bakery brand built on one promise “So good, you’ll forget it’s good for you!”

**About the role.**
You'll build and own TCK's food-safety and gluten-free assurance system, and take our dedicated gluten-free facility through FSSC 22000 certification. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the documents yourself, train the floor, and lead a two-person QC team across day and night shifts.

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, B.Sc or M.Sc in Food Technology or a related field
* 5–8 years in quality in food manufacturing; bakery, confectionery or snacks preferred
* Hands-on role in at least one FSSC 22000, BRCGS or ISO 22000 implementation or certification audit
* Strong in HACCP, FSSAI regulations, labelling and documentation
* Allergen-management experience strongly preferred
* FoSTaC trained; HACCP or internal-auditor certification preferred

**KRAs**

1. Lead FSSC 22000 certification with the consultant: gap closure, documentation, internal audit, Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits.
2. Own the gluten-free assurance system: supplier approval, raw-material testing, per-batch testing, cleaning checks, hold-and-release.
3. Write and maintain the HACCP plan and all food-safety SOPs.
4. Own FSSAI licence compliance, label checks and claims sign-off.
5. Handle customer complaints, root-cause analysis, recalls, and audits by buyers and platforms.
6. Train production staff and supervisors on hygiene and gluten-free rules.
7. Supervise and upskill the two QC executives; run shift handovers and check records.

**KPIs**

* FSSC 22000 certified by June 2027
* 100% of batches released only after tests pass
* Zero regulatory non-compliances
* Complaint rate falling every quarter
* Two mock recalls a year, each completed in under 4 hours
* Records complete and audit-ready every month

How to Apply-

. jobs.title: Zonal Sales Manager  General Trade South & East India
jobs.description:
**Zonal Sales Manager (East & South Zone) General Trade Bangalore or Hyderabad,India**

  

We, Jabsons Foods, a company based in Bharuch, Gujarat, are seeking a qualified **Zonal Sales Manager (East & South Zone)** to contribute to our companys sales objectives. Your responsibilities include supervising the sales team and building long-term client relationships.

As the Zonal Sales Manager, you should use your creativity and thorough knowledge of sales processes to provide innovative ideas for business growth. Communication and team management skills are also essential for this position.

  

**Objectives of this Role:**

* Responsible for implementing sales plans and strategies with a view to increase sustainable market share and profitability.
* Responsible for strengthening and expansion distribution network.
* Responsible for implementing the policies and guideline for smooth functioning.
* Responsible for understanding the competition activities, demand and supply and forecasting.
* Effective & timely implementation of GTM strategy, robust field force monitoring system, people management and relationship Management
* Managing the complete business cycle in the East & South Zone, from business development and customer acquisition to payment collection.
* Responsible for implementing effective sales monitoring system, daily, weekly, monthly target achievement & business review (sales, Coverage and Fill rate)
* Minimum 12 days of retailing per month
* Drive expansion of the Jabsons General Trade footprint across the East & South Zone, including appointing distributors in under-penetrated states and towns and adapting the GTM approach to regional market dynamics.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* **Sales Achievement:** Primary and secondary sales vs. monthly and quarterly targets (value and volume), and growth over the same period last year, tracked state-wise and distributor-wise.
* **Distribution Expansion:** Number of new distributors / super stockists appointed and activated in white-space towns, and town coverage by population class.
* **Outlet Coverage:** Active outlets billed per month, new outlets added, and repeat-billing rate of existing outlets.
* **Field Force Productivity:** Productive calls %, lines per call, and average bill value per outlet.
* **Range Selling & New Launches:** Outlet-level distribution of focus SKUs and new launches across categories (peanuts, namkeen, chana, dry fruits).
* **Fill Rate & Order Servicing:** Distributor fill rate and secondary order fill rate within agreed norms.
* **Channel Partner Infrastructure, Investment & Hygiene:** Effectiveness of each distributors infrastructure (warehouse space, delivery vehicles, dedicated salesmen and DMS) against the coverage plan; partner investment in stock and working capital commensurate with business size, with healthy ROI; and operational hygiene, including stock within norms, FIFO and expiry management, accurate DMS data, and timely, documented claim settlement.
* **Sales Returns:** Returns / replacements kept within 2% of sales, with proactive management of near-expiry stock.
* **Trade Spend Effectiveness:** Scheme spend within budget as % of sales, and incremental sales delivered per scheme.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Monthly zone demand forecast accuracy for S&OP planning.
* **Team Management:** Team target achievement, attrition, time to fill vacancies, minimum 12 market-working days per month, and SFA / DMS adherence.

**Candidate Requirement:**

* Age: 38yrs to 40 yrs. (Max limit 45yrs)
* Experience: Minimum 15years, of Food industry without any gap. Out of which at least 5 years in branded snack foods. Total number of company change is not be more than 4.
* Qualification: Minimum graduate. Post Graduate in Sales & Marketing.

jobs.title: Walk-in || Nutritionist
jobs.description:
Job Description Nutritionist / Dietitian

  

Organisation: Cloudnine Hospital

Location: Vashi & Nerul, Navi Mumbai

Department: Nutrition & Dietetics

Designation: Nutritionist / Dietitian

Reporting To: Unit Head / Clinical Head

  

Job Summary

  

We are looking for a qualified and experienced Nutritionist / Dietitian to provide nutritional counselling, assess patients’ dietary requirements, and develop customised diet plans to support their health, recovery, and overall well-being.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1. Conduct nutritional assessments of patients based on their medical history, health conditions, and dietary requirements.

2. Prepare customised diet plans for antenatal, postnatal, lactating mothers, and other patients.

3. Provide nutritional counselling to pregnant women, new mothers, and patients with specific dietary needs.

4. Educate patients about healthy eating habits, balanced nutrition, and lifestyle modifications.

5. Plan and monitor therapeutic diets for patients as per doctors’ recommendations.

6. Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals regarding patients’ nutritional requirements.

7. Provide guidance on breastfeeding nutrition, pregnancy nutrition, and post-delivery dietary care.

8. Monitor patients’ nutritional progress and modify diet plans whenever required.

9. Conduct nutrition awareness sessions and educational activities for patients.

10. Maintain proper documentation of nutritional assessments, diet plans, and patient counselling.

11. Ensure compliance with hospital policies, clinical protocols, and food safety standards.

  

Required Skills & Competencies

  

\* Good knowledge of clinical nutrition and dietetics.

\* Knowledge of pregnancy, lactation, maternal, and child nutrition.

\* Strong patient counselling and communication skills.

\* Ability to prepare customised and therapeutic diet plans.

\* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.

\* Patient-centric approach with attention to detail.

\* Knowledge of MS Office and basic hospital documentation.

  

Qualification & Experience

  

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, or Food & Nutrition.

\* 1–3 years of relevant experience in a hospital or healthcare setup.

\* Experience in maternity, gynaecology, paediatrics, or multispecialty hospitals will be an added advantage.

jobs.description:
**Business Head RootsDesi**

**Milk, dairy products and wood-pressed oils • India and abroad**

**Company:** SmartAgro Farm Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (RootsDesi brand)

**Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer

**Base:** Bengaluru, with travel to our farm

**Experience:** 10–15 years, 5+ in dairy or D2C food

**Markets:** India: all products. Abroad: ghee and oils

**Type:** Full-time, leadership

**Compensation:** Industry standard, plus variable pay

**About RootsDesi**

**Vision:** Bringing pure, desi dairy and daily essentials, grown on our farms and made the way Grandma did, to every Indian home.

**Mission:** We are on a mission to bring back the goodness our grandparents trusted. On our own farms we raise native Gir cows and feed them natural fodder grown with their own manure. This natural ecosystem gives us A2 milk, ghee, paneer and everyday desi groceries, made the way our grandparents made them, and delivered farm-fresh to Indian homes.

**Tagline:** Just Pure Desi — made the way Grandma did.

Today our customers are families who have visited the farm and the people they recommend. This role takes RootsDesi from there to homes across India and to Indian families abroad.

What you will sell: A2 milk (daily delivery); bilona ghee, curd, buttermilk, lassi, paneer, colostrum milk, butter, khoa and sweets; groundnut, coconut, sesame and other wood-pressed oils. Ghee and oils are sold in India and abroad; fresh products in India only. More products will be added based on what customers ask for.

**Role summary**

Sell our milk, dairy products and wood-pressed oils across India, and our ghee and oils abroad, profitably, and build the team to run it. You report directly to the CEO.

**Your contribution — nine areas you own**

**Area**

**What you deliver**

**Measured by**

**Sales in India**

D2C (website, WhatsApp, subscriptions), quick-commerce, marketplaces, modern trade, and business customers: hotels, restaurants, caterers, institutions, retailers.

Revenue growth, active customers, business customers, and the mix of direct and business sales.

**Sales abroad**

Ghee and oils: first export markets chosen with the CEO; export licences, labelling and lab certificates; importers, distributors or global e-commerce partners.

Export markets opened, export orders and export margin.

**Profit, plan and cash**

Cost every product from milk to doorstep and set prices by product, channel and market; annual sales and profit plan agreed with the CEO and a monthly business review; credit limits for business customers, on-time collections and safe export payment terms.

Margin by product and channel, plan versus actual, days to collect payment and overdue amount. A product scales only once it is profitable.

**Brand and marketing**

Content, performance marketing and community; our real farm, cows and team; new products added on customer demand, and those that do not sell paused.

Cost to win a customer, new products live on schedule, reviews and rating.

**Customers and CRM**

Every customer and subscription in the CRM; service complaints (delivery, billing, subscriptions) resolved fast; customers asked what they want.

Repeat purchase rate, subscription retention, service complaint resolution time.

**Delivery**

Daily cold-chain delivery for fresh dairy; dense routes that pay for themselves; ghee and oils shipped across India and abroad through partners.

On-time delivery, cost per order, damage in transit.

**Milk supply and stock**

Demand planned with the farm and processing teams; outside A2 milk sourced and tested when needed; stock kept lean; no wastage of perishables — fresh products made only to confirmed orders.

Milk available to plan, every lot tested, zero wastage of perishables, forecast accuracy.

**Quality and compliance**

Every batch tracked from milk to customer and a recall plan ready; product quality complaints acted on fast; an SOP for every activity; launch only with an FSSAI-checked label, shelf-life test and lab report; every claim within ASCI norms.

Quality complaints per 1,000 orders, every batch traceable, SOP adherence in audits. Any compliance breach fails the quarter.

**Build the team**

Lead the existing milk delivery and sales staff; hire for sales, marketing, delivery, export and customer care; weekly reviews; every person accountable for full, on-time delivery.

Key roles filled on time, team results against targets, retention.

**Critical: bring proof with numbers**

* **Speed and 100% execution** — A plan delivered in full and on time
* **People management** — A team you built, and an under-performer you turned around
* **Scalable sales and marketing channels in dairy or D2C food** — Customers at start and at exit, and how you scaled
* **P&L and pricing** — A product or channel moved from loss to profit
* **Repeat customers and subscriptions** — Your retention rate, and what moved it

**Also required**

* **Cold-chain last-mile delivery** — How you lowered cost per delivery
* **Food export, ideally ghee or oils** — Markets you opened
* **FSSAI labelling and ASCI advertising norms**

**Good to have**

* Quick-commerce, marketplaces or global e-commerce.
* Business customers: hotels, restaurants, caterers, institutions, retail.

**Basics**

* Graduate; MBA preferred.
* English and Hindi required; Kannada, Telugu or Tamil a plus.

**First 90 days — outcomes we expect**

**Days**

**Outcomes**

**1–30**  **Take charge**

Milk delivery and existing staff handed over; cost and margin known for every product; hiring plan agreed with the CEO; annual sales and profit plan agreed

**31–60**  **Open channels**

Ghee and oils selling online in India; first business customers signed; CRM tracking every customer; first key hires made; credit limits and collections tracking live

**61–90**  **Prove and plan**

Repeat orders growing; an SOP for every activity; batch tracking and complaint log live; fresh-dairy plan ready; export plan ready: first markets, licences, partners

*Detailed targets are shared with shortlisted candidates.*

**Why join**

* **Own the P&L:** run RootsDesi as your business, reporting directly to the CEO.
* **Grow with the brand:** help us bring pure desi food to every Indian home. Your role grows as we do.
* **Rewarded for results:** variable pay linked to business performance.

Champion Accountability

**Job Summary**

People Inc is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor in the Internal Audit team based in Bangalore, India. The opportunity is to be a part of well-established local internal audit team in Bangalore and works closely with US Internal Audit team and stakeholders. You will be reporting to the Manager, Internal Audit India. People Incs global Internal Audit function performs operational, financial and information technology audits and data analytic/automation projects for IA across all of People Inc locations and businesses. The skills necessary to succeed in this position include strong organization skills, ability to collaborate and partner with our businesses, audit expertise, effective communication and ability to conduct audit testing independently. The Internal Audit Senior will assist in the development, planning, execution and communication of audits and will develop recommendations to improve/enhance the internal control environment.

  

**Primary responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute risk-based audits in accordance with the department audit methodology and SOX compliance standards. This includes identifying and researching applicable operational/technical issues, identifying risks, developing test plans, executing audit procedures, and test steps and documenting test results.

* Lead meetings for assigned audit areas, interact / communicate with stakeholders at various levels of the organization, and develop value-added relationships with process owners and business unit management.
* Communicate audit status, results, control issues/recommendations, and other key messages to Internal Audit management and relevant business stakeholders in a concise, clear, and timely manner
* Assist with special assignments as determined by Internal Audit senior management
* As part of the Internal Audit team, keep up to date on industry and business trends significant to the profession and to People Inc.

  

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Bachelors or masters degree in Accounting, commerce, finance, or a related field required
* Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) designation preferred
* Strong working knowledge of accounting and auditing principles, internal controls, and Sarbanes -Oxley requirements
* Minimum of 3–4 years of internal or external audit experience required, including SOX business process controls testing; IT audit experience alone does not meet this requirement.

* Proactive, organized, and able to manage competing priorities to deliver timely completion of assignments

jobs.description:
**ABOUT GENERAL MILLS**

  

**We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents.** With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Hagen-Dazs, weve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting). Each of our brands has a unique story to tell.

How we make our food is as important as the food we make. Our values are baked into our legacy and continue to accelerate

us into the future as an innovative force for good. General Mills was founded in 1866 when Cadwallader Washburn boldly bought the largest flour mill west of the Mississippi. That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com

General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people.

With our team of 1800+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital & Technology (D&T) Innovation, Technology & Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy & Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance India and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in

We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

**Function Overview**

The Finance organization partners across General Mills to provide financial expertise to guide and govern the company. We bring a distinctive skill set to help the company sustainably drive strong returns on investment, whether thats brand investments, capital investments or resource investments. We hold ourselves accountable for the areas where we are uniquely positioned to drive results what we call our Strategic Priorities but we never lose sight of the fact that we only truly win when the company wins. The Finance function operates as a global team through the partnership of a series of enterprise-focused and business-embedded groups.

  

**Purpose of the role**

The General Mills Financial Systems Integration (FSI) team oversees a global financial systems, data and process ecosystem that enables business growth and evolution, with uncompromising fiduciary integrity. The agile & experienced team governs systems and data, leads close and consolidation processes and provides strategic guidance on key enterprise and portfolio shaping initiatives.

General Mills is in the process of transitioning our global close & consolidation platform from HFM to the OneStream platform. We are seeking a motivated individual to assist in building, sustaining and optimizing this new core platform. The Global Consolidation Administrator (OneStream) will report to the Global Consolidation Steward and oversee the administration and day-to-day support of the OneStream application. This role is integral to the Financial Systems Integration (FSI) Team and involves close collaboration with various members of the global finance and accounting organization across the company.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Perform primary duties within OneStream application, including, but not limited to, entity hierarchies, rules, workflows, dashboards, and reporting views/packages.
* Develop and maintain various reporting solutions (OneStream Cube Views and Excel Add-in) as needed by Accounting and other Finance
* teams.
* Create, maintain, and update financial reports and forms and perform training and end-user education of the system functionality, as needed
* Troubleshoot and partner with D&T resources on technical issues related to the OneStream system.
* Support integrations and data quality processes (validations, mappings, transformations, confirmations) from source systems (SAP, other) in OneStream.
* Partner with SOX team to ensure internal control governance (including SOX requirements), documentation and coordination with internal and external auditors as it relates to system access and change management.
* Provide support for users and maintain system protocols in troubleshooting data validation, access, and reporting issues.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education – Full time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory- Note: This is the minimum education criteria which cannot be altered)
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
* 5+ years of experience in Financial Consolidation system administration, specifically in OneStream, with experience in Hyperion HFM is a plus
* Strong documentation and communication skills, to support interaction with Finance customers and IT partners
* A strong background in accounting and finance
* Detail oriented, highly accurate, and conscientious with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Exhibit strong problem solving, deductive reasoning and decision-making skills
* Work independently as well as in a team environment
* Demonstrate our core values of ambition, innovation, integrity and teamwork

**Job Summary:**   
The Certification Executive – Organic Compliance will be responsible for managing end-to-end organic certification activities across the manufacturing and processing facility. The role includes ensuring complete compliance with **NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations**, and other applicable standards from **raw material inward to finished goods dispatch**, including APEDA TraceNet operations, Transaction Certificate (TC) management, batch traceability, production compliance, documentation, and certification audits.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Organic Certification Management**

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.
* Coordinate with certification agencies for inspections, surveillance audits, renewals, and certification updates.
* Maintain certification validity and statutory compliance.

**2. Raw Material (Inward) Compliance**

* Verify supplier Organic Scope Certificates and Transaction Certificates (TCs).
* Ensure only approved certified organic raw materials are received.
* Verify inward documentation, lot details, and traceability records.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores for compliant inward operations.

**3. Production & Processing Compliance**

* Monitor manufacturing activities as per organic certification requirements.
* Create and maintain production batches in ERP and traceability systems.
* Verify Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packing Records (BPR).
* Monitor material consumption, production yields, wastage, and reconciliation.
* Ensure segregation of organic, in-conversion, and conventional materials.
* Verify cleaning and changeover records before production.

**4. Batch Creation & Traceability**

* Create production batches with complete lot traceability.
* Maintain batch-wise inward, production, processing, and packing records.
* Ensure complete forward and backward traceability.
* Conduct mass balance verification and stock reconciliation.

**5. Finished Goods Compliance**

* Verify finished product labeling as per organic regulations.
* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.
* Approve finished goods for dispatch after compliance verification.
* Maintain finished goods inventory records.

**6. Transaction Certificate (TC) Management**

* Generate inward and outward Transaction Certificates.
* Manage APEDA TraceNet transactions.
* Coordinate with certification bodies for TC issuance.
* Ensure timely documentation for domestic and export consignments.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain certification documents and statutory records.
* Manage:
* Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)
* Batch Packing Records (BPR)
* Stock Registers
* Processing Records
* Yield Reports
* Traceability Records
* Cleaning & Sanitation Records
* Dispatch Documentation
* Maintain electronic and physical documentation as per document control procedures.

**8. Audit & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate internal, customer, and certification audits.
* Prepare audit documentation.
* Address non-conformities and implement CAPA.
* Conduct internal compliance inspections.
* Ensure continuous audit readiness.

**9. Warehouse & Inventory Compliance**

* Ensure proper segregation and identification of organic inventory.
* Verify warehouse compliance with certification requirements.
* Conduct stock verification and inventory reconciliation.
* Monitor storage conditions and product integrity.

**10. Cross Functional Coordination**

Coordinate closely with:

* Procurement
* Production
* Quality Assurance
* Warehouse
* Sales & Exports
* Dispatch & Logistics
* Regulatory Affairs

Support new product approvals, certification requirements, employee training, and customer audits.

**Required Knowledge**

* NPOP Organic Standards
* USDA NOP Organic Regulations
* EU Organic Regulations
* APEDA TraceNet
* Transaction Certificate (TC) Management
* Organic Traceability Systems
* ERP Batch Management
* HACCP
* GMP & GHP
* ISO 22000
* FSSAI Regulations
* Food Safety Management Systems
* Documentation Control
* Internal Audit Procedures

**Technical Skills**

* APEDA TraceNet
* ERP (SAP / ERPNext / Oracle / Microsoft Dynamics / Tally ERP or equivalent)
* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* MS Word
* PowerPoint

**Key Competencies**

**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**

Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.

 **Qualifications**  

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* **Technical expertise:** recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* **People leadership:** develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* **Stakeholder management:** communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* **Delivery focus:** plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* **Continuous improvement:** challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* **Quality, safety and integrity**: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

**About InspireXT**

InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish. We have lofty ambitions in an exciting market, where sustainability, efficiency, AI & technology enablement are driving bold collaborations in pursuit of customer excellence and profitable growth.

The foundation is laid, momentum is building, and we now are looking for talented team players who share our values and want to make a meaningful difference and be part of shaping the next chapter. **WHY** **InspireXT****?**

Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
* Data migration mapping and specification governance inpu

jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

The Quality Technologist ensures that Fresh and UHT products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. They analyze product samples and run routine tests, including pH, conductivity, and the concentration of chemicals used, and they assess packaging materials. They also apply hygiene best practices across operations, carry out internal audits, and keep accurate quality records. * Carry out environmental and allergen swabbing to verify sanitation effectiveness.
* Test packaging integrity and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for corrective action.

**Process Control**

* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters across pasteurisation, fermentation, filling, and packaging. Make sure CCPs stay within defined limits and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for immediate corrective action.

* Lead the closure of packaging-related Non-Conformance Action Reports (NCARs), including reviewing and validating suppliers’ corrective and preventive actions.

**Compliance & Audits**

* Ensure compliance with HACCP, ISO, FSSC 22000, and other food safety and quality management systems.
* Implement Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA) procedures across manufacturing and supply chain functions to reduce food safety risks.
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and maintain accurate quality documentation.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of quality assurance or quality control experience, preferably in dairy or juice manufacturing.
* HACCP Level 3 certification.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance based in United Arab Emirates.**
We are looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance to oversee supplier quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance across a network of ingredient suppliers, manufacturing partners, and fulfillment facilities. You will own the quality systems and processes that ensure materials and finished products consistently meet established standards. Working closely with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain, you will lead supplier qualification, audits, risk assessments, and corrective action programs. You will also manage ingredient verification, quality documentation, and supplier performance monitoring to identify and address potential issues proactively. This role combines hands-on quality oversight with strategic supplier partnerships and continuous improvement initiatives. You will contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment where product integrity, accountability, and consumer trust are essential.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.
  
  

* Supplier Quality & Compliance

+ Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.
+ Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.
+ Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.
+ Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable.
+ Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
+ Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships.

* Ingredient Quality Management

+ Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.
+ Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications.
+ Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations.
+ Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.
+ Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks.

* Quality Systems & Document Control

+ Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.
+ Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention.
+ Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready.
+ Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements.
+ Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency.

* Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

+ Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.
+ Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers.
+ Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
+ Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions.

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

jobs.title: Senior Scientific Community Engagement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Senior Scientific Community Engagement Specialist supports USP's global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center initiatives by helping build and engage a scientific and technical community focused on pharmaceutical continuous manufacturing. This is an outward-facing community engagement role for someone who is comfortable working in a scientific or technical environment and enjoys connecting with people, building relationships, facilitating knowledge exchange, and identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  
  
The specialist manages the day-to-day operation of USP's online continuous manufacturing community at cmkc.usp.org while actively engaging scientific and technical stakeholders, supporting community programming and outreach, identifying relevant conversations and emerging needs, and connecting insights and people across the broader AMT network. The role does not require prior professional community management experience or expertise in continuous manufacturing, but it does require a working understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, curiosity about continuous and other advanced manufacturing technologies, strong communication and relationship-building skills, initiative, and an interest in learning and applying community engagement practices. This is not a laboratory or research role, and it is not an internal knowledge management role. It suits someone with a pharmaceutical manufacturing background who wants to work with people, such as through technical customer engagement, application support, scientific communications, or professional associations.
  
  
The specialist works closely with the person leading USP's Continuous Manufacturing Knowledge Center (CMKC), adding dedicated capacity for ongoing community engagement, particularly with stakeholders in India, while contributing to broader programming, expert engagement, content, and knowledge-sharing activities. Training in community management and in using the online community platform will be provided.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. **Designation:** DGM/GM Biotech

  

**Job Descriptions**

The General Manager/DG,, Biotech Centre, Kumar Organic Products Limited is responsible for leading the Biotech team (which includes R&D, Pilot plant, QC-Micro) in Jigani, Bangalore to invent, develop, and commercialize new active cosmetic ingredients, innovative compounds and process technology aligned with the needs of KOPL business.

  

Develop and implement process technology improvements in Kumar

Secure and protect intellectual property assets.

Co-ordinate new compound development and scale-up.

Identify distinctive raw material suppliers for Biotech Products (with purchase department)

Provide a responsive Biotech Centres presence for the customers. Manage KOPL Biotech Centres capital and expense budgets

Take leadership in outsourcing (manufacturing) of products developed by Biotech Centre and increase the revenue.

Lead the R&D Team and development of new Molecules.

Bio transfer, Gene synthesis

* Able to lead, develop and commercialize various bio-based ingredients by processes of fermentation & biotransformation for cosmetics & personal care industries.
* Screening capabilities (enzymes, microorganisms)

Design capabilities.

**Team:** Biotechnology Scientists, Research Associates, Process Development Scientists, Analytical Support and Technical Staff

  

Position Purpose

To lead the Biotechnology R&D function for development, optimization, scale-up and commercialization of biotechnology-based processes for APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, specialty chemicals and other value-added products.

The position will be responsible for converting scientific concepts and laboratory processes into commercially viable, robust, safe, scalable and cost-effective manufacturing processes.

The role will also drive innovation through fermentation, microbial biotechnology, enzymatic transformation, biocatalysis, strain improvement, process intensification and sustainable manufacturing technologies.

  

Key Responsibilities

A. R&D Strategy and Technology Development

* Develop and execute the company's 35-year biotechnology R&D strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Identify new opportunities in fermentation, biocatalysis, enzymatic synthesis, microbial conversion and sustainable chemical manufacturing.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their technical and commercial feasibility.
* Build internal biotechnology capabilities and technology platforms.
* Establish appropriate project stage-gate and technical review systems.

  

Product and Process Development

* Lead biotechnology process development from laboratory proof-of-concept through pilot and commercial scale.
* Develop and optimize fermentation and biotransformation processes.
* Optimize media, feed strategy, inoculum, fermentation parameters, reaction conditions and downstream recovery.
* Establish robust process parameters and operating ranges.
* Improve yield, productivity, conversion, purity, cycle time and process consistency.
* Develop processes capable of meeting required product quality specifications.

  

Scale-Up and Commercialization

* Lead scale-up from laboratory to pilot and commercial manufacturing.
* Define scale-up criteria and critical process parameters.
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, Analytical R&D and EHS teams.
* Support pilot and commercial batches.
* Troubleshoot process and manufacturing problems.
* Lead technology transfer and process validation support.
* Ensure successful implementation of developed processes at manufacturing sites.

  

Process Economics and Cost Optimization

* Develop techno-economic evaluations for new biotechnology processes.
* Identify major cost drivers and opportunities for cost reduction.
* Drive reduction in raw-material consumption, solvent usage, utilities, waste generation and cycle time.
* Establish target cost of goods for new processes.
* Deliver measurable manufacturing cost improvements through biotechnology/process innovation.

  

E. Innovation and Intellectual Property

* Identify opportunities for patents and proprietary process technologies.
* Work with the IP/legal team on patentability and freedom-to-operate assessments.
* Generate process know-how and protect critical technical knowledge.
* Maintain awareness of competitor technologies and industry developments.
* Build a pipeline of differentiated biotechnology technologies.

  

F. R&D Project Management

* Establish project objectives, milestones, timelines, resources and budgets.
* Manage multiple R&D projects simultaneously.
* Conduct periodic technical and management reviews.
* Identify technical risks and establish mitigation plans.
* Ensure timely completion of development milestones.
* Prepare technical reports and management presentations.

  

G. Quality, Regulatory and EHS

* Ensure R&D activities comply with applicable GMP, quality, EHS and biosafety requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and traceability of development activities.
* Support regulatory submissions and technical responses where required.
* Ensure safe handling of microorganisms, enzymes, chemicals and biological materials.
* Promote safe-by-design approaches during process development.

  

H. Team Leadership

* Build and lead a high-performance biotechnology R&D team.
* Recruit, train and develop scientists and technical personnel.
* Establish technical competency and career-development plans.
* Mentor scientists in experimental design, troubleshooting and scientific decision-making.
* Develop succession plans for critical technical positions.
* Promote collaboration between R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Commercial functions.

  

I. External Collaboration

* Identify and manage collaborations with universities, research institutes, CROs, technology providers and biotechnology companies.
* Evaluate external technologies and licensing opportunities.
* Establish partnerships for specialized technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Represent the company at relevant technical forums and industry conferences.

  

4. Key Interfaces

5. Qualification

6. Experience

**Head International Business (Brands)**

**Department:** International Business Brands

**Reports to:** Jt. Managing Director

**Direct reports:** Regional Managers / Business Development Managers (South-East Asia & Indian Subcontinent, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, and other regions as added)

**1. Position Purpose**

To own and grow company's branded business outside India across all international regions. The Head – International Business (Brands) sets the international brand and market strategy, builds and leads the regional team, expands the distributor network, opens new countries, and is accountable for secondary sales, stock health, new product introductions and the overall international revenue, profitability and forecast.

This is a business-building role, not an export-coordination role. The incumbent must be comfortable working directly with distributor owners, KOLs and institutional buyers, and equally comfortable reviewing numbers and presenting performance to the Management.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategy and Business Planning**

* Define the international brand strategy, country prioritisation and market-entry roadmap aligned with the Company's overall business plan.
* Prepare annual and monthly regional and country business plans, budgets, forecasts and pipeline, and ensure their achievement.
* Take full P&L ownership of international brands business: revenue, pricing, margin, trade terms and receivables, in coordination with Finance.
* Evaluate new market opportunities across private market, hospitals, institutions and government tenders.

**B. Distributor Network and Market Development**

* Develop secondary sales and product movement through existing distributors and their sales teams.
* Drive repeat orders, stock liquidation and inventory health, working with distributors on monthly sales plans and execution.
* Identify, evaluate, appoint and, where required, exit distributors; negotiate distribution agreements and commercial terms.
* Open new countries and expand company's presence beyond existing markets.
* Activate and improve the productivity of distributor sales and marketing teams through training, joint field work and review mechanisms.

**C. Brand, Product and Portfolio**

* Own international brand positioning, brand plans and promotional, digital and scientific initiatives with distributor marketing teams.
* Drive new product and new pack introductions and ensure successful market launches; introduction and upselling of new formulations.
* Gather market requirements and competitor intelligence and feed these to R&D, Regulatory and Supply Chain for new formulations, pack sizes and product development.
* Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market trends and emerging clinical nutrition opportunities.

**D. KOL and Scientific Engagement**

* Build and oversee KOL networks across assigned countries.
* Plan and ensure execution of RTMs, CNEs, scientific meetings and other healthcare professional engagement programmes in coordination with Medical / Scientific Affairs.

**E. Tender and Institutional Business**

* Lead identification and participation in government and institutional tenders, including pricing strategy, documentation and follow-up.
* Build relationships with hospitals, institutions and procurement agencies in key markets.

**F. Regulatory, Supply and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work with Regulatory Affairs to plan product registrations, renewals and dossier requirements country-wise, and to prioritise them against business needs.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Production, Quality and Finance for forecasts, order fulfilment, shelf-life management, documentation and collections.
* Ensure compliance with applicable export, regulatory and company policies.

**G. Team Leadership and Governance**

* Hire, develop, coach and set KPIs for Regional Managers / BDMs; conduct regular performance reviews.
* Create a structured review rhythm: monthly secondary sales, stock and forecast reviews, quarterly business reviews and market visits.
* Present international business performance, risks and opportunities to the Managing Director and Management.
* Build a pipeline of internal talent and a succession plan for the international team.

* 15+ years of international business, export or brand-management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple countries and a team.
