jobs.title: Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS)
jobs.description:
Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS)  
Role Overview  
The Manager – Quality Applications (LIMS) is responsible for the strategy, lifecycle, operation, compliance, and continuous improvement of the Laboratory Information Management System and related Quality applications. The role serves as the application owner and key liaison between Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, IT, Data, Information Security, and external technology partners. The position ensures that LIMS remains reliable, scalable, secure, inspection-ready, and aligned with laboratory, manufacturing, and business priorities.  
Key Responsibilities  
Application Ownership and Lifecycle Management  
•Own and manage LIMS and associated laboratory applications across their full lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, upgrades, maintenance, support, periodic review, and retirement.  
•Maintain the application roadmap in alignment with Quality, manufacturing, regulatory, cybersecurity, and enterprise-architecture priorities.  
•Standardize and harmonize LIMS platforms, master data, and processes across sites while ensuring scalability, reliability, and data integrity.  
•Identify opportunities for modernization, automation, simplification, and continuous improvement.  
Compliance, Validation, and Audit Readiness  
•Ensure compliance with GxP, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+, data-integrity principles, and applicable global regulatory requirements.  
•Lead or support the Computer System Validation strategy and required deliverables, including URS and FRS reviews, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, validation summary reports, periodic reviews, and retirement documentation.  
•Embed validation-by-design, cybersecurity-by-design, and data-integrity controls throughout the application lifecycle.  
•Support regulatory inspections, internal and customer audits, CAPA execution, and timely closure of observations.  
Systems Integration, Data, and Analytics  
•Lead integration of LIMS with MES, ERP, QMS, CDS, ELN, eBR/eBPR, laboratory instruments, data platforms, and other enterprise systems.  
•Enable secure and traceable data flow through APIs, validated connectors, and approved integration patterns, reducing manual intervention and data silos.  
•Maintain the accuracy, lineage, security, availability, and traceability of laboratory data.  
•Enable dashboards, real-time visibility, and analytics for laboratory performance, Quality risks, audit readiness, and operational decision-making.  
•Assess appropriate uses of AI, predictive analytics, and automation across Quality and laboratory processes.  
Operations and Service Management  
•Maintain application availability, performance, reliability, and business continuity for GxP-critical laboratory systems.  
•Manage incidents, problems, changes, releases, system risks, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions.  
•Define and monitor service levels, platform KPIs, support performance, disaster-recovery readiness, and business-continuity arrangements.  
•Ensure effective access management, application security, documentation, and operational controls.  
Stakeholder, Vendor, and Change Management  
•Partner with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, IT, Data, and Information Security teams to translate business and laboratory needs into compliant technology solutions.  
•Manage LIMS software providers, implementation partners, system integrators, and support vendors against agreed scope, quality, cost, timelines, and service levels.  
•Lead stakeholder communication, governance reviews, risk escalation, and executive reporting.  
•Drive user training, change management, adoption, and effective use of LIMS across sites.  
Qualifications and Experience  
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline; an advanced qualification is preferred.  
•Relevant experience managing, implementing, or supporting LIMS in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another regulated environment.  
•Demonstrated delivery of complex digital or IT programs in GxP-controlled environments.  
•Experience with multi-site implementations, upgrades, harmonization, validation, and application lifecycle management.  
•Experience managing technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, delivery plans, and service performance.  
•Experience with related laboratory and Quality platforms such as CDS/Chromeleon, QMS, ELN, eBR/eBPR, MES, and laboratory automation systems.  
Technical and Regulatory Knowledge  
•Strong understanding of LIMS architecture, laboratory workflows, interfaces, master data, and application support models.  
•Knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, validated connectors, cloud/SaaS platforms, enterprise data platforms, and cybersecurity controls.  
•Strong working knowledge of GxP, GMP, CSV/CSA, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+, data integrity, and audit readiness.  
•Understanding of validation deliverables covering requirements, risk assessment, qualification, testing, traceability, release, periodic review, and retirement.  
Core Competencies  
•Quality and compliance leadership  
•LIMS and laboratory informatics expertise  
•Application ownership and systems thinking  
•Program, service, and vendor management  
•Data governance and integrity  
•Analytical problem-solving and risk management  
•Cross-functional stakeholder management  
•Change leadership and user adoption  
•Clear communication and executive reporting  
Key Success Measures  
•Stable, reliable, and compliant operation of LIMS and related Quality applications.  
•Timely delivery of roadmap initiatives, upgrades, integrations, and validation commitments.  
•Strong audit and inspection readiness with effective closure of risks, incidents, and CAPAs.  
•Improved process standardization, user adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency across sites.  
•Effective vendor performance, service-level achievement, stakeholder satisfaction, and transparent governance.

jobs.title: Clinical Dietician
jobs.description:
We are seeking a licensed Clinical Dietitian with Western qualifications and training to deliver evidence-based medical nutrition therapy to patients in Dubai. The role combines individual assessment and counselling with multidisciplinary collaboration, patient education and quality improvement, in line with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct nutritional screening and comprehensive assessments using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) and international standards of practice.
* Develop, implement and review individualised nutrition care plans for inpatients and outpatients, including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, renal, gastrointestinal, oncology, obesity and weight management, and paediatric nutrition as required.
* Provide enteral and parenteral nutrition recommendations and monitor tolerance and outcomes.
* Deliver culturally sensitive counselling and group education to a diverse, multinational patient population, taking account of local dietary habits, religious practices and Ramadan considerations.
* Work with physicians, nurses, pharmacists and allied health teams, attending case reviews and contributing to discharge planning.
* Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation in line with DHA and facility requirements.
* Collaborate with food services on therapeutic diets, menu development, allergen management and food safety standards.
* Participate in audits, clinical protocols, research and quality initiatives; support accreditation (e.g., JCI) readiness.
* Maintain continuing professional development (CPD/CME) required for licence renewal.

**Essential**
Qualifications and Registration
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Dietetics (or Nutrition and Dietetics) from an accredited university in the UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or another recognised Western country; a postgraduate diploma or master's in Dietetics where the first degree is in nutrition or health science.
* Completion of supervised clinical training/placement (approximately 900+ hours, or equivalent to the home-country accreditation standard).
* Current professional registration in good standing, such as HCPC (UK), CORU (Ireland), CDR/RDN (USA), CDRE/provincial college (Canada), Dietitians Australia (APD), or the NZ Dietitians Board.
* Minimum two years of post-qualification clinical experience in a healthcare facility, with no significant gap in practice.
* A valid Certificate of Good Standing issued within the last six months.
* Eligibility for, or possession of, a DHA professional licence (Sheryan registration, DataFlow primary source verification and, where not exempt, the DHA licensing exam). The employer will support licence activation.
* Fluent spoken and written English.

Desirable
  
  

* Specialist experience or additional certification (e.g., diabetes education, renal, critical care, paediatrics, sports nutrition).
* Experience in a JCI-accredited or international hospital setting.
* Arabic or other additional languages.
* Prior experience working in the Gulf region.

Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong clinical reasoning and evidence-based practice.
* Excellent communication, motivational interviewing and patient education skills.
* Cultural awareness and adaptability in a multicultural environment.
* Proficiency with electronic medical records and nutrition analysis software.
* Teamwork, organisation and sound time management.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Animal Nutrition Trial Specialist

**Location:**
United Arab Emirates (Remote)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Arrangement:**
100% Remote — Work From Home

**Level:**
Senior

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Animal Nutrition Trial Specialist to support the planning, technical evaluation, and analysis of animal nutrition research and feeding trials. This role focuses on remote trial protocol review, nutritional data analysis, feed formulation assessment, laboratory report review, research documentation, and virtual coordination with animal nutrition and veterinary teams.

The successful candidate will collaborate with animal nutritionists, veterinarians, feed scientists, researchers, laboratory personnel, and agricultural stakeholders to evaluate trial outcomes, assess nutritional performance, and recommend evidence-based improvements. The position is entirely remote and does not involve physical animal handling, feeding, sample collection, laboratory testing, or on-site trial supervision.

Key Responsibilities

* Review animal nutrition trial protocols, study objectives, feeding schedules, and technical documentation.
* Analyze nutritional trial data, including feed intake, nutrient composition, growth performance, feed conversion, and relevant health indicators.
* Evaluate feed formulation records and assess the nutritional suitability of ingredients and dietary specifications.
* Review laboratory reports relating to feed composition, nutrient analysis, digestibility, and other relevant nutritional measurements.
* Assess trial results and identify trends, variations, and potential factors affecting animal performance.
* Support statistical and comparative analysis of nutritional trial outcomes.
* Review research documentation for completeness, consistency, traceability, and adherence to approved study protocols.
* Collaborate remotely with qualified local personnel to investigate data discrepancies and monitor trial progress.
* Support the preparation of technical reports, research summaries, performance dashboards, and nutritional recommendations.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve feed efficiency, nutrient utilization, and trial methodology.
* Assist with the review of animal welfare documentation and compliance records within the scope of assigned responsibilities.
* Maintain accurate records and comply with applicable research integrity, animal welfare, confidentiality, and data management requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Animal Nutrition, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Agricultural Science, Feed Technology, or a related discipline.
* Significant professional experience in animal nutrition research, feeding trials, feed formulation, or livestock nutrition analysis.
* Strong understanding of animal nutritional requirements, feed ingredients, nutrient composition, digestibility, and feeding management principles.
* Experience reviewing feeding trial protocols and analyzing animal performance and nutritional data.
* Familiarity with laboratory feed analysis reports, research documentation, and statistical evaluation methods.
* Knowledge of animal welfare principles, research ethics, and relevant agricultural or veterinary standards.
* Experience with data analysis tools, spreadsheets, and technical reporting systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams.
* High standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and professional integrity.

What We Offer

* A fully remote, work-from-home position within the UAE employment context.
* Opportunities to contribute to animal nutrition research and evidence-based feed improvement initiatives.
* Professional collaboration with experienced veterinary, agricultural, and scientific teams.
* A structured environment focused on research quality, nutritional performance, and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities for ongoing professional learning and development.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant animal nutrition, feeding trial analysis, feed formulation, research coordination, and technical reporting experience.

**Suggested application subject:**
Application – Senior Animal Nutrition Trial Specialist (UAE Remote)

Please note that physical animal handling, feeding, weighing, sample collection, feed preparation, laboratory testing, veterinary examinations, animal health monitoring, and on-site trial supervision must be performed by trained local personnel. This remote role is limited to trial protocol review, nutritional data analysis, feed formulation assessment, laboratory report review, research documentation, and virtual coordination. Clinical veterinary judgments, treatment decisions, interventions requiring veterinary oversight, animal welfare determinations, ethics approvals, regulated trial authorizations, formal research certifications, and statutory reporting must be handled by appropriately licensed or authorized veterinarians, research ethics committees, and regulatory professionals.

* Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer.

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy.

* Advanced degree or postgraduate qualification in Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs or a related discipline.
* Broad knowledge of regulatory and pharmacovigilance requirements across the Middle East and Africa.
* Experience using Veeva RIM or similar regulatory information management systems.

**About The Role**
Are you ready to build your commercial career in a specialised market where animal biosecurity, food safety and hygiene make a real difference?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)**
to support the growth of LANXESS’ Material Protection Products business across the Middle East. You will focus on developing new business, strengthening customer and distributor relationships, and expanding our presence across animal biosecurity and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
The portfolio includes
**speciality biocides, disinfectants, hygiene solutions and preservation technologies**
used across animal production, poultry, dairy, livestock, food processing, beverage manufacturing and related industrial hygiene markets.
  
  
This is a commercially focused role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, spotting opportunities and developing business across different markets and cultures. **Job Description**
Provide individualized medical nutrition therapy (MNT) through a multi-disciplinary approach for inpatients and or outpatients in Health Care Facilities / Homecare/ Kidney Care and or Ambulatory Healthcare Services.
  
  
MNT is implemented according to the American Dietetic Association (ADA) Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which provides a framework for the Clinical Dietitians to individualize care, taking into account the patient’s needs and values and using the best scientific evidence available to make decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Encourages teamwork by creating an environment of empowerment and accountability
  
  
May supervise and liaise with Food Service related to therapeutic diets, therapeutic projects and education on therapeutic diets
  
  
Implements Departmental standards of practice
  
  
Able to utilize marketing techniques and participation in revenue generation, where appropriate
  
  
May be responsible in maintaining sufficient inventory of nutrition consumable items, general material management and equipment required for patient care and performance of duties
  
  
Responsible for Medical Nutrition Therapy and thus assess patients using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which is a systematic approach to providing high-quality nutrition care. The NCP consists of four distinct, interrelated steps: Nutrition Assessment, Nutrition Diagnosis, Nutrition Intervention, and Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation.

jobs.title: AMET Public Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**Position: AMET Public Affairs Lead**
**Reporting to: AMET GM**
**Location: UAE or Turkey**
*Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.*
*Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.*
*At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.*
*Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.*
*Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at*
*www.opella.com.*
**Job Purpose**

* Opella is looking to recruit a seasoned public affairs & policy lead for their business in Africa. This role is designed to achieve Consumer Healthcare business objectives and growth ambitions by shaping the external public policy environment to support Self Care and ensuring business strategy is informed by a clear understanding of the external policy environment, as well as stakeholders’ needs and expectations.
* This role is vital to shape the external policy and operating environment in support of Self Care, conducive to grow the Opella Consumer Healthcare business in the AMET Zone (Africa Middle East and Turkey).
* The role will require a strong government affairs experience with a track record of success in public policy advocacy with the agility to navigate the complex policy, regulatory, and business environment. The candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of the continent’s landscape complexity and is able to provide clear guidance and strategic counsel to the Opella business in support of its growth ambitions in AMET - Africa Middle East & Turkey.
* Finally, the role will involve strengthening our participation in the regional industry association (MENAP-SMI), as well as those local trade associations in the key markets to support the Opella growth ambitions.

**Key Results/Accountabilities**

* The primary objective of this role is to establish and execute a robust public affairs & policy strategy and action plan aimed to grow the CHC business in AMET.
* Identify key policy priorities and levers to support business growth, provide a robust analysis of the self care policy and operating environment in AMET.
* Regularly inform the AMET GM, the Global Public Affairs Head and other relevant CHC business leaders/partners (i.e., CHC Commercial/Categories, Regulatory Affairs) to ensure seamless understanding and alignment on issues and topics.
* Anticipate public affairs & policy trends and competitive dynamics (i.e., self care, e-commerce, pharmacy channel, etc.) that represent opportunities or threats to the business; and build a clear plan of action to leverage the opportunities or mitigate threats to Opella's reputation and to the business.
* Monitor external developments and effectively communicate potential threats or opportunities to the AMET GM and the Global Public Affairs Head, and CHC business leaders/partners.
* Lead in proposing CHC positions on key issues affecting the CHC business and industry in AMET– in alignment with the AMET Zone GM, relevant counterpart CHC functions and the Global Public Affairs – and develop position papers/statements to advocate with policy makers and other key external audiences, ensuring internal sign-off prior to engagement.
* Strengthen engagement with key external stakeholders, and foster new ones, given the evolving policy environment around Self Care.
* Lead and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams ensuring that business risk is mitigated, and opportunities are swiftly identified and successfully executed.
* Develop scenarios and risk mitigation plans, which reflect a thorough understanding of the policy, government decision-making processes, decision-makers, and influencers, and provide recommendations and solutions to the CHC business
* Gain a clear understanding of Sanofi’s Consumer Healthcare strategy for growth and contribute to the formulation of such strategies.
* Remain current and alert on relevant industry changes (activities likely to include monitoring trade journals and press releases (in collaboration with the Communications team), networking with agenda-setting institutions like WHO and the African Union, venture capital firms and companies, and attending conferences to learn about and monitor new business development opportunities).

**KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

* The position holder will be a key member of the extended leadership team of AMET.
* Strong interactions with relevant functions in the AMET Zone including e.g. digital, marketing/categories, regulatory, finance, medical, communications, among others.
* Strong partnership and collaboration with the AMET Science Head and AMET Communications Lead.
* A wide-ranging network of external stakeholders to manage in the AMET healthcare ecosystem, including establishing a strong presence in our industry associations in both the regional (MENAP-SMI) and priority countries to drive the Opella agenda.
* Selection, direction, and oversight over third party agencies, firms, and/or consultants to support this role in accomplishing its objectives
* See list below for key working relationships:

**AMET GM and leadership team**

* Country Heads and leadership team (key countries supported)
* Global Public Affairs team
* Communications counterparts
* Science counterparts

**Skills, Experience & Knowledge Requirements**

* A high-calibre professional with comprehensive working experience in the public affairs, policy, and market access space (at least 8-10 years) and track record of success delivering on shaping the external environment to address business objectives; broad cross functional understanding & general knowledge of the pharmaceutical business is preferred; knowledge and experience in the field of Consumer Healthcare/FMCG a plus
* Solid experience navigating the AMET Zone healthcare ecosystem, preferably with strong existing network, having past experience proactively dealing with government ministries that have oversight on health policy, public health, reimbursement, finance, among others.
* Proven track record of successful initiatives in public affairs, market access/development, innovative reputation-building, and stakeholder engagement is required. Experience conceiving programs that join diverse stakeholders to deliver on a common public interest is an asset.
* Experience working in highly regulated environment and a demonstrated understanding of AMET's various national, provincial/regional health authorities, including experience dealing with World Health Organization Regional Office for Africa; knowledge/familiarity of New Partnership for Africa’s Development (NEPAD), the African Medicines Regulatory Harmonization (AMRH) initiative, and the African Continental Free Trade Area are a plus.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to understand consumer needs and business transformations to create new business opportunities to build CHC’s business in the AMET Zone.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment and driving results through influence is required, but with a Compliance-first mindset.
* Ability to work under a multi-country accountability, with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and matrix environment, demonstrate flexibility and superior organizational, analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Results-oriented with strong cross-functional collaboration mindset.
* Exercise a high level of independent judgment even in challenging, complex situations is required.

jobs.title: RCM Associate (Payment Posting)
jobs.description:
**About Amperos**
Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.
  
  
We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented Payment Posting Specialist with 2+ years of experience in RCM to join our team. You'll work at the intersection of traditional claim submission or payment posting workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers submit claims accurately and efficiently while ensuring our automation systems perform at the highest standard.
  
  
You'll be responsible for entering charges, verifying claim accuracy, managing charge submissions to insurance companies, and tracking claims through posting and adjudication. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities—this is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Payment Posting:**

* Post payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs, EOBs, and lockbox files into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms
* Balance daily batches, reconcile to bank deposits, and resolve missing or mismatched ERAs
* Flag underpayments and denials
* Resolve unapplied cash, credit balances, refunds, and recoupments, and transfer balances

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience in medical billing, charge entry, or coding verification
* Strong working knowledge of medical coding
* Experience with leading PM systems, including eCW, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more
* Solid understanding of insurance claim submission requirements and pre-authorization processes
* Ability to identify coding errors and clinical editing issues before claim submission
* Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through
* Ability to work US hours (9am–6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Perks & Benefits
  
  

* Competitive compensation with eligibility for a bonus on anniversary date
* Paid sick days and vacation days
* Meal stipends
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company and be an early member of a global billing team, as we expand our billing team in India

Our Hiring Promise: A safe, transparent process
  
  
Amperos will never as you for money at any point in the hiring process. That includes application fees, payment for equipment or training, or a fee to move your application forward. No one at Amperos, or anyone acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment from a candidate.
  
  
**Our Values**

* Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.
* Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.
* Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

*Amperos never asks candidates for money at any stage of the hiring process, including fees for interviews, processing, or recruitment. No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here:*
*Report a Hiring Concern*

jobs.title: Fraud Senior Analyst –Payment Integrity Provider Investigation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
The Fraud Senior Analyst plays a critical role in protecting the organization’s International Health portfolio by leading Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) investigations, driving measurable affordability outcomes, and strengthening prevention strategies across the claims lifecycle. The position combines investigative expertise, data-driven insight, and stakeholder influence to reduce financial leakage, improve claim governance and support sustainable savings delivery across the region. This role is responsible for detecting and recovering FWA payments, creating solutions to prevent claims overpayment and future spend monitoring within a dedicated region. He / She will work closely with other PI team members, Network, Medical Economics, Data Analytics, Claims Operations, Clinical partners, and Product.
  
  
**Job Profile**
Operating with a high degree of independence, the Fraud Senior Analyst owns end-to-end investigative activities within a dedicated region. The role extends beyond case handling to include proactive identification of systemic risks, development of preventive controls, and partnership with regional and global stakeholders to enhance Payment Integrity strategy. The incumbent acts as a subject matter expert, contributing to operational improvements, automation initiatives, and cross-market collaboration to strengthen FWA detection and mitigation capabilities.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Fraud Manager
  
  
**Critical Tasks And Expected Contributions / Results**

* Lead FWA investigations across International Markets, applying investigative judgement to identify billing anomalies, emerging fraud typologies, and systemic risk patterns.
* Deliver quantifiable financial impact through cost containment, recoveries, and forward-looking prevention initiatives aligned to regional savings objectives.
* Translate data insights into actionable investigation strategies by partnering closely with Data and Analytics teams to refine triggers, reporting frameworks and automation opportunities.
* Influence provider behavior through structured Provider audit engagement, negotiation, and collaboration with regional and global stakeholders to reduce future risk exposure.
* Drive continuous improvement of Payment Integrity processes by identifying operational gaps and proposing scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Produce clear, defensible investigative findings and recommendations for senior stakeholders, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
* Ensure investigations and cost containment actions are balanced with fair member outcomes, regulatory expectations, and client commitments.
* Collaborate with Customer Service and Client Management teams to support clear, consistent communication approaches that protect member experience while maintaining investigative integrity
* Operate within established governance frameworks, ensuring investigative activities are compliant with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
* Collaborate with the Member Investigation Unit on Fraud cases when required.
* Perform periodic TPA oversight and partner with TPAs on FWA investigations when required.
* Partner with Data Analytics team in building future FWA triggers automation.
* Mentor and provide support through knowledge sharing, quality review input and guidance on investigative best practices and share FWA claiming schemes.
* Ad hoc duties as assigned

**Key Challenges / Anticipated Changes In Environment**

* Rapid evolution of provider billing models and fraud schemes requiring adaptive investigative approaches.
* Increasing claim volumes and evolving FWA typologies requiring advanced analytical and investigative skills
* Balancing operational turnaround times with deep investigative rigor, stakeholder expectations and member experience considerations
* Expanding use of automation, data analytics, and cross-market collaboration within Payment Integrity operations
* Managing complex provider relationships while maintaining firm compliance and cost containment positions
* Navigating diverse regulatory and healthcare environments across multiple international markets

**Developmental Value Of Position**

* Strengthens strategic thinking through ownership of regional investigative portfolios and measurable savings delivery.
* Builds advanced expertise in international health insurance investigations, audit frameworks, and provider engagement strategies
* Develops leadership capabilities through ownership of complex cases, cross-functional collaboration, and influence without direct people management
* Provides exposure to advanced analytics initiatives, provider strategy discussions and global Payment Integrity frameworks
* Opportunity to deepen technical knowledge in healthcare claims coding, regulatory consideration and fraud risk management

**Experience/Knowledge, Education And Other Requirements**

* You should enjoy working in a team of high performers, who hold each other accountable to perform to their very best.
* Experience of investigation within payment integrity or similar discipline.
* Minimum of 4 years of health insurance or health care provider experience.
* Knowledge of Mainframe, GlobalCare, Actisure and / or Diamond essential.
* Knowledge of claims coding, regulatory rules and medical policy.
* Medical/ paramedical qualification is a definite plus.
* Critical mind-set with ability to identify cost containment opportunities.
* Experience with data analytics
* Demonstrated strong organization skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly learn new and complex tasks and concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to balance multiple priorities at once and deliver on tight timelines.
* Flexibility to work with global teams and varying time zones effectively.
* Experience in liaising with internal stakeholders and ability to work independently within a cross functional team.
* Strong organization skills with the ability to juggle priorities and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.

**Job Title:**
Senior Consultant - Business Analyst - Claims & Benefits Platforms

**Location : Chennai / Hyderabad**

**Flexible to work in 3pm - 12 am shift**

**Experience : 8+ Years**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Senior US Healthcare Business Analyst with strong payer-domain expertise across claims administration, benefits configuration, member enrollment, provider data, pricing, and healthcare transactions. The role requires hands-on experience with Facets, HealthEdge HealthRules, or comparable core administration platforms. The successful candidate will partner with business, product, architecture, engineering, testing, operations, and compliance teams to translate complex healthcare requirements into clear, testable, and implementation-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead requirement discovery and analysis for claims, benefits, eligibility, enrollment, provider, pricing, billing, and related payer capabilities.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, process walkthroughs, and gap analysis; document current-state and future-state business processes.
* Translate business needs into business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, decision tables, data mappings, and traceability artifacts.
* Analyze end-to-end claims processing, including intake, validation, benefit application, pricing, edits, adjudication, coordination of benefits, adjustments, denials, and payment outcomes.
* Analyze and support benefit configuration for medical products and plans, including covered services, exclusions, limitations, copay, coinsurance, deductibles, out-of-pocket accumulators, visit or dollar limits, and network rules.
* Work with Facets, HealthEdge HealthRules, or comparable platforms to evaluate configuration impacts, upstream and downstream dependencies, and operational readiness.
* Analyze healthcare data and transactions across members, providers, products, benefits, claims, accumulators, authorizations, and billing; use SQL or reporting tools to validate findings where required.
* Define mapping and validation requirements for HIPAA EDI transactions such as 834, 837, 835, 270/271, and 276/277, based on project scope.
* Partner with QA teams to prepare test scenarios, expected results, requirement traceability, defect analysis, regression scope, and user acceptance testing support.
* Investigate production issues and business discrepancies by tracing requirements, configuration, data, interfaces, and claims outcomes to identify root cause and remediation needs.
* Support release planning, implementation readiness, business validation, training materials, operating procedures, and post-production stabilization.
* Identify regulatory, privacy, security, audit, and operational considerations for healthcare solutions and escalate gaps to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions across business and technology teams, maintain RAID items, and communicate dependencies, risks, assumptions, and status clearly.
* Mentor business analysts and promote consistent standards for requirements quality, traceability, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Mandatory Technical and Domain Skills**

* US Healthcare Payer Domain Claims, benefits, eligibility/enrollment, provider, products/plans, pricing, billing, accumulators, and payment processes Strong end-to-end payer-domain understanding, with depth in claims and benefits administration.
* Claims Administration Claim intake, adjudication, benefit application, pricing, COB, adjustments, denials, reprocessing, and payment outcomes Able to analyze claim results, identify configuration or data impacts, and translate findings into actionable requirements.
* Benefits Administration Plan, product and Benefit structures understanding, covered services, exclusions, copays, coinsurance, deductibles, out-of-pocket limits, accumulators, networks, and benefit limits Able to define, analyze, and validate benefit requirements and configuration outcomes across multiple scenarios.
* Core Administration Platforms Facets and/or HealthEdge HealthRules; comparable healthcare payer platforms may be considered Hands-on functional experience in requirements, configuration analysis, testing, implementation, or production support.
* Business Analysis Stakeholder workshops, BRD/FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, process models, decision tables, use cases, gap analysis, and traceability Independently leads complex analysis and produces clear, complete, testable documentation.
* Healthcare Transactions HIPAA EDI 834, 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277; X12 concepts and interface mapping Able to analyze business content, mappings, validation rules, exceptions, and downstream impacts relevant to project scope.
* Data Analysis SQL, relational data concepts, data mapping, reconciliation, root-cause analysis, and reporting tools Able to query or validate data, identify discrepancies, and communicate findings to business and technical teams.
* Testing & Quality Test scenarios, expected results, RTM, SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, and production validation Ensures requirements are testable and supports quality teams through closure and business acceptance.
* Delivery Methods Agile/Scrum and iterative delivery; backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, release readiness, and change control Works effectively across product and delivery teams while maintaining scope, priorities, dependencies, and traceability.
* Compliance & Data Handling HIPAA, protected health information, privacy, security, auditability, and controlled handling of healthcare data Recognizes compliance-sensitive requirements and ensures they are addressed through appropriate business and technical controls.
* Communication & Leadership Facilitation, negotiation, executive-ready communication, cross-functional coordination, and mentoring Confidently leads discussions, resolves ambiguity, and drives decisions across business and technology stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare product implementation, platform migration, benefit conversion, claims transformation, or core-administration modernization programs.
* Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, ACA, ASO, or other payer lines of business.
* Exposure to provider contracts, fee schedules, authorizations, care management, pharmacy, portals, APIs, or interoperability initiatives.
* Experience with Service now, Agility, Tableau, Powerbi, Visio, Excel, or comparable requirements and process-modeling tools.
* Relevant healthcare-domain certification are advantageous.

Role Purpose:

The **RTR** **Accounting Manager,** **Americas Accountant / Sr. Accountant** plays a pivotal role in a fast-paced multinational and shared services finance environment by leading month-end financial close activities and ensuring accuracy and compliance with US GAAP and internal policies. This role will work across core accounting, close, and controls —with strong exposure to process improvement and transformation initiatives. You will partner with cross functionalcross functional stakeholders to ensure financial records are complete, compliant (US GAAP), and audit ready audit ready.

* Prepare and review account reconciliations, ensuring clear explanations, support, aging follow ups follow-ups, and timely resolution of open items.
* Coordinate with shared services / operations teams to ensure smooth endtoend accounting flows and issue resolution.
* Act as an SME by providing guidance on appropriate accounting treatments for complex or non-routine transactions. Enforce compliance with internal controls and company accounting policies, maintaining an audit-ready environment with proper documentation.
* Identifyopportunities for**simplification, standardization, and automation**across close, reconciliations, validations, and reporting.

Success Measures (Key Outcomes):

* Timely & Accurate Closings: Consistently complete monthly and quarterly closings on schedule with high accuracy, yielding reliable financial statements and minimal post-close adjustments.
* Financial Integrity: Achieve strong balance sheet integrity through well-documented, fully reconciled accounts (no aged or unexplained items) and effective elimination of intercompany mismatches in consolidation.

Core Competencies & Skills:

jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Repair Engineer** with strong expertise in **aerospace maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO)** processes. This role involves assessing damaged aero-engine components, developing and substantiating repair schemes, and supporting component recovery activities throughout the MRO lifecycle, ensuring compliance with aerospace standards and OEM guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate service-induced damage and determine **component repairability**.
* **Lead development** and **approval of repair schemes** for complex component damage.
* Define **repair strategies, acceptance limits, and serviceability criteria**.
* Develop, review, and approve **repair schemes** for aero-engine components.
* Perform **technical assessments** and create **repair substantiation** using engineering drawings, specifications, repair manuals, and service documentation.
* Support investigation of **non-conformances, technical variances, and serviceability issues**.
* Collaborate with design, materials, stress, manufacturing, and overhaul teams to **resolve complex repair challenges**.
* Develop **inspection requirements** and **characteristics matrices** for repair processes.
* Support **First Article Inspection (FAI/FAIR)** planning and resolution of dimensional issues
* Define **repair implementation strategies** including **industrialization, tooling requirements, inspection methodology, and shop-floor deployment**.
* Develop **repair should-cost models** and perform **cost-benefit assessments.**
* Drive **continuous improvement** initiatives focused on **repair capability, turn-around time, and cost reduction**.
* Support **customer discussions**, **technical reviews**, and **engineering audits**.
* Ensure compliance with **regulatory guidelines**, **OEM standards**, and **aviation safety regulations**.

**Required Skills**

* **2-8 years of experience** in **aerospace maintenance**, **repair**, and **overhaul (MRO)**.
* Strong knowledge of **gas turbine engine components, materials, and repair methodologies.**
* **Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and technical publications.**
* Experience in **damage assessment, serviceability evaluations, repair documentation, and repair development.**
* Understanding of **Characteristics Matrix development** and **critical feature identification.**
* Ability to review and approve **technical documentation and engineering justifications.**
* Excellent **problem-solving**, **root cause analysis**, and **decision-making skills**.

**Nice to Have**

* **Competent Delegations** from OEM's or equivalent aero-engine programs.
* Familiarity with **OEM manuals**, **regulatory compliance (EASA, FAA)**, and **aviation safety standards**.
* Experience in **component life assessment**, **reliability analysis**, and **performance benchmarking**.
* Strong **documentation**, **reporting**, and **technical writing skills**.

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelors degree** in **Aeronautical Engineering**, **Mechanical Engineering**, or **Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME)**.
* Proven experience in **aerospace MRO repair processes** and **technical documentation**.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. jobs.title: Content Platform & Services Manager
jobs.description:
**Content Platform & Services Manager**

  

**About ZS**

ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.

  

**About the Role**

ZS seeks a Content Platform & Services Manager to join our team in Bengaluru, India. This role will own end-to-end content operations for marketing and promotional materials and Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review workflows. The position sits at the intersection of content production and compliance process management, ensuring that content moves efficiently and compliantly from creation through approval to publication and archival.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing content lifecycle platforms, such as Veeva Vault PromoMats or an equivalent platform, in a regulated industry and is comfortable partnering with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and Regulatory stakeholders to keep review cycles on track. The role will also lead the evaluation, build, and rollout of AI-based accelerators, such as automated tagging, claims and reference checking, and pre-MLR quality screening, that reduce manual effort and accelerate review cycles.

We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management, ideally within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industries. A bachelors degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field is required; an MBA is preferred.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Own content operations.** Manage intake, tagging and metadata, routing, review coordination, approval, publishing, and archival of promotional and non-promotional materials.
* **Manage MLR reviews.** Schedule review cycles, track reviewer comments and claims, ensure timely turnaround, and maintain complete audit trails.
* **Administer the platform.** Optimize Veeva Vault PromoMats or similar DAM/CLM systems, including user access, workflows, and metadata taxonomy.
* **Enable review-ready content.** Partner with Brand and Marketing teams to plan content pipelines and ensure correct references, claims substantiation, and formatting.
* **Coordinate cross-functionally.** Work with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance reviewers to resolve bottlenecks and maintain SLA adherence.
* **Maintain compliance.** Ensure content meets internal standards, brand guidelines, and applicable pharmaceutical marketing and regulatory requirements prior to release.
* **Govern the content lifecycle.** Maintain accurate records of approved content, expiry and renewal dates, and withdrawal of outdated materials.
* **Improve operations.** Identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement across workflows, templates, and SOPs.
* **Report performance.** Create leadership dashboards covering review cycle time, throughput, bottlenecks, and compliance metrics.
* **Build capability.** Train internal stakeholders and agency partners on platform usage and MLR submission best practices.
* **Shape AI use cases.** Identify opportunities in metadata tagging, claims and reference validation, pre-review compliance checks, content reuse, and modular content, and build business cases.
* **Deliver AI accelerators.** Lead requirements, pilots, testing, output validation against MLR standards, and impact measurement with Technology, Data, and vendor partners.
* **Establish AI governance.** Set validation, human-in-the-loop, auditability, and compliance guardrails for AI-assisted content workflows.
* **Integrate and scale AI.** Evaluate Veeva AI features, GenAI tools, and workflow automation, and lead stakeholder and agency adoption.

  

**What You'll Bring**

* **Content operations expertise.** 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* **Platform experience.** Hands-on experience with content lifecycle or DAM platforms such as Veeva Vault PromoMats, Aprimo, or similar systems.
* **MLR knowledge.** Working knowledge of MLR review processes and regulatory and compliance requirements for promotional materials.
* **AI and automation delivery.** Demonstrated experience building, piloting, or testing AI/GenAI accelerators or automation solutions, including defining success metrics and validating outputs.
* **Technical partnership.** Ability to convert operational pain points into AI and automation requirements and work effectively with technical teams through delivery.
* **Modular content.** Experience with content reuse and modular content strategies enabled by AI.
* **Stakeholder leadership.** Ability to coordinate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Technology, Data, and agency partners.
* **Operational discipline.** Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage concurrent review cycles and deadlines.
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field; MBA preferred.

  

**Preferred Experience**

* **Industry background.** Prior experience at a pharmaceutical company or healthcare-focused marketing or content services organization.
* **Content governance.** Familiarity with taxonomy, metadata standards, and digital asset management best practices.
* **Process improvement.** Experience driving automation or continuous improvement within content operations.
* **Reporting tools.** Exposure to Power BI or Tableau for operational reporting and dashboards.
* **GenAI tools.** Hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM tools, prompt design, or low-code automation applied to content or compliance workflows.
* **Responsible AI.** Understanding of validation, auditability, data privacy, and responsible AI in regulated industries.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Faster, more predictable review cycles with improved throughput and sustained SLA adherence.
* Accurate, compliant, and audit-ready content across the complete lifecycle.
* Measurable reduction in manual effort through validated AI accelerators and workflow automation.
* Strong adoption of content platforms, MLR best practices, and AI-enabled ways of working across internal and agency teams.
* Clear operational visibility through reliable metrics on cycle time, bottlenecks, throughput, quality, and compliance.

  

**Why Join ZS**

At ZS, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of AI-enabled content operations while working alongside world-class consultants, technologists, data experts, and business leaders. You will help translate emerging technologies into compliant, scalable workflows that improve speed, quality, and impact across the content lifecycle.

Senior Associate, Promotional Materials, **Cardiovascular**

  
  

**Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.

  
  

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas - Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease - we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

  
  

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Role summary**

  
  

The Senior Associate, Marketing Operations and Promotional Materials will coordinate Repatha label update implementation, maintain the evergreen claims workbook and support personal promotion materials across Cardiovascular Business Unit teams. The role will maintain asset inventories and field resource guides and coordinate print inventory and physical material production with agencies and vendors.

Working with U.S. brand, field, agency and medical, legal and regulatory teams, the individual will track approved updates from intake through implementation, maintain source traceability and coordinate material availability. Medical, legal and regulatory partners retain responsibility for label interpretation, claim substantiation and approval.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**

  
  

**Label update implementation and asset control**

Maintain the implementation plan for approved label changes, including affected assets, owners, milestones, review status and deployment dates. Confirm the affected asset inventory and required actions with brand and review owners.

Coordinate updates across web, email, field, patient and other relevant materials. Track dependencies, follow up on outstanding reviews and escalate timing, source and approval questions to accountable owners.

Coordinate agency revisions, review routing and implementation handoffs. Maintain accurate asset inventories and version history and identify materials requiring replacement or retirement.

Check final versions against documented update instructions, coordinate replacement of superseded materials and retain evidence of completion in approved systems.

Provide implementation status and closeout reports, track overdue actions and recurring issues and recommend improvements to review and asset management workflows.

  
  

**Evergreen claims workbook**

Maintain approved claim wording, source references, usage status, version information and review dates provided by accountable owners.

Update records from approved materials and documented decisions and flag incomplete or conflicting entries for resolution.

Link claims records to relevant promotional materials and source documents to maintain traceability across updates.

Record owner decisions, approved revisions and applicable usage guidance so workbook entries reflect the latest approved position.

Maintain a review queue for stale references, unresolved questions and claims records requiring owner confirmation. Coordinate follow up with brand and review partners.

Position Summary
  
  
The Quality Assurance Manager leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the facility's Quality Management System and patient safety programs. The role ensures compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) requirements and international accreditation standards, including Joint Commission International (JCI), and drives a culture of safety and continuous improvement across clinical and non-clinical departments.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer / Medical Director |
**Location:**
Dubai, UAE
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Quality Management System
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System, including annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.
* Maintain controlled policies, procedures, and guidelines with effective document control and version management.
* Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.

Patient Safety and Risk Management
  
  

* Lead patient safety initiatives; monitor incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, and complaints.
* Coordinate incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA); develop and track Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Conduct risk assessments, maintain risk registers, and escalate serious or high-risk findings to senior management.

Audits and Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute annual clinical and operational audits, including medical record, infection prevention and control, medication management, and patient identification audits.
* Develop and monitor KPIs and quality indicators; prepare monthly and quarterly dashboards for senior leadership and committees.
* Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.

Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation
  
  

* Ensure continuous readiness for DHA inspections and other regulatory assessments.
* Oversee preparation for JCI and other accreditation surveys, including mock surveys and gap assessments.
* Monitor changes in UAE healthcare regulations and accreditation standards and implement required changes.
* Liaise with regulators, surveyors, and external auditors.

Continuous Improvement and Leadership
  
  

* Lead quality improvement projects using PDCA/PDSA, Lean, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Chair or coordinate quality and patient safety committees, producing agendas, reports, and action trackers.
* Manage, mentor, and develop the quality team; provide staff training on quality, safety, and accreditation requirements.
* Monitor patient complaints and satisfaction results and lead patient experience initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field from a recognized Western institution (US, UK, Canada, Australia, or EU); Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of healthcare experience, including at least 3 years in a quality, patient safety, or accreditation leadership role.
* Proven experience leading a facility through successful JCI accreditation or re-accreditation.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA regulations and UAE healthcare standards.
* Professional certification preferred: CPHQ, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, or equivalent.
* Eligibility for DHA professional licensing, where applicable.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, and data-driven decision-making.
* Strong knowledge of quality improvement and statistical methodologies.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and lead change.
* Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

**Senior Manager Quality & Risk (Hospital) | Dubai, UAE**

**About Us**

Our client is a new premium tertiary hospital in Dubai Healthcare City, opening in 2027. Backed by Scope Investment, it is being developed as an academic medical centre for the region. Advanced gastroenterology is its flagship programme, supported by a growing range of specialist services and centres of excellence. The hospital combines the latest medical technology with an academic approach to care, teaching and research, in a state-of-the-art building with premium design and a seamless digital patient journey. Care is physician-led and organised around the patient, and the hospital is designed to meet JCI standards from day one. Joining us now means helping to shape a new hospital from the ground up and building your career in an academic setting, with teaching, research, and fellowship opportunities alongside clinical practice.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Quality & Risk to establish and lead the Quality, Patient Safety and Risk Management function for our new multi-specialty tertiary hospital in Dubai.

The successful candidate will lead the hospital’s quality governance, regulatory and accreditation readiness, patient safety, clinical risk management, performance improvement, clinical audit and policy management programmes.

This role requires a senior healthcare quality leader with proven UAE hospital experience and hands-on involvement in new hospital commissioning, DHA licensing and inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, go-live and post-opening stabilisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Quality and Risk Management workstream through hospital commissioning, pre-opening, phased activation, go-live and operational stabilization.
* Establish and maintain the hospital-wide Quality Management System, Quality and Patient Safety Plan, governance framework, policies, procedures and reporting mechanisms.
* Lead DHA licensing, inspection and regulatory readiness, including gap assessments, compliance trackers, mock inspections, evidence files and corrective action follow-up.
* Drive JCI accreditation readiness through mock surveys, tracers, standards interpretation, evidence management and closure of identified gaps.
* Lead patient safety and clinical risk programmes, including incident reporting, adverse-event review, near-miss analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and risk registers.
* Develop and manage the hospital’s clinical and operational audit programme, leadership rounds, patient safety rounds and compliance monitoring activities.
* Establish quality indicators, KPIs and dashboards; ensure data validation, trend analysis, executive reporting and timely escalation of significant risks or performance gaps.
* Lead multidisciplinary improvement initiatives using recognised methodologies such as PDCA, PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma and DMAIC.
* Oversee policy development, document control, review cycles, approvals, version control and compliance with approved hospital policies and procedures.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, safety culture and service-quality indicators, and coordinate sustainable improvement actions.
* Build and lead the Quality and Risk team and collaborate closely with Medical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, Infection Prevention and Control, Health Information Management, Facilities, IT, HR and other project stakeholders.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, Allied Health, Quality Management, Public Health or a related healthcare discipline. A relevant Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, clinical governance or risk management, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven UAE hospital experience; direct involvement in commissioning, opening, licensing, or major expansion of a hospital is highly desirable.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA requirements, JCI accreditation standards, patient safety principles, clinical governance and healthcare risk management.
* Demonstrated experience in mock surveys, tracers, clinical audits, incident investigations, RCA, CAPA, risk registers, quality indicators and executive dashboards.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary quality-improvement projects and support organisational change in a complex hospital environment.
* Experience managing quality teams, governance committees, policies, training programmes, departmental budgets and regulatory or accreditation evidence.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CPPS, Lean Six Sigma, Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor or an equivalent healthcare quality or risk credential is preferred.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

**We are particularly interested in healthcare quality leaders who have successfully supported the commissioning and opening of a new hospital in the UAE and can establish the complete Quality and Risk function from the ground up.**

Candidates should demonstrate direct responsibility for DHA inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, Quality Management Systems, patient safety, incident investigation, RCA, CAPA, clinical audits, risk registers, KPIs, dashboards, policy management, and post-opening stabilisation.

**Please note: This position requires extensive hospital Quality and Risk leadership experience. Applicants without relevant hospital experience will not be considered.**

* Review medical treatments and services to identify any discrepancies or areas requiring further investigation or clarification.

* Participate in internal quality assurance processes, providing feedback to improve claims management and operational efficiency.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams (claims adjusters, medical case managers, legal, underwriting, call center, BDU, account managers and finance) to ensure effective case resolution and timely decision-making.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in case management, claims management, or a related role within a TPA or insurance environment.
* Experience in health insurance or medical claims management is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of claims processes, insurance policies, and healthcare industry regulations.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with a variety of stakeholders.
* Excellent negotiations skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple cases efficiently while ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulations.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Proficiency with claims management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Bilingual (English/Arabic) is a plus, depending on location.
* AI READINESS Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data analytics and cloud-based tools, using insights responsibly with our standards of data governance, security and ethical use.

Allianz Partners is a global leader in providing innovative Einsurance and assistance services across the globe. As part of Allianz Group, we focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences, offering a broad range of tailored services that meet the evolving needs of individuals and businesses worldwide.

The Quality & After-Sales Manager is responsible for ensuring that yachts meet the company's quality standards throughout production, commissioning, delivery, and after-sales service.
  
  
The role focuses on identifying and resolving quality issues, managing customer complaints and warranty claims, coordinating repairs, and ensuring that recurring problems are addressed to improve the quality of future yacht builds.
  
  
The position requires close coordination with Production, Engineering, Project Management, Service, and other departments to maintain high-quality standards and customer satisfaction.

**2. After-Sales & Warranty Management**
**3. Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee quality inspections during yacht construction, assembly, commissioning, and final delivery
* Ensure all work meets approved drawings, technical specifications, company standards, and applicable marine regulations
* Identify quality defects and nonconformities across structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior, and finishing works
* Monitor quality checkpoints at different stages of yacht production
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues before yacht delivery

* Monitor outstanding warranty claims and follow up until successful closure
* Coordinate technical support for yachts operating in different locations when required
* Maintain proper records of warranty claims, repair costs, service history, and completed rectification works
* Investigate recurring quality defects and after-sales complaints to identify their root causes
* Determine whether defects originate from design, production, installation, materials, suppliers, or commissioning
* Work with Engineering, Production, and Procurement teams to implement corrective and preventive actions
* Ensure lessons learned from delivered yachts are applied to ongoing and future yacht projects
* Recommend improvements to production processes, inspection procedures, and quality standards
* Monitor recurring defects to reduce warranty costs, rework, and customer complaints
* Coordinate final quality inspections before yacht handover
* Ensure all identified defects and outstanding items are documented and resolved before delivery
* Work with Project Managers, Production, and Commissioning teams to ensure yachts meet delivery requirements
* Review punch lists and monitor the closure of outstanding items
* Support sea trials, technical inspections, and customer acceptance activities when required
* Ensure proper handover of quality records, warranty documentation, and outstanding service items to the after-sales team
* Coordinate quality inspectors, after-sales technicians, and service teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Service departments
* Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to resolve material defects, equipment failures, and installation issues
* Prioritize critical quality and after-sales issues based on safety, operational impact, customer requirements, and delivery schedules
* Conduct regular quality and after-sales review meetings to monitor progress and outstanding issues
* Prepare regular reports on production quality, warranty claims, and after-sales activities
* Maintain an updated tracker of quality defects, corrective actions, and pending warranty issues
* Monitor warranty repair costs and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenses
* Track recurring defects and provide recommendations to management
* Monitor key performance indicators, including:

+ Number of quality defects and recurring issues
+ Outstanding and overdue nonconformities
+ Warranty claims and repair costs
+ Average time taken to resolve after-sales complaints
+ Closure of corrective and preventive actions
+ Customer satisfaction and repeat complaints

**Requirements**
**Candidate Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Quality Management, or a related technical field
* Minimum 7-10 years of relevant experience in yacht manufacturing, shipbuilding, marine quality management, or after-sales technical services
* Previous experience in a managerial or supervisory role within the marine industry
* Experience working with luxury yachts, superyachts, or complex marine vessels is highly preferred
* Strong understanding of yacht construction, commissioning, technical systems, and warranty management
