jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

jobs.title: Research Engineer (Process)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Sr Scientist, Crosslinking, Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**About ZymoChem**

ZymoChem is pioneering breakthrough science for a fossil-free future. We are building bio-based materials that make everyday products better for people and the planet, accelerating the world’s transition to a real zero-carbon economy. We develop specialty chemicals and high-performance materials from renewable feedstocks. Our proprietary bio-manufacturing platform delivers fossil-independent alternatives to petroleum-based materials, bringing decarbonization and supply chain resiliency to everyday goods.

The company’s first commercial product, BAYSE™, is a bio-based, biodegradable, and microplastic-free superabsorbent polymer with traceable bio-based content and verifiable sustainability claims.

Founded by leading scientists and engineers and backed by strategic investors and industry partners, ZymoChem is scaling rapidly to meet growing demand for sustainable materials. With funding from both financial and strategic investors like Lululemon, Toyota, Breakout Ventures, and major U.S. government agencies (DOE, DOD), ZymoChem is accelerating the commercialization and sales of our products.

At ZymoChem, our culture is rooted in curiosity, innovation, and collaboration. We tackle complex scientific challenges with determination and succeed because of the strength of our diverse, multidisciplinary teams working toward a bold mission. As a Certified B Corporation and Public Benefit Corporation, we hold ourselves accountable not only to scientific and commercial excellence, but also to creating measurable impact for people and the planet.

**Our Mission:**
To catalyze a real-zero carbon economy with drop-in, bio-based solutions.

**Our Vision:**
To live in a world in which the goods we depend on every day are bio-manufactured from 100% renewable materials and designed for a sustainable economy - without compromise.

**Our Values:**
Lead with Compassion, Aspire Collectively, Evolve Continuously, Innovate with Impact, Scale Sustainably

**Position Summary**

The
**Sr. Scientist, Crosslinking**
will serve as primary on-site technical liaison between ZymoChem’s San Leandro teams (Materials Development, Process Engineering, R&D, Quality) and our contract manufacturer (CMO) in India. You will drive technology transfer, scale-up and manufacturing of our bio-based superabsorbent polymer (BioSAP).

**Responsibilities:**

**Technology transfer and coordination**

* Communicate process requirements, clarify technical instructions and implement approved process changes at the CMO.
* Work with CMO personnel and equipment vendors to resolve equipment issues.

**Campaign readiness and execution**

* Assess readiness: equipment, raw materials, staffing and training, sampling plans, analytics and acceptance criteria.
* Provide hands-on support during campaigns, commissioning, engineering trials, startup and ramp-up.

**Process monitoring and troubleshooting**

* Support the full SAP conversion process: crosslinking, gel processing, drying, milling, sieving, and thermal treatment.
* Monitor crosslinking parameters: stoichiometry, mixing uniformity, reaction kinetics, curing and thermal treatment.
* Track how incoming polymer properties (e.g. solids, viscosity, molecular weight, pH) affect crosslinking, consistency and SAP performance.
* Troubleshoot high-viscosity polymer handling, mixing, heat transfer, gel processing, drying and powder handling.
* Implement at-line and in-process methods to assess crosslinking consistency, gel quality and intermediate SAP properties.

**Data, quality and optimization**

* Collect, analyze and report manufacturing data against specifications, including material balance, yield, throughput, absorbency, particle size distribution, moisture, bulk density and residuals. Flag trends and deviations.
* Lead preliminary assessments and facilitate root-cause analysis of off-spec batches and deviations. Coordinate corrective actions with Materials Development and Quality teams.
* Improve throughput, yield, cycle time, equipment utilization and batch-to-batch consistency.

**Documentation, risk and safety**

* Maintain SOPs, batch records, process control documents and training materials.
* Contribute to risk assessments, FMEA and post-run reviews. Document lessons learned.
* Ensure safe handling of chemicals and equipment per HSE and company policies.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* MS or PhD in Polymer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of industrial experience in polymer processing, crosslinking, scale-up or technology transfer.
* Strong command of polymer synthesis, crosslinking chemistry, curing mechanisms and reaction kinetics. Water-soluble polymers or hydrogels preferred.
* Hands-on industrial mixing, drying, milling and thermal processing.
* Data analysis, deviation troubleshooting and root-cause investigation.
* Familiarity with manufacturing documentation, in-process QC and process safety, including designing safety into processes and equipment.
* Able to work independently on-site while coordinating with remote teams.
* Based on-site in India, with travel to San Leandro as required.
* Preferred: surface crosslinking, surface functionalization or polymer modification.

**Culture and Benefits**

We are a mission-driven team building the future of sustainable materials. At ZymoChem, you’ll work on bold ideas with smart, collaborative people. This position is at our CMO site in India, so benefits will be based on India employment standards and will include competitive compensation and benefits packages for the region.

jobs.title: Operations Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**

* Analyse production and operational performance data to identify trends, variances, root causes and improvement opportunities, providing actionable insights that support productivity, efficiency and informed operational decision-making.
* Validate and reconcile production and operational data across relevant systems and sources, identifying and resolving data discrepancies with relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate, complete and reliable management information.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, performance reports and visual management tools to provide timely visibility of production KPIs, operational performance, risks and exceptions, enabling management to monitor performance and take appropriate action.
* Analyse Cost of Production drivers, including yield, labour productivity, waste and resource utilisation, identifying variances and improvement opportunities to support cost optimisation and operational efficiency.
* Analyse historical and current production, sales and operational data to support demand forecasting, capacity planning and resource requirements, enabling timely and informed production planning decisions.
* Develop analytical models and scenario assessments to support business cases, projects, process improvements and capacity reviews, providing reliable evidence and assumptions to support evaluation and business decision-making.
* Provide analytical support for R&D activities, production trials and new initiatives by establishing relevant performance measures and evaluating results to support evidence-based assessment of operational outcomes.
* Identify and support opportunities to standardise and automate operational reporting, data collection and analytical processes, improving the accuracy, efficiency, accessibility and consistency of management information.

**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in business analytics, operational analytics, production reporting, data analysis or a related field, preferably within a manufacturing, production or operational environment.
* Proven experience developing management dashboards, performance reports and analytical models using multiple data sources.
* Experience in Cost of Production analysis, business case development, forecasting, scenario modelling and supporting operational improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with R&D, trials, projects or new initiatives where data analysis is required to evaluate performance and outcomes.

**Skills**

* Advanced Excel and Power BI or equivalent data visualisation tools.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems and data management.
* Strong analytical, quantitative and problem-solving skills, including statistical analysis and forecasting.
* Ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into clear operational insights.
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills with high attention to data accuracy and detail.

At Emirates Bustanica, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

* A fast‑paced, technology‑driven environment where ownership and accountability matter

* A collaborative, multicultural team environment
* Open communication and a culture of transparency
* A strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and learning

jobs.title: Technical Proposal Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to be part of an innovative, international organisation delivering advanced wastewater treatment solutions and supporting sustainable water management across the Middle East?

*Influx Search has partnered with a globally recognised leader in water and wastewater treatment technology, specialising in advanced Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) systems for municipal and industrial applications. With an established international presence and a strong reputation for technical innovation, the business delivers high-performance solutions to some of the region's most demanding wastewater treatment projects.*

As part of their continued regional expansion, we're looking for a Technical Proposal Engineer to join their Dubai-based team, providing specialist process design and technical proposal support across the Middle East.

**What's the job?**

We're seeking a technically capable engineer with a strong background in biological wastewater treatment, ideally with experience in MBR systems and process design.

You will play a key role in supporting the regional sales team, reviewing technical enquiries, developing wastewater treatment concepts and preparing detailed technical proposals for municipal and industrial projects.

Working closely with both local commercial colleagues and an established UK-based technical team, you'll help develop technically sound, commercially competitive solutions while occasionally supporting technical discussions with customers, consultants and contractors.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Reviewing client enquiries, tender documents, technical specifications and wastewater characteristics to develop appropriate treatment solutions.
* Preparing detailed technical proposals, including process calculations, equipment sizing, mass balances and technical compliance statements.
* Developing biological wastewater treatment concepts and process designs, particularly for MBR applications.
* Producing and reviewing engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, equipment datasheets, layouts and BOQs.
* Supporting the regional sales team with technical input throughout the pre-sales and tendering process.
* Participating in technical meetings with customers, consultants, contractors and project partners.
* Collaborating with international engineering and technical teams to ensure proposed solutions meet project requirements.
* Managing multiple technical proposals simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, quality and timely submission.

**What's in it for you?**

As well as joining a globally established business at the forefront of membrane technology, you'll play an important role in strengthening its technical capabilities across the Middle East. You'll also benefit from:

* The opportunity to work on diverse municipal and industrial wastewater treatment projects across the region.
* Specialist product and technical training with an established UK-based engineering team.
* International exposure and collaboration with experienced technical specialists.
* A Dubai-based position offering some hybrid working flexibility.
* Opportunities for regional travel and ongoing professional development.

**What do we need from you?**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental, Chemical, Process, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* Approximately 5–10 years' experience in wastewater treatment process design, proposal engineering or a similar technical position.
* Strong technical understanding of biological wastewater treatment processes, with practical MBR design experience highly desirable.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, process calculations, equipment specifications and engineering documentation.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, with experience producing or reviewing PFDs and P&IDs.
* Experience in municipal and/or industrial wastewater treatment, with industrial applications considered particularly advantageous.
* Previous experience within a water treatment technology provider, OEM, EPC contractor, engineering consultancy or system integrator.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage with technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.
* Currently based in the UAE, with the ability to work from the Dubai office and travel throughout the Middle East when required.

If you're an experienced wastewater treatment engineer with a passion for biological treatment technology and an interest in supporting technically challenging projects across the Middle East, we want to hear from you.

Apply via LinkedIn or contact Max Fraser-Krauss (max@influxsearch.com) to apply directly.

**Influx Search is a global executive and specialty search recruitment consultancy that helps businesses find the best talent across a wide range of water, clean-tech and environmental applications.**

**Our mission is clear: to streamline, optimise, and propel your business's recruitment plans.**

jobs.description:
**Building a Startup in Urban Energy Technologies**

**The Opportunity**

I am looking for a passionate and ambitious scientific mind to join me as a
**Co-Founder and Scientific Lead**
in building Shamsa, an early-stage startup focused on developing innovative technologies in the field of urban energy.

I am not advertising a job, nor am I looking to hire someone to fill an existing position.

I am looking for a co-founder who shares my enthusiasm for the idea and is genuinely interested in building a technology startup from the ground up.

My ambition is to establish a company that explores, develops, and brings innovative energy technologies into the built environment, creating new possibilities for how energy can be generated, integrated, and utilized within our cities.

**Where We Stand**

Shamsa is currently at the idea and venture-building stage.

This is an opportunity to join at the very beginning, contribute to shaping the company's vision, explore technological opportunities, and help determine the direction Shamsa will take.

I believe that building an innovative technology company requires more than a promising idea. It requires scientific expertise, curiosity, experimentation, and the ability to turn research and innovation into commercially viable solutions.

**Who I Am Looking For**

I am looking for someone who has:

* An academic background in Materials Science, Physics, Renewable Energy, Electrical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* A PhD or a research-intensive Master's degree.
* A genuine passion for scientific innovation and emerging energy technologies.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a strong desire to build a startup, rather than simply pursue a conventional career.
* The ambition to transform scientific knowledge and research into practical technologies and commercial opportunities.
* The willingness to take ownership, embrace uncertainty, and build something from the earliest stages.
* Be permanently present in the UAE.

**What I Envision Building Together**

As Co-Founder and Scientific Lead, you will play a central role in shaping Shamsa scientific and technological direction.

This includes exploring new technologies, identifying promising research opportunities, developing concepts, evaluating their feasibility, and leading the journey from scientific exploration towards practical applications and market-ready solutions.

Most importantly, I am looking for someone who wants to help shape the company itself, not just its technology.

**The Founding Opportunity**

This is a founding opportunity, not a salaried employment position.

I am looking for a committed co-founder who is excited about the idea, believes in its potential, and is willing to invest their expertise, time, and entrepreneurial drive into building Shamsa.

The opportunity includes a founding equity stake, with the structure and terms to be discussed based on mutual commitment and contributions.

**Let's Build Shamsa**

If you are a scientist, researcher, or technical innovator who has an entrepreneurial ambition and would be excited to turn an idea into a technology startup, I would be interested in connecting with you.

**I am not looking for someone to join an existing company. I am looking for someone to build one with me.**

Shamsa — Building the Next Generation of Urban Energy Technologies.

jobs.title: Post-Doctoral Associate in the Division of Science (Chemistry) - Dr. Ali Trabolsi
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
The Trabolsi Research Group at New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) invites applications for a Post-Doctoral Associate position in Organic and Supramolecular Chemistry. The successful candidate will conduct innovative and interdisciplinary research focused on the rational design, synthesis, and characterization of complex organic molecules, supramolecular architectures, and functional porous materials, particularly covalent organic frameworks (COFs). The research will emphasize the development of responsive molecular systems with tailored structural and functional properties for applications in water treatment, health, and energy. Particular attention will be given to designing functional COFs for the selective recognition, capture, and removal of emerging contaminants from water, including pharmaceuticals, endocrine disruptors, and persistent organic pollutants. The candidate will investigate molecular recognition, host–guest interactions, self-assembly, and structure–property relationships to advance the fundamental understanding and practical applications of these materials.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Conduct research in organic synthesis, supramolecular chemistry, and the development of functional molecular architectures.
* Design, synthesize, purify, and characterize complex organic molecules, macrocycles, supramolecular assemblies, and functional building blocks for COFs.
* Develop innovative synthetic strategies for preparing responsive molecular systems and porous organic materials.
* Investigate molecular recognition, host–guest interactions, self-assembly, and structure–property relationships.
* Develop and optimize functional COFs for selective contaminant removal, molecular capture, and environmental applications.
* Explore potential applications of supramolecular systems and functional materials in biomedical and energy-related technologies.
* Prepare high-quality scientific manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present research findings at scientific conferences.
* Contribute to the preparation of research proposals, grant applications, and scientific reports.
* Mentor and train undergraduate and graduate students in organic synthesis, characterization techniques, and experimental procedures.
* Collaborate with researchers within the Trabolsi Research Group and with external academic partners.
* Maintain accurate research records and ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures and institutional regulations.
* Contribute to the development of new research directions and support the overall scientific objectives of the research group.

The terms of employment are competitive and include housing and educational subsidies for children, in accordance with NYU Abu Dhabi policies. The anticipated start date is February 1, 2027. Applications will be accepted immediately, and candidates will be considered on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
  
  
**About NYU Abu Dhabi**
https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/
  
  
NYU Abu Dhabi is the first comprehensive liberal arts and research campus in the Middle East to be operated abroad by a major American research university. Times Higher Education ranks NYU among the top 30 universities in the world, making NYU Abu Dhabi the highest-ranked university in the UAE and MENA region. NYU Abu Dhabi has integrated a highly selective undergraduate curriculum across the disciplines with a world center for advanced research and scholarship. The university enables its students in the sciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities, and arts to succeed in an increasingly interdependent world and advance cooperation and progress on humanity’s shared challenges. NYU Abu Dhabi’s high-achieving students have come from over 120 countries and speak over 100 languages. Together, NYU's campuses in New York, Abu Dhabi, and Shanghai form the backbone of a unique global university, giving faculty and students opportunities to experience varied learning environments and immersion in other cultures at one or more of the numerous study-abroad sites NYU maintains on six continents.
  
  
NYUAD is committed to upholding a culture of non-discrimination, anti-harassment, dignity, and mutual respect; providing equal access and opportunity; and fostering academic excellence in learning, research, and teaching.
  
  
Students are drawn from among the world’s best. They are bright, intellectually passionate, and committed to building a campus environment anchored in mutual respect, understanding, and care. The NYUAD undergraduate student body has garnered an impressive record of scholarships, graduate-school admissions, and other global honors. Graduate education is an area of growth for the University; the current graduate student population of over 100 students is expected to expand in the next decade as doctoral programs are developed.
  
  
**Working for NYUAD**
At NYUAD, we recognize that Abu Dhabi is more than where you work; it’s your home. In order for research staff to thrive, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. This starts with a generous relocation allowance; educational assistance for your dependents; access to health and wellness services; and more. NYUAD is committed to research staff success throughout the academic trajectory, providing support for ambitious and world-class research projects and innovative, interactive teaching approaches. Support for dual-career families is a priority. Visit our website for more information on benefits for you and your dependents.
  
  

* Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry, Supramolecular Chemistry, or a closely related discipline, and no more than five years post receipt of PhD.
* Strong experimental background in multistep organic synthesis and supramolecular chemistry.
* Demonstrated experience in the design, synthesis, purification, and characterization of complex organic molecules and supramolecular systems.
* Strong knowledge of molecular recognition, host–guest chemistry, self-assembly, and noncovalent interactions.
* Experience in the synthesis and functionalization of covalent organic frameworks (COFs), macrocycles, or related porous organic materials is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in organic synthesis and characterization techniques, including NMR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, and chromatography.
* Demonstrated research productivity through publications in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
* Ability to independently design and execute experiments, analyze results, and solve complex scientific problems.
* Good scientific writing skills and the ability to contribute to research manuscripts and grant proposals.
* Willingness to mentor undergraduate and graduate students and collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and teamwork skills.
* Strong motivation, creativity, and commitment to conducting high-quality research.

For consideration, applicants must submit the following documents, all in PDF format:
  
  

* A cover letter outlining their qualifications and motivation for applying.
* A curriculum vitae (CV), including a complete list of publications.
* A transcript or copy of degree
* A statement of research interests highlighting relevant experience and future research goals.
* Three contact references

For questions or further information regarding the position, please contact Prof. Ali Trabolsi at at105@nyu.edu.
  
  
NYUAD is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and seek individuals who will contribute to the excellence and vibrancy of our academic community.
  
  
Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Join NYU Abu Dhabi, an exceptional place for exceptional people.**
NYUAD values belonging and respect; such principles are fundamental to the university’s commitment to excellence. NYUAD is an equal-opportunity emp

jobs.title: Senior Chemist (UAEN)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Chemist (UAEN)**
to join our client's team based
**Sharjah.**

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and monitoring the plant's water chemistry, chemical treatment systems, environmental compliance, and laboratory activities to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient power plant operations.

***In support of Emiratization initiatives and the organization's commitment to developing local talent, qualified Emirati professionals are encouraged to apply.***

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* **8–10 years of relevant professional experience**
  in power plant chemistry, preferably within large-scale Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) power plants.
* Candidates must have specific experience in the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) of large CCGT power plants.
* Experience working with
  **GE heavy-duty gas turbines, F-class and above**
  , is essential.

  **GE 9HA-class gas turbines**
  , preferably with 8–10 years of experience, will be given preference.

* Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and plant operations while ensuring compliance with HSE, environmental, and company procedures.

jobs.title: GC-MS Analyst, Fragrance Division
jobs.description:

Founded in 1850 and headquartered in Grasse, France,
**Robertet**
is a global leader in natural raw materials and one of the world's most respected creators of fragrances, flavors, and active ingredients. With a presence in over 50 countries, Robertet combines innovation, sustainability, and scientific expertise to create unique sensory experiences for some of the world's leading brands.

At
**Robertet Middle East**
, based in Dubai, we serve customers across the Middle East region, providing tailored fragrance solutions through close collaboration between our local team and global experts.

Joining Robertet means becoming part of a company that values creativity, technical excellence, entrepreneurship, and passion for the world of scent.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**GC-MS Analyst**
to join our
**Dubai Creative Center**
. Reporting directly to the Managing Director of Robertet Middle East, you will provide analytical support to our Fine Fragrance Division across the region.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of science and perfumery, collaborating closely with our Sales, Evaluation, and Laboratory teams in Dubai, as well as our GC-MS specialists and Perfumers in France. You will play a key role in fragrance analysis, reformulation, laboratory operations, and maintaining analytical excellence within our regional innovation center.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform fragrance analysis, interpretation, quantification, and reformulation using
  **Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS)**
  .
* Process and interpret analytical data using chromatographic software and fragrance databases.
* Maintain an up-to-date library of market fragrances and natural raw materials.
* Ensure preventive maintenance and troubleshooting of GC-MS equipment.
* Support laboratory compliance with safety procedures and good laboratory practices.
* Collaborate closely with Perfumers, Fragrance Development teams, and GC-MS specialists in France.
* Prepare analytical reports and communicate findings effectively to internal stakeholders.

**Skills & Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Sciences, or a related field.
* 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in GC-MS analysis within the fragrance, flavors, cosmetics, essential oils, or related industries.
* Knowledge of chromatographic techniques and analytical data interpretation.
* Familiarity with GC-MS software and analytical databases.
* Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Good laboratory practices (GLP) and laboratory safety awareness.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

**Preferred**

* Basic olfactory skills and the ability to recognize fragrance ingredients and odor profiles.
* Exposure to fragrance reformulation or raw material analysis.
* Knowledge of natural raw materials and essential oils.
* French language skills would be an advantage.

**Why Join Robertet?**

* Join a world-renowned fragrance house with over 175 years of heritage and innovation.
* Work alongside industry experts, perfumers, and analytical specialists across international teams.
* Gain exposure to a wide variety of fragrance categories and cutting-edge analytical techniques.
* Be part of a collaborative, multicultural, and entrepreneurial environment.
* Contribute directly to the development of fragrances for customers across the Middle East region.

**If you are passionate about analytical chemistry, fragrances, and working in an international environment where science and creativity come together, we would love to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Industrial Technical Consultant
jobs.description:

Founded in 1923, Ecolab is the global leader in water, hygiene and energy technologies and services that protect people and vital resources. With 2022 sales of $13 billion and 48,000 associates, Ecolab delivers comprehensive solutions and on-site service to promote safe food, maintain clean environments, optimize water and energy use and improve operational efficiencies for customers in the food, healthcare, energy, hospitality, commercial laundry and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world.

Summarize findings in a technical report and support the presentation of key findings and service reports during customer review meetings with value documentation and benefits
* Provides on-the-job product and sales training as appropriate and identifies training and reference materials needed for field sales training programs.

Participation includes field trial assistance, technical training development or rollout, and after commercialization sales support.
* Ability to track product margin on monthly basis and discuss with stakeholders during deviations, identify alternate products/Innovation to retain customers and product GM.

* Knowledge of water automation, digital solutions, and managed operations.

* Experience in troubleshooting water and wastewater plants. (Ability to identify problems and guide sales team to resolve it)
* Agile, self-driven, and results oriented.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Role requires frequent domestic and international travel.
* Fluency in English is a must. Candidates with fluency in Arabic are preferred.

jobs.description:

* Focus: Regenerative agriculture practices introduced in 100% olive oil value chain and apply the learnings to other IFFCO key crops value chain. Potential wildlife conservation projects in key markets: KSA, Egypt, Pakistan and Indonesia.
* Work closely with partners, coordinate and manage regenerative agriculture. Support with internal communication decks around regenerative agriculture and impacts.
* Work closely with partners, direct and coordinate on wildlife conservation projects. Support with internal communication decks around wildlife conservation projects and impacts.
* Collect, compile, measure and report on progress and results of projects.
* Support in external communications of sustainability stories and results of projects.

*This is a not-exhaustive list of focus areas and tasks*

**KPIs**

* Committed Biodiversity targets reached, including communications on sustainability stories and impacts
* 100% Olive oil value chain is implementing regenerative agriculture and is reflected in the brands campaigns/communications. In plan, budget and time
* Regenerative agriculture learning applied and implemented in other IFFCO key crops
* IFFCO footprint on biodiversity conservation is realized
* Sustainability Team administrative support

**Work Experience Requirement**

Agricultural and environmental background. Sustainability aspects knowledge.

**Qualification**

University Graduates in Agriculture / Environment Science

**Competencies**

* Communicating effectively
* Customer Centricity
* Knowledge of Value Chain Management
* Manufacturing Operations and Industry Practices
* Ownership & Result Orientation
* Planning & Decision Making
* Project Management
* Self and Team Management

**Enriching Lives Since 1975: IFFCO Group's Legacy**

Since its establishment in 1975, IFFCO Group has thrived into a multinational conglomerate headquartered in the United Arab Emirates. Our influential FMCG brands and diverse portfolio of industry solutions and services enrich the lives of countless consumers and customers across the globe. In 2023, IFFCO Group proudly carries the distinction of being certified as a Great Place to Work® in both the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
